lemmas.def_en: the act of rendering optimal

examples.en: Continuous optimization of the supply chain reduced operational expenses.
examples.zh: 对供应链的持续优化降低了运营开支。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数抽象名词，常见搭配包括system optimization或cost optimization。

lemmas.def_en: most desirable possible under a restriction expressed or implied

examples.en: The greenhouse creates optimal conditions for tropical plant growth.
examples.zh: 温室为热带植物的生长创造了最佳条件。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词作定语，修饰conditions、solution等，表示客观上的最优状态。

lemmas.def_en: most desirable possible under a restriction expressed or implied

examples.en: Keep the refrigerator at the optimum temperature to preserve food safely.
examples.zh: 将冰箱保持在最适宜的温度以安全保存食物。

lemmas.usage_note: 作形容词时只用于名词前作定语，常修饰level、temperature等量化指标。

lemmas.def_en: in an optimal and most desirable way

examples.en: The heating system must be maintained regularly to ensure that it functions optimally.
examples.zh: 供暖系统必须定期维护，以确保其处于最佳运行状态。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 optimus（最好），加后缀 -ize 表示“使达到最佳状态”。
family_guide.core_distinction: optimize 为动词操作；optimization 为优化的过程或状态名词。

lemmas.def_en: street names for marijuana
lemmas.def_zh: 吸毒者, 笨蛋, 麻醉药物, 粘稠物

examples.en: The reporter managed to get the inside dope on the political scandal.
examples.zh: 记者设法获取了那起政治丑闻的内部内幕。

lemmas.usage_note: 俚语中指毒品大麻或笨蛋，非正式用法中也指内部消息（the inside dope）。

lemmas.def_en: take drugs to improve one's athletic performance
lemmas.def_zh: 麻痹, 上涂料, 预测出；吸毒

examples.en: The athlete was banned for life after attempting to dope before the finals.
examples.zh: 该运动员因在决赛前企图使用兴奋剂而被终身禁赛。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指给赛马、运动员等服用违禁药物，或下麻醉药迷倒某人。

lemmas.def_en: having or revealing stupidity
lemmas.def_zh: 被麻醉的, 呆笨的, 迟钝的

examples.en: He felt quite dopey for hours after waking up from the general anesthesia.
examples.zh: 从全身麻醉中醒来后，他昏昏沉沉了好几个小时。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自荷兰语 doop（蘸酱、粘稠液体），后引申为麻醉剂、兴奋剂及相关动作。

lemmas.def_en: help to readapt, as to a former state of health or good repute
lemmas.def_zh: 恢复原状, 修复, 使康复

examples.en: The physical therapy program helped rehabilitate the injured athlete after surgery.
examples.zh: 理疗项目帮助这位受伤的运动员在术后恢复了健康。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指通过治疗或培训使人恢复健康或正常生活，亦可指修复名誉或老旧建筑，常接介词 into。

lemmas.def_en: the restoration of someone to a useful place in society

examples.en: She spent three months in rehabilitation learning to walk again.
examples.zh: 她在康复中心度过了三个月，重新学习走路。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于医疗、司法与建筑领域，常见搭配有 undergo rehabilitation 与 stroke rehabilitation。

lemmas.def_en: designed to accomplish rehabilitation; - J.B.Costello

examples.en: The clinic offers specialized rehabilitative therapy to help stroke patients recover their speech.
examples.zh: 该诊所提供专门的康复治疗，帮助中风患者恢复语言功能。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 re-（重新）+ habilitate（使有能力），核心语义为“使恢复正常状态或能力”。
family_guide.core_distinction: rehabilitate 为动词动作；rehabilitation 为康复、恢复名誉的名词形式。

lemmas.def_en: someone who performs rap music
lemmas.def_zh: 敲门人, (美)(非正式)控告人, 证人, 检举人

examples.en: The old wooden door had a heavy brass rapper shaped like a lion head.
examples.zh: 那扇老木门上有一个狮头形状的沉重黄铜门环。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于音乐语境，指说唱歌手；常见搭配有 aspiring rapper（有抱负的说唱歌手）或 hip-hop rapper。

family_guide.root_logic: 动词 rap（说唱）加表示人的后缀 -er，特指说唱歌手。

lemmas.def_en: a metric unit of weight equal to one thousandth of a kilogram
lemmas.def_zh: 克, 绿豆, 鹰嘴豆

examples.en: The baker added just one extra gram of salt to balance the sweet dough.
examples.zh: 面包师只多加了一克盐来中和甜面团的味道。

lemmas.usage_note: 重量单位克，常与数词连用；搭配 per gram（每克）或 be measured in grams，英式常拼作 gramme。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 gramma（小重量单位），为公制重量单位“克”。

lemmas.def_en: pause or hold back in uncertainty or unwillingness
lemmas.def_zh: 犹豫, 迟疑, 踌躇, 支吾, 停顿

examples.en: Please do not hesitate to contact our customer support if you have questions.
examples.zh: 如果您有任何疑问，请随时联系我们的客户支持。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示由于疑虑或担忧而停顿，常用于 don't hesitate to do sth（尽管做某事）或 hesitate about。

lemmas.def_en: indecision in speech or action
lemmas.def_zh: 犹豫, 踌躇, 含糊, 口吃, 暂停

examples.en: He accepted the challenging job offer without a moment's hesitation.
examples.zh: 他毫不犹豫地接受了这份极具挑战性的工作邀请。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数或可数名词，常与介词 without 连用表示“毫不犹豫”，也常与 have no hesitation in doing 搭配。

lemmas.def_en: a feeling of diffidence and indecision about doing something

examples.en: His noticeable hesitancy during the interview raised concerns about his confidence level.
examples.zh: 他在面试中明显的犹豫不决引起了人们对其自信程度的担忧。

lemmas.def_en: a feeling of diffidence and indecision about doing something

examples.en: His momentary hesitance before answering made the interviewers quite suspicious.
examples.zh: 他回答前片刻的犹豫引起了面试官的怀疑。

lemmas.def_en: with hesitation; in a hesitant manner

examples.en: he finally accepted hesitantly

lemmas.def_en: without hesitation
lemmas.def_zh: 不踌躇地, 坚定地, 迅速地; 爽爽快快

examples.en: The brave lifeguard jumped unhesitatingly into the rough water to save the child.
examples.zh: 勇敢的救生员毫不犹豫地跳入汹涌的水中去救那个孩子。

lemmas.def_en: with hesitation; in a hesitant manner
lemmas.def_zh: 踌躇地, 含糊地, 犹豫地

examples.en: The nervous witness stepped forward hesitatingly to identify the suspect in the courtroom.
examples.zh: 紧张的证人犹豫不决地走上前去，在法庭上指认嫌疑人。

lemmas.def_zh: 迟疑的, 踌躇的, 犹豫不定的
lemmas.def_en: lacking decisiveness of character; unable to act or decide quickly or firmly

examples.en: Investors remain hesitant to fund early-stage startups in this volatile market.
examples.zh: 在当前动荡的市场环境下，投资者对资助初创企业依然犹豫不决。

lemmas.usage_note: 作表语或定语，形容态度犹疑不决，后常接介词 about、in 或动词不定式 to do。

lemmas.def_en: characterized by quickness and firmness
lemmas.def_zh: 不踌躇的, 不犹豫的, 迅速的

examples.en: She offered unhesitating support when her friend asked for help during the crisis.
examples.zh: 在朋友危难求助时，她毫不犹豫地施以援手。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 haesitare（卡住、结巴、停留），引申为思想动作上的迟疑。
family_guide.core_distinction: hesitate 为动词动作；hesitation 为犹豫的心理状态或名词表现。

lemmas.def_en: a prisoner who is held by one party to insure that another party will meet specified terms

examples.en: The government negotiated through diplomats to secure the safe release of the hostage.
examples.zh: 政府通过外交官进行谈判，以确保人质安全获释。

lemmas.usage_note: 核心动词搭配有 take/hold sb hostage（绑架/扣押某人为质），介词用 as a hostage；注意名词不加被动。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 hostage，指作为担保或被强行扣押的“人质”。

lemmas.def_en: denoting a quantity consisting of six items or units

examples.en: Experienced programmers often prefer the vi editor for quick edits on remote servers.
examples.zh: 经验丰富的程序员通常更喜欢用 vi 编辑器在远程服务器上快速修改。

lemmas.usage_note: 作罗马数字表示“六”，多用于世纪（the VI century）、章节或君主世系后，一般大写且只作定语。

family_guide.root_logic: 通常为罗马数字缩写或语法缩写；作为词典词头通常标作罗马数字六（即第六的）。

lemmas.def_en: located, suited for, or taking place within a building

examples.en: Bad weather forced the school to move the sports event to the indoor gym.
examples.zh: 恶劣的天气迫使学校将体育赛事移至室内体育馆举行。

lemmas.usage_note: 仅作前置定语修饰名词，如 indoor sports/activities；切勿作表语或状语，表示“在室内”须用 indoors。

family_guide.root_logic: 合成词 in（在内）+ door（门），本义为“门内的”，引申为室内的。

lemmas.def_en: lacking physical depth; having little spatial extension downward or inward from an outer surface or backward or outward from a center

examples.en: Young children should only paddle in the shallow end of the pool.
examples.zh: 幼童只应在游泳池的浅水区戏水。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可指水、坑等物理深度浅，也可引申指人、见解或呼吸肤浅，常见搭配如 shallow water、shallow breathing。

lemmas.def_en: make shallow

examples.en: The coastal waters shallow rapidly as you approach the rocky shoreline.
examples.zh: 随着靠近岩石嶙峋的海岸线，近海水位迅速变浅。

lemmas.usage_note: 较少见的及物或不及物动词，指水域变浅或使水域变浅，常与 out 连用（shallow out）。

lemmas.def_en: lack of depth of knowledge or thought or feeling

examples.en: Critics quickly pointed out the extreme shallowness of the candidate's proposed tax policies.
examples.zh: 批评人士迅速指出了候选人拟议税收政策的极度肤浅。

lemmas.def_en: in a shallow manner
lemmas.def_zh: 浅浅地; 不深地; 肤浅地; 浅薄地

examples.en: Under severe stress, he began breathing shallowly and clutching at his racing chest.
examples.zh: 在极度紧张下，他开始浅浅地呼吸，并紧抓着狂跳的胸口。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语，与 shoal（浅滩）同源，核心指深度不足或见识浮浅。

lemmas.def_en: a cushion to support the head of a sleeping person
lemmas.def_zh: 枕头, 靠垫, 枕状岩

examples.en: She fluffed up her down pillow before settling into bed for the night.
examples.zh: 上床安睡前，她把羽绒枕头拍得蓬松松的。

lemmas.usage_note: 日常指睡觉时垫头的枕头，常见搭配包括 pillow fight（枕头大战）和 pillow talk（枕边悄悄话）。

lemmas.def_en: rest on or as if on a pillow
lemmas.def_zh: 作...的枕头, 垫, 枕于；靠在枕上

examples.en: Tired from the long journey, the child pillowed her head on her mother's lap.
examples.zh: 因长途旅行而疲惫不堪的孩子把头枕在母亲的腿上。

lemmas.usage_note: 文学或具象用法，表示“把头枕在……上”或“垫着”，常与 on 或 against 连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 pulvinus（垫子），指起支撑和缓冲作用的软枕，引申作动词“枕着”。

lemmas.def_en: resist or confront with resistance
lemmas.def_zh: 藐视, 挑衅, 使落空

examples.en: The brave protesters took to the streets to defy the curfew imposed by the regime.
examples.zh: 勇敢的抗议者走上街头，公然违抗政权强加的宵禁令。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，表示公然违抗权威、法令，或某事超出理解范围，常搭 defy authority 或 defy description。

lemmas.def_en: intentionally contemptuous behavior or attitude

examples.en: He folded his arms and held her gaze in clear defiance of her orders.
examples.zh: 他双臂抱胸，直视着她的目光，公然蔑视她的命令。

lemmas.def_en: boldly resisting authority or an opposing force
lemmas.def_zh: 挑衅的, 目中无人的

examples.en: The defiant child crossed his arms and flatly refused to eat his cold dinner.
examples.zh: 那个叛逆的孩子双臂交叉，断然拒绝吃冰凉的晚饭。

lemmas.def_en: in a rebellious manner

examples.en: The brave student stood defiantly before the principal, refusing to betray his close friends.
examples.zh: 那位勇敢的学生挑衅般地站在校长面前，拒绝出卖好友。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 dis-（解除）+ fidere（信任），原指“撕毁誓约、宣战”，演变为公开抗拒或藐视权威、规则。

lemmas.def_en: any of numerous relatively small elongated soft-bodied animals especially of the phyla Annelida and Chaetognatha and Nematoda and Nemertea and Platyhelminthes; also many insect larvae
lemmas.def_zh: 虫, 蠕虫, 小人物, 螺纹, 蜗杆

examples.en: The robin tugged a long earthworm out of the damp soil.
examples.zh: 知更鸟从湿润的泥土中拽出了一条长长的蚯蚓。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指蠕虫或软体小虫，口语中可蔑称小人，也常用于谚语 the early bird catches the worm。

lemmas.def_en: to move in a twisting or contorted motion, (especially when struggling)
lemmas.def_zh: 蠕行, 慢慢前进；使蠕行, 慢慢地走, 除虫

examples.en: He skillfully managed to worm his way into the executive committee.
examples.zh: 他手段老练，想方设法钻营进了执行委员会。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与 one's way into 搭配表示“慢慢钻入/巧妙钻营”，也指给动物驱虫（worm a pet）。

lemmas.def_en: infested with or damaged (as if eaten) by worms
lemmas.def_zh: 有蛀虫的, 虫多的, 虫蛀的

examples.en: He discarded the wormy apples he found beneath the old tree in the orchard.
examples.zh: 他扔掉了在果园老树下捡到的长了虫的苹果。

family_guide.root_logic: 古日耳曼语源，原指蠕虫、蛇或爬虫，动作上引申指像虫子一样缓慢蠕动或暗中钻营。

lemmas.def_en: large slender food and game fish widely distributed in warm seas (especially around Hawaii)

examples.en: A playful dolphin leaped gracefully out of the ocean alongside our small tour boat.
examples.zh: 一只顽皮的海豚在我们的小游船旁优雅地跃出海面。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，注意海豚是哺乳动物而非鱼类；群用 a pod/school of dolphins，常见搭配 dolphin pod。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 delphis（海豚），词根与子宫相关，指这一类具有胎生特性的海洋哺乳动物。

lemmas.def_en: a sudden outburst of anger
lemmas.def_zh: (钢等的)硬度, 脾气, 心情, 中和剂, 倾向, 回火

examples.en: He tried hard to control his temper during the heated debate.
examples.zh: 在激烈的辩论中，他竭力克制自己的脾气。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指脾气或心境，高频搭配有 lose one's temper（发脾气）和 keep one's temper（忍住脾气）。

lemmas.def_en: the trait of avoiding excesses
lemmas.def_zh: 节欲, 戒酒, 禁酒, 节制

examples.en: His doctor strongly advised strict temperance in both eating habits and alcohol consumption.
examples.zh: 他的医生强烈建议他在饮食和饮酒方面都要保持严格节制。

lemmas.def_en: bring to a desired consistency, texture, or hardness by a process of gradually heating and cooling
lemmas.def_zh: 使回火, 锻炼, 调和, 使缓和；回火

examples.en: The experienced judge decided to temper justice with mercy in this rare case.
examples.zh: 这位经验丰富的法官决定在这个罕见的案子中恩威并施、宽大处理。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面语及物动词，指“使缓和、冲淡”，常用于 temper A with B，或工业上指对金属“回火回炼”。

lemmas.def_en: not brought to a proper consistency or hardness
lemmas.def_zh: 未回火的, 没有锻炼的, 未调和好的

examples.en: His speech was fueled by raw, untempered anger that shocked everyone in the audience.
examples.zh: 他的演讲充满了原始且未经克制的愤怒，震惊了全场观众。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 temperare（适度调和、调配），引申指身心情绪的配比平衡（脾气），或使金属通过回火达到最佳软硬度（锤炼）。

lemmas.def_en: a distinctive emotional aura experienced instinctively

examples.en: This cozy little cafe gives off a relaxed vibe with its soft acoustic music.
examples.zh: 这家舒适的小咖啡馆播放着轻柔的原声音乐，给人一种轻松的氛围。

lemmas.usage_note: 极高频口语词，常复数表示氛围或感觉，搭配如 give off good vibes、ruin the vibe，指场所或人的气场。

family_guide.root_logic: 来自 vibration（震动）的截短词，现代口语中借指人或环境散发出的“气场、氛围或感觉”。

lemmas.def_en: the optimistic feeling that all is going to turn out well
lemmas.def_zh: 乐观主义, 乐观, 乐天

examples.en: There is growing optimism about the country's upcoming economic recovery.
examples.zh: 人们对该国即将到来的经济复苏抱有越来越大的乐观态度。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数抽象名词，指对未来的积极态度，常与介词 about 搭配，如 cautious optimism（谨慎乐观）。

lemmas.def_zh: 乐观者, 乐观主义者
lemmas.def_en: a person disposed to take a favorable view of things

examples.en: As an incurable optimist, she always looks for the silver lining in every crisis.
examples.zh: 作为一个无可救药的乐天派，她总能在每次危机中看到积极的一面。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指生性乐观的人，常与介词 by nature 搭配，反义词为 pessimist。

lemmas.def_en: expecting the best in this best of all possible worlds
lemmas.def_zh: 乐观的, 乐观主义的, 乐天的

examples.en: The medical team is cautiously optimistic about the patient's chances of a full recovery.
examples.zh: 医疗团队对这名患者完全康复的前景持谨慎乐观态度。

lemmas.usage_note: 作表语或定语，表示乐观的，常接介词 about，搭配结构为 be optimistic that / about sth。

lemmas.def_en: with optimism; in an optimistic manner

examples.en: She optimistically predicted that the construction project would finish ahead of schedule.
examples.zh: 她乐观地预测这项建筑工程将提前完工。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 optimus（最好），哲学上指“凡事皆趋向最好的状态”，引申为乐观主义。

lemmas.def_en: worthy of notice
lemmas.def_zh: 值得注意的, 显著的

examples.en: The historic town is notable for its well-preserved medieval architecture.
examples.zh: 这座历史名镇因其保存完好的中世纪建筑而闻名。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示值得注意的或著名的，常搭配 notable example、notable achievement，后接介词 for。

lemmas.def_en: a celebrity who is an inspiration to others
lemmas.def_zh: 著名人士, 值得注意之事物

examples.en: Local notables and city officials gathered at the banquet to welcome the foreign diplomats.
examples.zh: 当地名流和市政府官员齐聚宴会，欢迎外国外交官。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，通常用复数 notables，多指社会名流、要人或重要人物，属于正式语体。

lemmas.def_en: a celebrity who is an inspiration to others
lemmas.def_zh: 显著, 著名, 著名人物

examples.en: The young pianist achieved international notability after winning the prestigious global competition.
examples.zh: 这位年轻的钢琴家在赢得声誉卓著的全球竞赛后闻名国际。

family_guide.root_logic: 来自 note（注意）+ -able（能够……的），核心逻辑是“值得被注意、显而易见的”。

lemmas.def_en: characterized by a high degree or intensity; often used as a combining form
lemmas.def_zh: 加强的, 内涵的, 集中的

examples.en: She enrolled in an intensive language course to prepare for her overseas assignment.
examples.zh: 她报名参加了一门高强度语言集训班，以便为外派任务做准备。

lemmas.usage_note: 指短时间内高度集中的、强化的，常见搭配有 intensive care（特护）、intensive training、labor-intensive。

lemmas.def_en: in an intensive manner

examples.en: Researchers have been studying the newly discovered virus intensively for the past few months.
examples.zh: 在过去几个月里，研究人员一直在深入密集地研究这种新发现的病毒。

family_guide.root_logic: 来自 intendere（拉紧、集中注意力），-ive 为形容词后缀，强调力量、时间或资源高度集中和紧绷的状态。

lemmas.def_en: make a solicitation or entreaty for something; request urgently or persistently
lemmas.def_zh: 请求, 乞求, 招揽, 征求

examples.en: The charity went door to door to solicit donations for the flood victims.
examples.zh: 该慈善机构挨家挨户上门为洪水灾民募集捐款。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式用词，指恳切地征求意见、请求捐赠或招揽生意，常搭配 solicit advice/funds from sb。

lemmas.def_en: a petitioner who solicits contributions or trade or votes
lemmas.def_zh: (英)律师, 初级律师, (美)法务官, (美)掮客, 游说者, (美)募捐者

examples.en: She consulted a solicitor to help draft her will and finalize the property sale.
examples.zh: 她咨询了一位事务律师，以协助起草遗嘱并完成房产出售事宜。

lemmas.usage_note: 英式英语中指事务律师（处理诉讼准备及非诉业务）；美式英语中常指法务官或募捐掮客。

lemmas.def_en: an entreaty addressed to someone of superior status
lemmas.def_zh: 恳求, 恳请, 教唆, 诱惑

examples.en: The university strictly prohibits the unauthorized solicitation of commercial business on campus.
examples.zh: 该大学严禁在校园内进行未经授权的商业揽客行为。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 sollicitare（搅动、促动），演变为主动上前央求、请求支持或招徕生意。
family_guide.core_distinction: solicitor 在英国专指“初级事务律师/诉状律师”，在北美则指“募捐者/推销员”。

lemmas.def_en: able to be compared or worthy of comparison
lemmas.def_zh: 可比较的, 比得上的

examples.en: The quality of this domestic brand is directly comparable to imported alternatives.
examples.zh: 这一国产品牌的质量完全可以与进口替代品相提并论。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与 to 或 with 连用，表示在规模、品质等方面相似或可相提并论，多用于正式论述。

lemmas.def_en: such that comparison is impossible; unsuitable for comparison or lacking features that can be compared

examples.en: The natural beauty of the untouched alpine valley remains uncomparable to any other landscape.
examples.zh: 这片原始高山峡谷的自然美景是任何其他景观都无法比拟的。

lemmas.def_en: qualities that are comparable

examples.en: Standardized metrics were implemented to ensure the comparability of experimental data across laboratories.
examples.zh: 实施标准化指标是为了确保各实验室之间实验数据的可比性。

family_guide.root_logic: 来自 compare（比较）+ -able（能……的），指两者性质或体量相近，从而“可以拿来相提并论的”。
family_guide.core_distinction: comparable 强调“可比拟的、类似的”；comparative 强调“相对的、比较而言的（如 comparative study 比较研究）”。

lemmas.def_en: an assistant subject to the authority or control of another
lemmas.def_zh: 子公司, 附件, 辅助者

examples.en: The multinational technology corporation decided to establish a new subsidiary in Southeast Asia.
examples.zh: 这家跨国科技公司决定在东南亚成立一家新的子公司。

lemmas.usage_note: 商业正式用语，指子公司或附属机构，常与 a wholly-owned subsidiary（全资子公司）搭配。

lemmas.def_en: secondary importance
lemmas.def_zh: 权力自主原则, 权力下放原则（允许成员针对影响自身的问题自作主张）

examples.en: The European Union governance model relies heavily on the democratic principle of subsidiarity.
examples.zh: 欧盟的治理模式很大程度上依赖于民主的辅助性原则。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 subsidium（预备队、支援），指提供辅助支持的角色，在现代商业中特指依附于母公司的子公司。

lemmas.def_en: insulting terms of address for people who are stupid or irritating or ridiculous

examples.en: The selfish driver refused to yield the lane, prompting angry shouts from other motorists.
examples.zh: 那个自私的混蛋司机拒绝让道，引发了其他司机的愤怒叫骂。

lemmas.def_en: declaring or rendering bastard

examples.en: Traditionalists heavily criticized the modern film remake for the blatant bastardization of classic literature.
examples.zh: 传统派强烈批评这部现代翻拍电影肆意糟蹋经典文学。

lemmas.def_en: change something so that its value declines; for example, art forms
lemmas.def_zh: vi. 判定/证明...为私生的, 变劣, 变为不纯, 误用语言, 乱用, 使不纯

examples.en: Critics argued that commercial adaptations tend to bastardize the rich subtleties of the original novel.
examples.zh: 批评人士认为，商业改编往往会使原著小说丰富的精妙之处变质劣质化。

lemmas.def_en: born out of wedlock; - E.A.Freeman

examples.en: Selling defective medical equipment to rural clinics was condemned as an utterly bastardly crime.
examples.zh: 向乡村诊所出售有缺陷的医疗设备被谴责为极其卑劣下流的罪行。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语，原指非婚生子（私生子），后在俚语中泛化为对人粗鲁、恶劣的辱骂，或非正式地用作调侃。

lemmas.def_en: a professional performer who tells jokes and performs comical acts

examples.en: The talented stand-up comedian kept the entire audience laughing with his relatable everyday humor.
examples.zh: 这位才华横溢的单口喜剧演员用引起共鸣的日常幽默让全场捧腹大笑。

lemmas.usage_note: 指喜剧演员，常见搭配 a stand-up comedian（脱口秀/单口喜剧演员）；口语中也可指爱开玩笑的逗比。

family_guide.root_logic: 来自 comedy（喜剧）+ -ian（人），专门指以幽默风趣逗人发笑为职业的人。

lemmas.def_en: beat thoroughly and conclusively in a competition or fight
lemmas.def_zh: 舔, 卷过, 鞭打；轻轻拍打

examples.en: The friendly golden retriever ran over to lick my hand as I arrived home.
examples.zh: 当我回到家时，那只友好的金毛寻回犬跑过来舔了舔我的手。

lemmas.usage_note: 本义为舔，口语习语极多，如 lick one's wounds（休养生息）、lick sb's boots（谄媚讨好）。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声/印欧词源，模拟舌头触碰并滑过物体表面的动作，亦借指火苗或波浪轻轻掠过。

lemmas.def_en: forsake

examples.en: The workers were instructed to ditch along the perimeter of the field to prevent waterlogging.
examples.zh: 工人们接到指示，在田地周边开沟以防止积水成涝。

lemmas.usage_note: 本义指在土地上开沟排水；非正式口语中极高频，意为果断丢弃、摆脱或甩掉某人某物。

lemmas.def_en: a long narrow excavation in the earth

examples.en: The car veered off the icy highway and ended up in a deep roadside ditch.
examples.zh: 汽车在结冰的公路上偏离方向，最终陷进了路边深沟里。

lemmas.usage_note: 具体名词，指田间、路旁用于排水或灌溉的长沟，常与 dig、drainage 搭配使用。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语意为“挖出的水渠”，引申为倾倒废弃物之处，后作动词表“丢弃”。

lemmas.def_en: the face of a timepiece; graduated to show the hours
lemmas.def_zh: 刻度盘, 钟面, 转盘

examples.en: The dial on the pressure gauge indicated that the tank was almost empty.
examples.zh: 压力表上的刻度盘显示储罐几乎已经见底了。

lemmas.usage_note: 指钟表盘、仪表盘或收音机等设备的调节转盘，常见搭配有 instrument dial 和 clock dial。

lemmas.def_en: operate a dial to select a telephone number

examples.en: She panicked and could barely steady her fingers to dial the emergency services.
examples.zh: 她惊慌失措，手指颤抖得几乎无法拨通紧急求助电话。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物或不及物动词，指拨打电话号码，常用于 dial a number 或 dial 911 等应急语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自中世纪拉丁语“每日的”，最初指日晷刻度盘，后泛指仪表盘及拨号盘，并转为动词“拨号”。

lemmas.def_en: deprive of freedom; take into confinement
lemmas.def_zh: 扣留, 扣押, 耽搁

examples.en: Customs officers decided to detain the suspect for further questioning at the airport.
examples.zh: 海关人员决定在机场拘留该嫌疑人以作进一步审讯。

lemmas.usage_note: 司法语境指拘留、扣押；日常正式语境指因突发情况耽搁、延误某人，常用于被动语态。

lemmas.def_en: a state of being confined (usually for a short time)
lemmas.def_zh: 阻止, 监禁, 拘留

examples.en: The activist was held in prolonged detention without access to legal representation.
examples.zh: 该维权人士遭到长期拘留，且无法获得法律代理协助。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数或可数名词，指官方拘留监禁；在校园语境中专指对违纪学生的“放学后留校惩罚”。

lemmas.def_en: some held in custody
lemmas.def_zh: 被拘留者, 被扣押者

examples.en: Each detainee was granted the right to speak with a lawyer.
examples.zh: 每位被拘留者都有权与律师沟通。

lemmas.def_en: a state of being confined (usually for a short time)

examples.en: His unexpected detainment at the airport caused him to miss the flight.
examples.zh: 他在机场意外被扣留导致他错过了航班。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀de-（向下、离开）+ 词根tain（握住、保持），核心义为“强行留住阻止前行”。

lemmas.def_en: contrary to your interests or welfare
lemmas.def_zh: 不利的, 敌对的, 相反的, 逆的

examples.en: The clinical trial was suspended after patients reported serious adverse reactions to the drug.
examples.zh: 在患者报告对该药物出现严重不良反应后，临床试验被暂停。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面正式用词，形容条件或影响消极不利，高频搭配 adverse effects、adverse weather 条件。

lemmas.def_en: a state of misfortune or affliction
lemmas.def_zh: 逆境, 不幸, 灾祸, 灾难

examples.en: She showed remarkable courage and resilience in the face of great adversity.
examples.zh: 面对巨大的逆境，她表现出了非凡的勇气和韧性。

lemmas.def_en: in an adverse manner
lemmas.def_zh: 不利, 有害, 相反, 逆, 敌对, 逆向

examples.en: High inflation has adversely affected the purchasing power of average households.
examples.zh: 高通胀对普通家庭的购买力产生了不利影响。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀ad-（朝向）+ verse（转向），字面为“反向对着”，引申为“不利的、相反的”。

lemmas.def_en: the male organ of copulation (`member' is a euphemism)

examples.en: The anatomical chart accurately illustrated the vascular structure of the mammalian penis.
examples.zh: 该解剖图准确展示了哺乳动物阴茎的血管结构。

lemmas.usage_note: 解剖学与医学领域的正规严肃名词，指男性或雄性动物的生殖器官，非粗俗俚语。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to the penis

examples.en: The surgeon treated the rare penial disorder with a specialized procedure.
examples.zh: 外科医生通过特殊手术治疗了这种罕见的阴茎疾病。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语penis，原义为“尾巴”，在解剖学中借指男性外生殖器。

lemmas.def_en: lacking in energy or will; - George Meredith
lemmas.def_zh: 消极的, 被动的, 冷漠的, 顺从的, 无源的

examples.en: Rather than taking initiative, he adopted a completely passive stance during the negotiations.
examples.zh: 在谈判期间，他非但没有采取主动，反而采取了彻底被动的态度。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容态度被动、顺从，常搭配 passive role；亦用于专业领域如 passive smoking（二手烟）或被动语态。

lemmas.def_en: in a passive manner
lemmas.def_zh: (贬)被动, 守势, 受动, (贬)消极, 不抵抗, 驯服, 钝性, 无源, 钝态, 无利息

examples.en: She refused to passively accept the unfair treatment from her manager.
examples.zh: 她拒绝被动接受经理的不公正对待。

lemmas.def_en: the trait of remaining inactive; a lack of initiative
lemmas.def_zh: 被动, 被动性, 无抵抗, 钝性, 被动结构

examples.en: His total passivity in times of crisis frustrated all his teammates.
examples.zh: 他在危机时刻的彻底被动让所有队友感到沮丧。

lemmas.def_en: submission to others or to outside influences
lemmas.def_zh: 被动, 顺从; 被动性

examples.en: The teacher noticed the boy's passiveness during group discussions in class.
examples.zh: 老师注意到了那个男孩在课堂小组讨论中的被动态度。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语passivus（承受的、经受苦难的），引申为“被动的、消极接纳的”。

lemmas.def_en: group of people related by blood or marriage
lemmas.def_zh: 氏族, 宗族, 集团

examples.en: The entire clan gathered annually to celebrate their long family heritage.
examples.zh: 整个宗族每年都会聚集在一起庆祝他们悠久的家族传统。

lemmas.usage_note: 原指有血缘关系的氏族、家族，现常引申为关系紧密的庞大群体，如 family clan、political clan。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自盖尔语clann（后裔、子女），指具有共同祖先的宗族，引申为利益集团。

lemmas.def_en: a humble request for help from someone in authority
lemmas.def_zh: 恳求, 辩解, 抗辩, 诉讼, 请愿, 托词

examples.en: The charity made an urgent plea for donations after the earthquake.
examples.zh: 地震发生后，该慈善机构紧急呼吁捐款。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式用语，法庭上常与 enter/make a plea of guilty/not guilty 连用；生活中常作恳求 a plea for help。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语，经拉丁语placitum（合意、裁决）演变而来，指法庭上的诉求，引申为“恳求、托词”。

lemmas.def_en: formed of separate units gathered into a mass or whole

examples.en: The aggregate turnover of the group exceeded expectations despite market headwinds.
examples.zh: 尽管面临市场逆风，该集团的总营业额依然超出了预期。

lemmas.usage_note: 经济、统计与学术界专用，作定语修饰名词，表示“总计的、汇集的”，如 aggregate demand。

lemmas.def_en: formed of separate units gathered into a mass or whole
lemmas.def_zh: 集合的, 聚集的, 作为整体的

examples.en: The report used an aggregative index to evaluate national economic health.
examples.zh: 该报告使用集合指标来评估国家的经济健康状况。

lemmas.def_en: amount in the aggregate to
lemmas.def_zh: 聚集, 集合, 合计达

examples.en: The software is designed to aggregate consumer feedback from multiple social media platforms.
examples.zh: 该软件旨在从多个社交媒体平台汇总消费者的反馈意见。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式用词，可作及物或不及物动词，指数据、资金或事物聚集、汇总，常与 into 连用。

lemmas.def_en: a person who collects things
lemmas.def_zh: 聚合器, 整合者; 汇集者, 聚合

examples.en: This news aggregator pulls headlines from several major media outlets daily.
examples.zh: 这个新闻聚合器每天从数家主流媒体抓取头条新闻。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀ad-（向）+ greg-（羊群），意为“聚集成群”，引申为总体、合计。

lemmas.def_en: the power or capacity of an organism to tolerate unfavorable environmental conditions
lemmas.def_zh: 宽容, 忍受, 容忍, 容许量, 公差

examples.en: The community promotes mutual respect and zero tolerance for discrimination of any kind.
examples.zh: 该社区提倡相互尊重，对任何形式的歧视都采取零容忍态度。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与介词 toward 或 of 连用表示包容心；在医学或技术语境中常指耐受力或机械公差。

lemmas.def_en: a disposition to tolerate or accept people or situations
lemmas.def_zh: 宽容, 默认, 信仰自由

examples.en: The government promoted religious toleration to maintain peace among different cultural communities.
examples.zh: 政府提倡宗教宽容，以维持不同文化群体间的和平。

lemmas.def_en: put up with something or somebody unpleasant

examples.en: The school administration will not tolerate bullying under any circumstances.
examples.zh: 学校管理层在任何情况下都不会容忍霸凌行为。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，后接名词或动名词形式，表示在艰难环境中勉强忍受或允许某事存在。

lemmas.def_zh: 宽容的, 容忍的, (对冷、热)能耐的
lemmas.def_en: showing respect for the rights or opinions or practices of others

examples.en: They are remarkably tolerant of differing cultural and religious practices.
examples.zh: 他们对不同的文化习俗和宗教信仰表现出了极大的包容。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用搭配为 be tolerant of，用于修饰对异见保持包容的态度，也可指植物等耐受性强。

lemmas.def_en: in a tolerant manner

examples.en: he reacts rather tolerantly toward his son's juvenile behavior

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语tolerare（忍受、承受），后缀-ance表性质，指容忍力或机件公差。

lemmas.def_en: showing regard for others in manners, speech, behavior, etc.
lemmas.def_zh: 有礼貌的, 文雅的, 客气的, 有教养的

examples.en: It is always polite to send a brief thank-you note after attending an interview.
examples.zh: 参加面试后寄一封简短的感谢信始终是合乎礼貌的做法。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用搭配为 be polite to sb.，常修饰言行、微笑或社交礼仪，表达客气但有时带疏离感。

lemmas.def_en: in a polite manner
lemmas.def_zh: 有礼貌地, 文雅地, 客气地

examples.en: He politely asked the passengers to step aside for the elderly.
examples.zh: 他礼貌地请乘客们给老年人让出一条路。

lemmas.def_en: a courteous manner that respects accepted social usage

examples.en: His natural politeness made everyone feel comfortable and respected in meetings.
examples.zh: 他天生的礼貌让每个人在会议中都感到舒适和受尊重。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语politus（磨光的、打磨光滑的），引申指人“有教养的、举止得体的”。

lemmas.def_en: intense sorrow caused by loss of a loved one (especially by death)
lemmas.def_zh: 伤心, 忧愁, 悲痛, 不幸, 灾难

examples.en: The sudden tragedy brought immense grief to the entire local community.
examples.zh: 这场突如其来的悲剧给整个当地社区带来了巨大的悲痛。

lemmas.usage_note: 指深切悲痛，常与 over/at 搭配，如 overcome with grief；口语俚语 give sb grief 意为使某人烦恼受累。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语，追溯至拉丁语gravis（沉重的），指心中承受不可承受的“深切悲痛”。

lemmas.def_en: cause fear in

examples.en: The loud clap of thunder did frighten the little girl so much that she started crying.
examples.zh: 那声巨响的雷鸣着实吓坏了那个小女孩，以至于她哭了起来。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用作及物动词表示惊吓某人，常见搭配为 frighten sb. into doing sth. 或 frighten sb. away。

lemmas.def_en: in an alarming manner
lemmas.def_zh: 吓人地; 令人恐惧地, 引起突然惊恐地

examples.en: The global temperature is rising at a frighteningly rapid pace each decade.
examples.zh: 全球气温正以惊人的速度逐年攀升。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 令人恐惧的；可怕的
lemmas.def_en: making you feel afraid or nervous
lemmas.usage_note: 主语通常是事物、经历或景象，表示具有威慑或惊吓性质；区别于修饰人感受的 frightened。

examples.en: It was a frightening experience that nobody in the village will ever forget.
examples.zh: 那是一次村里无人能忘却的可怕经历。

family_guide.root_logic: 名词fright（惊恐）+ 动词后缀-en（使成为），意为“使惊恐、吓唬”。

lemmas.def_en: the starting point for a new state or experience
lemmas.def_zh: 门槛, 入口, 开端, 阈

examples.en: She stood at the threshold of the house, hesitating before entering.
examples.zh: 她站在门槛前，犹豫着要不要进去。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于 on the threshold of（即将迎来/在…门槛上）或 high/low pain threshold，多用于书面语表达临界点。

family_guide.root_logic: 古英语复合词，原指进门前用于踏碎或脱去谷物杂物的门槛，引申为极限或起始点。

lemmas.def_en: register formally as a participant or member

examples.en: She decided to enroll in an advanced web development course this semester.
examples.zh: 她决定本学期报名参加一门高级网页开发课程。

lemmas.usage_note: 可作及物或不及物动词，不及物时常接介词 in；及物时表示招收或为某人登记入籍。

lemmas.def_en: register formally as a participant or member
lemmas.def_zh: 登记, 使加入；参军, 注册

examples.en: You need to enrol in the online course before the end of this week.
examples.zh: 你需要在本周末之前注册这门在线课程。

lemmas.def_en: the act of enrolling
lemmas.def_zh: 登记, 注册, 入伍

examples.en: School enrollment has increased steadily over the past three academic years.
examples.zh: 在过去的三个学年里，学校的入学人数稳步增长。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指入学者人数或注册登记的程序，常见搭配有 open enrollment 或 enrollment rate。

lemmas.def_en: the act of enrolling
lemmas.def_zh: 登记, 注册, 入伍, 入学, 入会, 注册人数, 入学人数

examples.en: The university reported a significant increase in student enrolment this semester.
examples.zh: 该大学报告称，本学期的学生注册人数显著增加。

lemmas.def_en: a person who enrolls in (or is enrolled in) a class or course of study
lemmas.def_zh: 被征入伍者, 入会者, 入学者

examples.en: Each new enrollee must complete a brief orientation session before classes begin.
examples.zh: 每位新入学者在开学前都必须参加一次简短的培训。

family_guide.root_logic: en-（进入）+ roll（名册），本义为“记入名册”，引申为登记、入学。

lemmas.def_en: a republic in southern South America on the western slopes of the Andes on the south Pacific coast

examples.en: Add a pinch of dried chile to give the sauce a spicy kick.
examples.zh: 加一小撮干辣椒碎，让酱汁带点辛辣的风味。

lemmas.usage_note: 美式英语常用于指辣椒或辣椒酱（同 chili/chilli），作为不可数或可数名词使用，首字母大写时特指国家智利。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自美洲原住民语言，指辣椒或辣椒制成的调味品（亦作 chili/chilli）。

lemmas.def_en: chew (food); to bite and grind with the teeth

examples.en: Take time to chew your food thoroughly before swallowing it.
examples.zh: 吞咽之前要花时间把食物彻底嚼碎。

lemmas.usage_note: 既指生理上的咀嚼（搭配 over 或 on），也可在短语 chew over 中比喻仔细考虑、推敲问题。

lemmas.def_en: requiring much chewing
lemmas.def_zh: 需要多嚼的, 难嚼的

examples.en: I prefer fresh homemade cookies that are soft and chewy in the center.
examples.zh: 我更喜欢中间松软且有嚼劲的新鲜自制曲奇。

lemmas.def_en: someone who chews (especially someone who chews tobacco)
lemmas.def_zh: 反刍动物；咀嚼口香糖的人

examples.en: As an avid gum chewer, he always keeps a fresh pack nearby.
examples.zh: 作为一个口香糖爱好者，他身边总备着一包新的。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 ceowan，模拟上下颌咬碎食物的动作，引申指深思、咀嚼。

lemmas.def_en: the time in the evening at which the sun begins to fall below the horizon

examples.en: They watched the spectacular sunset over the calm sea.
examples.zh: 他们注视着平静海面上那壮丽的日落景象。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作 at sunset（在日落时）；在法律和商业中常作定语，如 sunset clause/provision 指失效/日落条款。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 sun（太阳）+ set（下落）构成的复合词，指日落时分。

lemmas.def_en: bright and pleasant; promoting a feeling of cheer

examples.en: Her sunny disposition always brings cheer to the office.
examples.zh: 她开朗的性格总能给办公室带来欢乐。

lemmas.usage_note: 除形容天气晴朗外，常修饰人或性格，如 a sunny disposition/smile（开朗的性格/灿烂的微笑）。

lemmas.def_zh: (sunny 的复数) a. 阳光充足的, 乐观的, 快乐的, 像太阳的

examples.en: Don't forget to grab your sunnies before heading out to the beach.
examples.zh: 去海滩前，别忘了拿上你的太阳镜。

family_guide.root_logic: sun（太阳）+ -y（多……的形容词后缀），指阳光明媚的或性格开朗的。

lemmas.def_en: a rude or vulgar fool
lemmas.def_zh: n. 小丑，丑角；v. 扮小丑，耍闹

examples.en: The circus clown made all the children burst into laughter with his funny antics.
examples.zh: 马戏团的小丑用滑稽的动作逗得所有孩子们哈哈大笑。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，指马戏团等表演中的小丑，也用于比喻举止荒唐可笑或引人发笑的人。

lemmas.def_en: act as or like a clown
lemmas.def_zh: n. 小丑，丑角；v. 扮小丑，耍闹

examples.en: Stop clowning around and focus on finishing your assignment properly.
examples.zh: 别胡闹了，专心把你的作业好好完成。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物动词，极常以短语 clown around 出现，口语中指胡闹、打闹或插科打诨。

family_guide.root_logic: 词源可能与粗笨的原木或农夫有关，后定型为剧场或马戏团中滑稽扮相的丑角。

lemmas.def_en: conformable to or allowed by law

examples.en: He had a lawful excuse for his absence from the court hearing.
examples.zh: 他缺席法庭听证会有正当且合法的理由。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用于法律公文与正式文体，修饰权利、行为或权威，常与 lawful authority 等搭配。

lemmas.def_en: not conforming to legality, moral law, or social convention

examples.en: The security guards detained the intruder for unlawful entry into the building.
examples.zh: 保安人员因该入侵者非法进入大楼而将其拘留。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式法律术语，严格指违反法律或未经法律许可的，常搭配 unlawful entry 或 unlawful act。

lemmas.def_en: in a manner acceptable to common custom

examples.en: All citizens must act lawfully and respect the regulations set by the council.
examples.zh: 所有公民都必须依法行事，并遵守委员会制定的规章。

lemmas.def_en: not conforming to the law

examples.en: The suspect was accused of unlawfully entering the private property late at night.
examples.zh: 嫌疑人被指控在深夜非法闯入私人领地。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of conforming to law

examples.en: The judge questioned the lawfulness of the evidence obtained without a valid warrant.
examples.zh: 法官对没有合法搜查令而获得的证据的合法性提出了质疑。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of failing to conform to law
lemmas.def_zh: [法] 不合法, 非法, 违反道德准则

examples.en: The company faced severe penalties due to the clear unlawfulness of their financial actions.
examples.zh: 由于其财务行为明显违法，该公司面临严厉的处罚。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自 law（法律）+ -ful（具……特性的），核心义为符合法律规定的。
family_guide.core_distinction: lawful 强调受法律认可或允许；unlawful 则明确指违反法律规定的行为。

lemmas.def_en: have a tendency or disposition to do or be something; be inclined

examples.en: The recent evidence inclines me to believe that their proposal is feasible.
examples.zh: 最近的证据使我倾向于相信他们的提议是可行的。

lemmas.usage_note: 常以被动形式 be inclined to do 表示倾向于；作及物动词时可表示低头或倾斜身体。

lemmas.def_en: an attitude of mind especially one that favors one alternative over others
lemmas.def_zh: 倾向, 趋向, 倾斜度, 点头

examples.en: She showed an early inclination toward music and began playing the piano gracefully.
examples.zh: 她很早就表现出对音乐的偏好，并弹得一手好钢琴。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 倾向于……的；倾斜的；有天赋的
lemmas.def_en: wanting to do something or having a natural tendency or preference; leaning or sloping
lemmas.usage_note: 常见结构为 be inclined to do sth（倾向于做某事），亦可用在复合词中如 mathematically inclined（有数学天赋的）。

examples.en: I am inclined to agree with your analysis of the market.
examples.zh: 我倾向于赞同你对市场的分析。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 in-（向……）+ cline（倾斜），引申为倾向于某种想法或行动。

lemmas.def_en: (astrology) one of 12 equal areas into which the zodiac is divided

examples.en: The billionaire bought a historic mansion on the coast.
examples.zh: 那位亿万富翁在海边买下了一栋历史悠久的豪宅。

lemmas.usage_note: 指极其宽敞豪华的独立大宅邸，英式英语复数 a block of mansions 可指高档豪华公寓楼。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 manere（停留、居住），原指停留之所，后特指规模宏大的豪华宅邸。

lemmas.def_en: a heavy, closely woven fabric (used for clothing or chairs or sails or tents)
lemmas.def_zh: n. 帆布，画布；v. 游说，详细检查

examples.en: The artist applied thick layers of vibrant oil paint to the canvas.
examples.zh: 这位艺术家在画布上涂抹了厚厚的一层鲜艳油彩。

lemmas.usage_note: 作不可数名词指帆布材质，作可数名词常指油画布或油画作品本身，文体中立。

lemmas.def_en: a petitioner who solicits contributions or trade or votes
lemmas.def_zh: 游说者, 检票员, 兜揽生意的人

examples.en: A political canvasser knocked on our front door to discuss the upcoming election.
examples.zh: 一位政治拉票员敲响了我家前门，想讨论即将举行的选举。

lemmas.def_en: solicit votes from potential voters in an electoral campaign
lemmas.def_zh: n. 帆布，画布；v. 游说，详细检查

examples.en: Volunteers will canvas the entire neighborhood to collect public opinions tomorrow.
examples.zh: 志愿者们明天将走访整个街区以收集公众意见。

lemmas.usage_note: 作动词时意同 canvass，指在某地区游说拉票、走访调查民意或彻底排查讨论。

lemmas.def_en: get the opinions (of people) by asking specific questions
lemmas.def_zh: 彻底检查, 向...拉票或拉生意, 讨论；游说

examples.en: Volunteers plan to canvass the neighborhood to raise support for the new library.
examples.zh: 志愿者们计划在社区挨家挨户游说，以争取对新图书馆的支持。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 kannabis（大麻），由大麻纤维织成的粗布，引申为画布，作动词时衍生出彻底检查、拉选票之意（源于用粗布筛查）。

lemmas.def_en: a profession of belief

examples.en: The company's sustained profitability is a testament to its innovative strategy.
examples.zh: 该公司持续的盈利能力是其创新战略的有力证明。

lemmas.usage_note: 最常构成搭配 a testament to sth.，指某事物的明证；在法律语境中指最后的遗嘱。

lemmas.def_zh: 遗嘱的, 据遗嘱的, 遗嘱中有的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to a will or testament or bequeathed by a will or testament

examples.en: The lawyer meticulously reviewed every testamentary disposition mentioned in the elderly billionaire's final will.
examples.zh: 律师仔细审查了那位年迈亿万富翁最终遗嘱中提到的每一项遗嘱处分。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 testis（证人），指证实意愿的文件，引申为遗嘱或坚定的证明。

lemmas.def_en: lessen the strength of

examples.en: High inflation has weakened consumer spending power.
examples.zh: 高通胀削弱了消费者的消费能力。

lemmas.usage_note: 可用作及物或不及物动词，常与 resolve、economy 或 immune system 搭配，表示削弱力量、决心或体质。

family_guide.root_logic: weak（虚弱的）+ -en（使动后缀），字面即“使变弱”。

lemmas.def_en: a military campaign designed to achieve a specific objective in a foreign country

examples.en: The research team mounted a scientific expedition to Antarctica to study ice sheet dynamics.
examples.zh: 研究小组组织了一次前往南极洲的科学考察，以研究冰盖的动态变化。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指有组织、有明确科学或探险目的的长途考察，常见搭配为 embark on / mount an expedition。

lemmas.def_zh: 远征的, 考察的, 探险的
lemmas.def_en: (used of military forces) designed for military operations abroad

examples.en: The general organized an expeditionary force to secure the remote mountain border.
examples.zh: 将军组建了一支远征军以保卫偏远的山区边界。

lemmas.def_en: marked by speed and efficiency

examples.en: The company promised an expeditious review of all pending customer service complaints.
examples.zh: 公司承诺对所有待处理的客户投诉进行迅速审查。

lemmas.def_zh: 迅速(完成), 高效, 效率高, 敏捷, 急速(进行)
lemmas.def_en: with efficiency; in an efficient manner

examples.en: he functions efficiently

family_guide.root_logic: ex-（出）+ ped（脚）+ -ition（名词后缀），原指整装出发，后指有特定目的的远征或探险。

lemmas.def_en: a son of your brother or sister

examples.en: She took her young nephew to the natural history museum.
examples.zh: 她带着小侄子去了自然历史博物馆。

lemmas.usage_note: 指兄弟姐妹的儿子（侄子或外甥），注意与 niece（侄女/外甥女）区分，属日常亲属称谓词。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 nepos（孙子、侄子），现专指兄弟姐妹的儿子。

lemmas.def_en: someone who promotes or exchanges goods or services for money

examples.en: The company decided to negotiate contract renewal terms with its primary cloud software vendor.
examples.zh: 公司决定与其主要的云软件供应商协商合同续约条款。

lemmas.usage_note: 指沿街叫卖的小贩或商业活动中的卖方，常与 street vendor、software vendor 连用，多见于商务与日常语境。

lemmas.def_zh: 小贩, 卖主, 自动售货机
lemmas.def_en: someone who promotes or exchanges goods or services for money
sell or offer for sale from place to place

examples.en: Several local merchants vend fresh fruits along the busy sidewalk daily.
examples.zh: 几位本地商贩每天都在繁忙的人行道旁售卖新鲜水果。

family_guide.root_logic: vend（出售，源自拉丁语 vendere）+ -or（人/物），特指卖主或自动售货机等供应主体。

lemmas.def_en: a habitual or characteristic mental attitude that determines how you will interpret and respond to situations

examples.en: Despite the current crisis, the economic outlook remains positive.
examples.zh: 尽管面临当前的危机，经济前景依然乐观。

lemmas.usage_note: 指人生观时常搭配 outlook on life；指前景时接 for（如 economic outlook for next year）。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 out（向外）+ look（看）构成，核心意象为“向外看”，引申为前景或世界观。

lemmas.def_en: inferior in rank or status
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 琐碎的；小气的，心胸狭窄的

examples.en: We should not waste valuable office hours on petty squabbles over desk assignments.
examples.zh: 我们不应把宝贵的工作时间浪费在争夺办公桌分配这种琐碎的争执上。

lemmas.usage_note: 含贬义，修饰琐碎微不足道的事物或小气狭隘的性格，常见搭配有 petty squabble、petty crime。

lemmas.def_en: narrowness of mind or ideas or views
lemmas.def_zh: 琐碎, 微小, 小气, 委琐, 偏狭, 卑鄙, 心胸狭窄的举动

examples.en: Try to ignore office pettiness and focus on your long-term career goals.
examples.zh: 尽量忽略办公室里的琐碎琐事，专注于你的长期职业目标。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 petit（小的），指细微、无关紧要的，常带贬义。

lemmas.def_en: cause to suffer a blight

examples.en: Financial difficulties continued to plague the company for months.
examples.zh: 财务困难持续困扰了这家公司数月。

lemmas.usage_note: 作动词多用于被动语态 be plagued by/with，表示长期饱受疾病、贫困或问题的折磨与困扰。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 plaga（打击、灾祸），名词指瘟疫，动词引申为像瘟疫一样长期困扰。

lemmas.def_en: cause annoyance in; disturb, especially by minor irritations
lemmas.def_zh: v. 使烦躁；激怒；刺激（身体部位）

examples.en: The harsh chemicals in the detergent began to irritate her sensitive skin after prolonged exposure.
examples.zh: 长时间接触后，洗涤剂中的刺激性化学物质开始刺激她敏感的皮肤。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，既可表示使人心烦恼怒，也可表示生理上刺激皮肤或黏膜，多与 be irritated by 连用。

lemmas.def_en: the psychological state of being irritated or annoyed
lemmas.def_zh: 刺激, 烦恼, 刺激物

examples.en: He tried to hide his irritation when the train was delayed again.
examples.zh: 当火车再次晚点时，他努力掩饰自己的烦躁。

lemmas.def_en: something that causes irritation and annoyance

examples.en: Chemical fumes in the factory acted as a severe respiratory irritant.
examples.zh: 工厂里的化学烟雾是对呼吸道的严重刺激物。

lemmas.def_en: in an irritating manner

examples.en: The computer screen kept flickering irritatingly while I was trying to work.
examples.zh: 当我试图工作时，电脑屏幕恼人地闪烁个不停。

lemmas.def_en: (used of physical stimuli) serving to stimulate or excite

examples.en: Inhaling the chemical fumes caused an immediate irritative cough among the factory workers.
examples.zh: 吸入化学烟雾导致工厂工人们立刻引发了刺激性咳嗽。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 irritare（激怒、刺激），指使情绪烦躁或使身体器官产生不适反应。

lemmas.def_en: the act of orienting
lemmas.def_zh: n. 方向；取向；（新员工或新生的）迎新培训

examples.en: All new employees must attend a mandatory orientation next Monday.
examples.zh: 所有新员工都必须参加下周一的必修迎新培训。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指新生或新员工的“迎新/岗前培训”（orientation week），也表示方向定位或性取向。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自 orient（朝向东方，定位），引申为方向、目标取向以及适应新环境的培训。

lemmas.def_en: (psychiatry) an abnormal absorption with the self; marked by communication disorders and short attention span and inability to treat others as people

examples.en: Early intervention can significantly improve language and social outcomes for children diagnosed with autism.
examples.zh: 早期干预可以显著改善被确诊患有自闭症的儿童的语言和社交能力。

lemmas.usage_note: 医学与心理学专有名词，指自闭症谱系障碍，常与 diagnosed with、autism spectrum 连用，为正式客观用语。

lemmas.def_en: characteristic of or affected with autism
lemmas.def_zh: [医] 孤独的, 自我中心的

examples.en: The specialized school offers tailored support programs for autistic children and their families.
examples.zh: 这所专科学校为自闭症儿童及其家庭提供定制的支持项目。

family_guide.root_logic: 由词根 aut-（自己）+ -ism（病态/状态）构成，字面意为“沉浸在自我中”，即孤独症。

lemmas.def_en: a sudden violent spontaneous occurrence (usually of some undesirable condition)
lemmas.def_zh: n. （暴力、疾病等的）爆发，突然发生

examples.en: Health officials are working to contain the outbreak of the virus.
examples.zh: 卫生官员正努力控制该病毒的爆发。

lemmas.usage_note: 指疾病、战争或暴力冲突的突然爆发，常用搭配为 an outbreak of flu/violence/war。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 out（向外）+ break（爆发），指疾病、战争或暴力等突发性爆发。

lemmas.def_en: a reference book containing an alphabetical list of words with information about them

examples.en: If you come across an unfamiliar word, look it up in the dictionary.
examples.zh: 如果你遇到不认识的词，就查词典吧。

lemmas.usage_note: “查字典”地道表达为 look up a word in the dictionary 或 consult a dictionary，避免直译 check。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 dictionarium，词根 dict（说，词）+ -ary（集合场所），即词汇的汇编工具书。

lemmas.def_en: make stable and keep from fluctuating or put into an equilibrium

examples.en: Emergency measures were promptly introduced by the central bank to stabilize the volatile financial market.
examples.zh: 央行迅速采取了紧急措施，以稳定动荡的金融市场。

lemmas.usage_note: 可作及物或不及物动词，用于经济、病情或局势等恢复平稳，常见搭配为 stabilize the market/economy。

lemmas.def_en: the act of stabilizing something or making it more stable
lemmas.def_zh: 安定, 稳定, 平抑, 安定化, 稳定化

examples.en: Doctors worked overnight to achieve the stabilization of the injured patient's vital signs.
examples.zh: 医生们彻夜工作以维持受伤患者生命体征的稳定。

lemmas.def_en: a chemical that is added to a solution or mixture or suspension to maintain it in a stable or unchanging state
lemmas.def_zh: 有安定作用之物, 安定装置, 水平安定面

examples.en: The heavy camera needs an external stabilizer to capture smooth video footage.
examples.zh: 这部沉重的摄像机需要一个外接稳定器来拍摄平稳的视频素材。

lemmas.def_en: a device for making something stable
lemmas.def_zh: 稳定器, 安定器, 安定剂

examples.en: This dairy product contains a natural stabiliser to improve its overall texture.
examples.zh: 该乳制品含有一种天然稳定剂，以改善其整体质感。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自 stable（稳定的）+ -ize（使动后缀），核心意为“使……稳固”。

lemmas.def_en: extremely small in scale or scope or capability
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 极小的，微观的；微型的

examples.en: The company specializes in micro electronic components for smartphones.
examples.zh: 该公司专营用于智能手机的微型电子元件。

lemmas.usage_note: 指极微小或微观层面的，常与 macro 相对，修饰 micro scale/level 等抽象分析语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 mikros（微小），表示微观层面的或极小规模的。

lemmas.def_en: a person with fair skin and hair

examples.en: The tall blonde sitting in the corner is our new marketing manager.
examples.zh: 坐在角落里的那位高个子金发女郎是我们的新营销经理。

lemmas.usage_note: 指金发女性（男性通常写作 blond）；在当代英语中使用名词指代人需注意避免刻板印象。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语，特指浅黄色、金黄色的头发，作名词常指金发女性。

lemmas.def_en: a grand and imposing entrance (often extended metaphorically)
lemmas.def_zh: n. 大门，入口；门户网站

examples.en: Students can check their exam results through the school portal.
examples.zh: 学生可以通过学校的门户网站查询考试成绩。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指宏伟的拱门大门，现多用于互联网领域表示“门户网站/入口”（如 web/client portal）。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 porta（大门），引申为宏伟的入口，现代常引申为网络入口或门户网站。

lemmas.def_en: on the lower or downward side; on the underside of

examples.en: I found the missing keys underneath the sofa cushion.
examples.zh: 我在沙发垫子底下找到了丢失的钥匙。

lemmas.usage_note: 强调处于正下方且多被覆盖或隐藏，比 under 更具画面感，常接名词作宾语表位置或内心情感。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 under（在……下）+ neath（下方）强化构成，强调正下方或表面被遮盖的位置。

lemmas.def_en: an act of traveling by water
lemmas.def_zh: 航行, 航海, 航程, 旅行, 航空

examples.en: The luxury ocean liner completed its historic maiden voyage across the Atlantic without incident.
examples.zh: 这艘豪华远洋邮轮平安完成了横跨大西洋的历史性处女航。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指漫长而遥远的水上或太空航程，具文学色彩，高频搭配为 maiden voyage（首航）或 set out on a voyage。

lemmas.def_en: a traveler to a distant land (especially one who travels by sea)

examples.en: The lone voyager documented every milestone of his journey across the frozen desert.
examples.zh: 这位孤独的旅行者记录了他穿越冰冻荒漠旅程中的每一个里程碑。

lemmas.def_en: travel on water propelled by wind or by other means
lemmas.def_zh: 航海, 航行；航行越过, 飞过

examples.en: Centuries ago, courageous explorers voyaged across uncharted waters in search of new trading routes.
examples.zh: 几个世纪前，勇敢的探险家们漂洋过海穿越未知的海域，以寻找新的贸易路线。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式或文学书面语动词，意为长途航行或穿越，后常接介词 across, through 或 into。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 viaticum（旅费、行装），核心语义为‘长途旅行’，尤指航海或航天。

lemmas.def_en: feeling shame or guilt or embarrassment or remorse

examples.en: He felt deeply ashamed of his rude behavior toward the guest during yesterday's formal dinner.
examples.zh: 在昨天正式的晚宴上，他对客人的无礼行为深感惭愧。

lemmas.usage_note: 通常作表语，表达道德或良心上的惭愧与羞耻，固定搭配有 be ashamed of 或 feel ashamed to do sth.。

lemmas.def_en: used of persons or their behavior; feeling no shame
lemmas.def_zh: 无羞耻心的, 不知耻的, 厚脸无耻的, 问心无愧的

examples.en: She was completely unashamed of her humble background and shared it proudly.
examples.zh: 她对自己的卑微出身毫无愧色，并且自豪地分享出来。

lemmas.def_en: without shame

examples.en: He wept unashamedly in front of the entire audience during the final speech.
examples.zh: 在最后的演讲中，他在全体观众面前毫无顾忌地哭了起来。

lemmas.def_en: with a feeling of shame

examples.en: The boy looked down ashamedly after admitting that he had lied to his parents.
examples.zh: 承认对父母撒谎后，男孩不好意思地低下了头。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 a-（表状态）+ shame（羞耻），表示‘处于羞耻、惭愧的状态’。

lemmas.def_en: showing intellectual penetration or emotional depth
lemmas.def_zh: 极深的, 深厚的, 深刻的, 渊博的

examples.en: The advent of artificial intelligence has exerted a profound influence on modern higher education.
examples.zh: 人工智能的出现对现代高等教育产生了深远的影响。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用于正式书面语，形容影响深远、见解渊博或情感极其强烈，高频搭配为 profound impact / profound change。

lemmas.def_en: to a great depth psychologically

examples.en: The tragic news profoundly affected the entire community and prompted widespread reflection.
examples.zh: 这一悲惨的消息深深地触动了整个社区，并引发了广泛的反思。

lemmas.usage_note: 副词修饰动词或形容词，意为极度、深刻地，常见搭配如 profoundly affected、profoundly grateful。

lemmas.def_zh: 深度, 深奥, 深刻, 深厚
lemmas.def_en: wisdom that is recondite and abstruse and profound

examples.en: The professor spoke with great profundity on the philosophical nature of time.
examples.zh: 教授极为深刻地探讨了时间的哲学本质。

lemmas.def_en: extremeness of degree

examples.en: The sheer profoundness of her philosophical insights impressed every scholar in the room.
examples.zh: 她哲学见解的深奥让房间里的每位学者都赞叹不已。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 profundus（pro- 向前/向下 + fundus 底部），字面指‘深至底部’，引申为深度、深奥、深远。

lemmas.def_en: show displeasure, as after a performance or speech

examples.en: The angry crowd began to loudly boo the referee after the terrible call.
examples.zh: 在糟糕的判罚之后，愤怒的人群开始大声向裁判喝倒彩。

lemmas.usage_note: 指向表演者或选手发出嘘声喝倒彩，常见搭配 boo sb off the stage（嘘下台）。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声词，模仿发出低沉的嘘声以表达不满或喝倒彩。

lemmas.def_en: an electric railway operating below the surface of the ground (usually in a city)

examples.en: She prefers taking the crowded subway to avoid the terrible morning traffic jams.
examples.zh: 她宁愿乘坐拥挤的地铁，以避开早晨可怕的交通拥堵。

lemmas.usage_note: 美语中指地下铁（take the subway）；在英式英语中多指地下人行通道，英式地铁多用 underground。

family_guide.root_logic: sub-（在……下面）+ way（道路），字面指‘地下的通道’，现多指地下铁道。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to demography

examples.en: Rapid urban expansion is driving a significant demographic shift across the southern provinces.
examples.zh: 城市的快速扩张正在推动南部各省出现显著的人口结构转变。

lemmas.usage_note: 作形容词修饰与人口统计或结构相关的特征，多用于学术及商业报告，常见搭配为 demographic shift / demographic trends。

lemmas.def_en: a statistic characterizing human populations (or segments of human populations broken down by age or sex or income etc.)
lemmas.def_zh: [法] 人口统计的, 人口学的

examples.en: The streaming platform designed its new content strategy specifically to attract the younger demographic.
examples.zh: 该流媒体平台专门设计了其新的内容策略，以吸引更年轻的受众群体。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，指特定的人口群体或目标受众，常用于市场营销，搭配如 target demographic、the 18-to-35 demographic。

family_guide.root_logic: demo-（人民、人口）+ -graph（写、记录）+ -ic（形容词/名词后缀），指对人群统计特征的描述。

lemmas.def_en: a fractional monetary unit of Japan and Indonesia and Cambodia; equal to one hundredth of a yen or rupiah or riel
lemmas.def_zh: 传感器（传感元件, 探测设备）

examples.en: The optical sen detected the minor change in ambient light instantly.
examples.zh: 光学传感器瞬间检测到了环境光的微小变化。

lemmas.usage_note: 专有名词性货币单位，指日本等国的“钱”（日元百分之一），单复数同形，属于专业金融历史词汇。

family_guide.root_logic: 借词，源自日语（銭）及其他亚洲货币单位，指‘钱/仙’等辅币单位。

lemmas.def_en: a discrete amount of something that is analogous to the quantities in quantum theory

examples.en: The discovery represents a quantum leap in our understanding of molecular biology.
examples.zh: 这一发现代表了我们在分子生物学理解上的巨大飞跃。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于物理学与科技领域，构成固定搭配如 quantum leap（飞跃）或 quantum computing（量子计算）。

lemmas.def_zh: （实验中）仅有两种可能的； 量子的, 量子论的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to a quantum or capable of existing in only one of two states

examples.en: The experiment produced a quantal response, with cells either surviving or dying completely.
examples.zh: 实验产生了全或无的反应，细胞要么存活，要么完全死亡。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 quantus（多少），物理学借用指‘不可分割的基本微小能量单位’，引申指质的飞跃。

lemmas.def_en: artifact made by weaving or felting or knitting or crocheting natural or synthetic fibers

examples.en: She carefully cleaned the dusty wooden table with a soft, damp cloth.
examples.zh: 她用一块柔软的湿布仔细擦拭落满灰尘的木桌。

lemmas.usage_note: 指“布料”时不可数（a piece of cloth）；指“抹布”时可数；注意与衣服 clothes（复数）区分拼写及用法。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 clāth，最初指‘编织好的物料或布匹’，后专指特定用途的织物或抹布。

lemmas.def_en: an advertisement consisting of short scenes from a motion picture that will appear in the near future

examples.en: The gallery invited several art critics to a private preview of the new exhibition.
examples.zh: 画廊邀请了几位艺术评论家参加新展览的内部预展。

lemmas.usage_note: 指电影、展览等的预映、预展或技术预览，常与介词 of 或 give a preview 搭配使用。

lemmas.def_en: watch (a movie or play) before it is released to the general public

examples.en: The tech company will preview its upcoming operating system at the conference tomorrow.
examples.zh: 这家科技公司将在明天的发布会上预先展示其即将推出的操作系统。

lemmas.usage_note: 作及物动词，表示提前观看、预先展示或概述某事物，宾语常接电影、功能或计划。

family_guide.root_logic: pre-（提前）+ view（看），核心语义为‘提前观看、预先审视’。

lemmas.def_en: feeling a need to see others suffer
lemmas.def_zh: 恶意, 怨恨, 使人烦恼的事物

examples.en: He refused to invite his cousin to the dinner purely out of spite.
examples.zh: 他不肯邀请表弟参加晚宴纯粹是出于恶意报复。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用于书面及口语，表示出于恶意的动机，高频短语包括 in spite of（尽管）及 out of spite（出于怨恨）。

lemmas.def_en: feeling a need to see others suffer

examples.en: Her spitefulness alienated all the colleagues who had previously tried to help her.
examples.zh: 她的刻薄怀恨疏远了所有以前试图帮助她的同事。

lemmas.def_en: showing malicious ill will and a desire to hurt; motivated by spite
lemmas.def_zh: 怀恨的, 怀有恶意的, 恶意的

examples.en: She regretted sending that spiteful message to her friend in the heat of anger.
examples.zh: 她后悔在盛怒之下给朋友发了那条充满恶意的短信。

lemmas.def_en: in a maliciously spiteful manner
lemmas.def_zh: 怀恨地, 怀有恶意地

examples.en: He spitefully ruined her garden project after they had a bitter argument last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚发生激烈争吵后，他恶意破坏了她的花园项目。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 despit（看不起、蔑视），与 despise 同源，现多指因怀恨而故意为难的情绪。

lemmas.def_en: a quick reply to a question or remark (especially a witty or critical one)
lemmas.def_zh: 复原, 复辟, 复位, 尖刻的对答, 抱怨的原因

examples.en: The veteran tennis player made a remarkable comeback after two years of injuries.
examples.zh: 这位经验丰富的网球老将因伤缺阵两年后上演了精彩的回归。

lemmas.usage_note: 多指“东山再起”，固定搭配 make/stage a comeback；非正式语境中也可指机智反驳（a quick comeback）。

family_guide.root_logic: 动词短语 come back（归来、反驳）的名词化，指重返巅峰或机智的反驳。

lemmas.def_en: a blood vessel that carries blood from the capillaries toward the heart
lemmas.def_zh: 血管, 静脉, 纹理, 气质, 情绪

examples.en: The novel continues in a similar humorous vein throughout the subsequent chapters.
examples.zh: 这部小说在随后的章节中继续保持着类似的幽默基调。

lemmas.usage_note: 可指生理上的静脉血管、矿脉纹理，亦可引申指风格、基调，常搭配 in a ... vein（以……基调）。

lemmas.def_en: make a veinlike pattern
lemmas.def_zh: 使有脉络, 像脉络般分布于

examples.en: Cracks of glowing magma veined the dark volcanic rock after the eruption.
examples.zh: 喷发之后，炽热的岩浆裂纹如脉络般密布在黑色的火山岩上。

lemmas.usage_note: 多以过去分词 veined 形式作被动态或伴随状语，表示“使布满脉纹、使呈大理石纹状”。

lemmas.def_zh: 静脉的, 在静脉中的, 有脉的
lemmas.def_en: of or contained in or performing the function of the veins

examples.en: The nurse quickly located a suitable venous site to draw the required blood sample.
examples.zh: 护士迅速找到合适的静脉位置来采集所需的血样。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 vena（血管、矿脉、纹理），引申指像血管一样纵横分布的纹理或特定的风格心境。

lemmas.def_en: a clique (often secret) that seeks power usually through intrigue

examples.en: A radical faction within the party is threatening to block the proposed tax reform.
examples.zh: 党内的一个激进派系正威胁要阻挠拟议中的税制改革。

lemmas.usage_note: 指政党、组织内部因利益分歧而形成的派系或派别斗争，多含贬义，常与 rival 连用。

lemmas.def_zh: 好搞派系的, 好结党营私的
lemmas.def_en: dissenting (especially dissenting with the majority opinion)

examples.en: The committee's work was constantly delayed by bitter disputes among factious members.
examples.zh: 委员会的工作因好搞派系的成员之间激烈的争执而屡屡延误。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 facere（做、行动），引申为因共同政治行动而形成的分裂‘小集团’。

lemmas.def_en: someone who has won first place in a competition

examples.en: The quiet stable was filled with the rhythmic champ of the horses eating their oats.
examples.zh: 安静的马厩里充斥着马匹吃燕麦时有节奏的咀嚼声。

lemmas.usage_note: 作为动词的名词化使用，指大声咀嚼的动作或咬嚼声，日常交流中较为少见且具描述性。

lemmas.def_en: chafe at the bit, like horses
lemmas.def_zh: 大声地嚼, 格格地咬

examples.en: The young athletes were champing at the bit to get onto the field and play.
examples.zh: 这些年轻运动员急不可耐地想要上场打比赛。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示急躁、格格地咀嚼或咬，极其高频的固定搭配为 champ at the bit（跃跃欲试、急不可耐）。

family_guide.root_logic: 作名词时为champion的口语缩写；作动词时源于拟声词，指大声咀嚼或因急躁而咬嚼。
family_guide.core_distinction: champ (n.) 为 champion 口语缩略，意为“冠军”；champ (v.) 意为“大声咀嚼/急躁地咬”，两者词源不同但形态重合。

lemmas.def_en: capable of being done with means at hand and circumstances as they are
lemmas.def_zh: 能养活的, 能生长发育的

examples.en: Solar energy has become an economically viable alternative to fossil fuels in many regions.
examples.zh: 在许多地区，太阳能已成为化石燃料在经济上切实可行的替代方案。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容方案、技术等“切实可行的”，或生物学中“能存活的”，常搭配 viable alternative 或 financially viable。

lemmas.def_en: not capable of living or developing successfully

examples.en: The biologist confirmed that the damaged seeds were completely nonviable.
examples.zh: 生物学家证实这些受损的种子完全无法存活。

lemmas.def_en: (of living things) capable of normal growth and development
lemmas.def_zh: 生存能力, 发育能力

examples.en: Rising operational costs have threatened the long-term viability of the clinic.
examples.zh: 不断上涨的运营成本威胁到了该诊所的长期生存能力。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自法语 vie（生命），核心逻辑为“具备存活或成功推行能力的”。

lemmas.def_en: (baseball) a list of batters in the order in which they will bat
lemmas.def_zh: 阵容, 阵形, 布阵, 一组人

examples.en: The festival announced an impressive lineup of international jazz musicians today.
examples.zh: 该节日今天公布了令人印象深刻的国际爵士音乐家阵容。

lemmas.usage_note: 指“阵容”或警方的“指认队列”，常见搭配 an impressive lineup of artists 或 a starting lineup（首发阵容）。

family_guide.root_logic: 由短语 line up（排队、列队）复合派生而来的名词，指按次序排列好的人或事物名单。

lemmas.def_en: hanging cloth used as a blind (especially for a window)

examples.en: She drew the heavy velvet curtains to block out the harsh morning sunlight.
examples.zh: 她拉上厚厚的天鹅绒窗帘，以挡住清晨刺眼的阳光。

lemmas.usage_note: 指窗帘、幕布，常用于 draw/pull the curtains（拉上/拉开窗帘）或引申为终结之意。

lemmas.def_en: provide with drapery

examples.en: The nurse curtained off the bed to give the patient some privacy during the examination.
examples.zh: 护士用帘子将病床隔开，以便在检查期间保护病人的隐私。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示“装上帘子”或“用帘子隔开”，极高频搭配为短语动词 curtain off（用帘子隔开）。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 cortina（帷幔），核心意象为遮挡、隔断或作为舞台的幕布。

lemmas.def_en: order by virtue of superior authority; decree
lemmas.def_zh: 制定法律, 扮演, 颁布

examples.en: Congress voted overwhelmingly to enact new legislation protecting consumer data privacy.
examples.zh: 国会以压倒性多数投票通过了保护消费者数据隐私的新法规。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用于正式法律语境，表示“通过并颁布法律”，也可用于戏剧或比喻语境表示“扮演、上演”。

lemmas.def_en: the passing of a law by a legislative body
lemmas.def_zh: 制定, 条例, 法规, 法令, 颁布, 规定

examples.en: The enactment of the new policy caused immediate debate among local business owners.
examples.zh: 新政策的颁布立即引发了当地企业主之间的争论。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 en-（使成为）+ act（法令、行动），核心逻辑是“使法规产生效力”或“付诸表演”。

lemmas.def_en: submerge in a liquid
lemmas.def_zh: 使上下湿透, 浸, 吸入, 吸收, 浸洗掉；浸泡, 渗透

examples.en: Heavy rain quickly soaked through his thin jacket, leaving him shivering in the cold.
examples.zh: 大雨很快湿透了他的薄夹克，让他在寒冷中瑟瑟发抖。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示浸湿、浸泡或吸收，常与介词 in, through 或副词 up 搭配，构成 soak up（吸收、领略）。

lemmas.def_en: a heavy rain
lemmas.def_zh: 浸洗人, 酒量大的人, 倾盆大雨

examples.en: We got caught in a sudden summer soaker on our way home.
examples.zh: 在回家路上，我们遭遇了一场突如其来的倾盆大雨。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 socian，核心逻辑是液体充分渗透或浸泡物体。

lemmas.def_en: cause to repeat a cycle
lemmas.def_zh: 使再循环, 重新利用, 再制

examples.en: Our city encourages every household to recycle plastic bottles and paper waste.
examples.zh: 我们市鼓励每个家庭回收塑料瓶和废纸。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常与 waste/materials 搭配；引申为“沿用旧思路”，注意与简单复用（reuse）区分。

family_guide.root_logic: re-（重新）+ cycle（循环），指让物品或材料重新进入使用周期的过程。

lemmas.def_en: marked by simplicity; having a humble opinion of yourself
lemmas.def_zh: 谦逊的, 羞怯的, 端庄的, 适度的

examples.en: Despite his remarkable success in business, he remained modest about his achievements.
examples.zh: 尽管在商业上取得了非凡的成功，他对自己的成就依然保持谦逊。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰成就、收入或外貌，表达谦逊或适度规模；与about搭配表示对某事谦虚。

lemmas.def_en: with modesty; in a modest manner

examples.en: She smiled modestly as the audience applauded her outstanding piano performance.
examples.zh: 当观众为她出色的钢琴演奏鼓掌时，她谦虚地微笑了。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 modestus（有节制的），核心是不过分、不张扬的处事或规模状态。

lemmas.def_en: a quantity of no importance
lemmas.def_zh: 尖啸声, 拉链, 活力

examples.en: The dress has a hidden zip running down the back for a sleek look.
examples.zh: 这件连衣裙背部有一条隐形拉链，显得线条流畅。

lemmas.usage_note: 英式英语中指拉链，亦可引申为精力或活力；常搭配fasten/undo the zip。

lemmas.def_en: a fastener for locking together two toothed edges by means of a sliding tab

examples.en: The metal zipper on his old leather backpack suddenly broke this morning.
examples.zh: 他旧皮包上的金属拉链今天早上突然坏掉了。

lemmas.def_en: close with a zipper
lemmas.def_zh: 给...以速度, 使增加活力, 拉(拉链)；有力而迅速地行动, 嘘嘘地响, 拉拉链

examples.en: She zipped through the morning traffic and arrived at the office early.
examples.zh: 她飞速穿过早高峰的车流，早早到达了办公室。

lemmas.usage_note: 既指拉拉链（常接up/down），也可作不及物动词指快速疾驰或高效穿梭移动。

lemmas.def_en: close with a zipper

examples.en: The metal zipper on his old leather backpack suddenly broke this morning.
examples.zh: 他旧皮包上的金属拉链今天早上突然坏掉了。

lemmas.def_en: quick and energetic
lemmas.def_zh: 元气旺盛的, 敏捷的, 活泼的

examples.en: The compact electric car offers a surprisingly zippy ride through heavy traffic.
examples.zh: 这款紧凑型电动车在拥堵的交通中穿行格外轻快敏捷。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声词，模拟拉链滑动的嘶嘶声或物体疾速飞过的声音。

lemmas.def_en: army unit smaller than a division

examples.en: He served with distinction in an infantry regiment during the war.
examples.zh: 战争期间，他在一个步兵团服役，表现优异。

lemmas.usage_note: 军事上指陆军编制中的团，亦可用于泛指大群或大批人（常与of连用）。

lemmas.def_en: the imposition of order or discipline
lemmas.def_zh: 团的编制, 系统化, 严格控制

examples.en: Many creative students felt stifled by the strict regimentation of the military academy.
examples.zh: 许多有创造力的学生感到被军校的严格管制所压抑。

lemmas.def_en: subject to rigid discipline, order, and systematization
lemmas.def_zh: 组编成团，组织，严格管制

examples.en: The daily routine at the boarding school was strictly regimented.
examples.zh: 这所寄宿学校的日常生活被严格死板地管理着。

lemmas.usage_note: 多以被动形式出现，常含批评意味，指对某人的生活、工作等进行极其严格死板的管制。

lemmas.def_en: belonging to or concerning a regiment

examples.en: The soldiers gathered in the courtyard for their daily regimental parade.
examples.zh: 士兵们在院子里集合，进行每日的团列队检阅。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 regere（统治、引导），核心为严格规约和体系化编排的组织体系。

lemmas.def_en: grow vigorously
lemmas.def_zh: 繁荣, 兴旺, 茁壮成长

examples.en: These delicate native plants thrive best in moist and shady environments.
examples.zh: 这些娇嫩的本土植物在湿润阴凉的环境中生长得最好。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物动词，常接介词 on（如 thrive on stress），表示“在……中茁壮成长”或“因……而活跃”。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 繁荣的；蒸蒸日上的；蓬勃发展的
lemmas.def_en: growing, developing, or being successful; prosperous and flourishing
lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰经济、商业、社区、生态或动植物生长，如 a thriving business / ecosystem。

examples.en: The coastal town has developed a thriving tourist industry over the last decade.
examples.zh: 过去十年间，这座沿海小镇发展起了繁荣的旅游业。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古诺斯语 thrífa（抓住、繁盛），核心语义为生命或事业蓬勃向上发展。

lemmas.def_en: an impelling force or strength

examples.en: The election campaign gained strong momentum after the highly successful public debate.
examples.zh: 在极为成功的公开辩论之后，竞选活动获得了强劲的势头。

lemmas.usage_note: 物理指“动量”，引申为“势头”；高频搭配 gain/gather/lose momentum，不可数名词。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 movere（移动），物理学中指动量，引申为事物发展前进的势头或冲力。

lemmas.def_en: a sodium salt of carbonic acid; used in making soap powders and glass and paper

examples.en: He ordered a large burger and a cold glass of soda.
examples.zh: 他点了一个大汉堡和一杯冰苏打水。

lemmas.usage_note: 在美式英语中指“碳酸甜饮料”，也可指纯“苏打水”；表示不同杯数或罐数时可数（a soda）。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自阿拉伯语 suwwad（一种含碱植物），后演化指苏打盐，现代口语特指含二氧化碳的碳酸饮料。

lemmas.def_en: a thin cylindrical pointed writing implement; a rod of marking substance encased in wood
lemmas.def_zh: 铅笔, 色笔, 眉笔, 画笔, 光线束

examples.en: Please complete the preliminary sketch in pencil before applying color.
examples.zh: 在涂色之前，请先用铅笔完成初步草图。

lemmas.usage_note: 指书写或绘画的铅笔工具，常用介词in搭配（如write in pencil）。

lemmas.def_en: write, draw, or trace with a pencil
lemmas.def_zh: 用铅笔写或涂, 草拟

examples.en: I will pencil you in for a brief meeting next Tuesday afternoon.
examples.zh: 我先暂定下周二下午和你开个简会。

lemmas.usage_note: 最常构成固定短语pencil in，表示暂定、初步安排某人或某日程于某日。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 penicillus（小尾巴、画笔），后演变为用木质包裹铅芯的硬质书写工具，引申出“用笔描摹/记录”之意。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or belonging to the Middle Ages

examples.en: The city is famous for its well-preserved medieval architecture.
examples.zh: 这座城市以其保存完好的中世纪建筑而闻名。

lemmas.usage_note: 指欧洲“中世纪的”；在日常语境中常用作贬义修饰语，比喻制度、观念“极其老旧落后的”。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 medius（中间）+ aevum（时代），字面即“中世纪的”。

lemmas.def_en: a motor vehicle with four wheels; usually propelled by an internal combustion engine

examples.en: The company has become a global leader in manufacturing electric automobiles.
examples.zh: 该公司已成为全球电动汽车制造领域的领头羊。

lemmas.usage_note: 美式正式用语，指四轮机动车；多出现于工业、统计或行业报告等正式语境。

lemmas.def_en: travel in an automobile

examples.en: During their summer holiday, the wealthy family automobiled along the coast.
examples.zh: 暑假期间，这户富裕人家驾车沿着海岸线旅行。

lemmas.usage_note: 极度罕见且过时的古旧用法，指驾驶或乘坐汽车出行，现通常由drive替代。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 auto-（自己）与 mobile（移动的）构成，指自行移动的机动车辆。

lemmas.def_en: capable of being foretold

examples.en: The movie was technically impressive, but its plot was entirely predictable.
examples.zh: 这部电影在技术上令人印象深刻，但其情节完全在意料之中。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰结果、剧情或人的行为，有时含贬义指毫无新意、容易料到或墨守成规。

lemmas.def_en: not capable of being foretold
lemmas.def_zh: 不可预测的；反复无常的

examples.en: Mountain weather is notoriously unpredictable, so prepare appropriate gear.
examples.zh: 山区的气候以变化莫测著称，因此要准备好相应的装备。

lemmas.usage_note: 多修饰天气、市场、情绪或局势，强调由于变数过多而难以准确揣测预估。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of being predictable

examples.en: Investors appreciate the predictability of long-term government bonds in volatile markets.
examples.zh: 在动荡的市场中，投资者看重长期政府债券的可预测性。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of being guided by sudden unpredictable impulses
lemmas.def_zh: 不可预测性, 不可预知性

examples.en: The sheer unpredictability of mountain weather makes outdoor hiking somewhat risky.
examples.zh: 山区天气的完全不可预测性使户外徒步旅行带有一定危险。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自 predict（预言，pre- 前 + dict 说），后缀 -able 表“可……的”。
family_guide.core_distinction: predictable 强调事物有规律、可预料；反义词 unpredictable 强调变幻莫测。

lemmas.def_en: United States singer (1918-1990)

examples.en: The soldiers gathered in the castle's outer bailey.
examples.zh: 士兵们聚集在城堡的外庭院中。

lemmas.usage_note: 历史建筑专有名词，指中世纪城堡的内庭或外院；大写的 Old Bailey 特指英国中央刑事法院。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 bail（围栏），特指城堡外围的城拱或庭院。

lemmas.def_en: act between parties with a view to reconciling differences

examples.en: A professional negotiator was brought in to mediate between the two parties.
examples.zh: 一位专业谈判专家被请来为双方进行调解。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物或不及物动词，常与between搭配，指作为中立第三方调解纠纷、促成和解。

lemmas.def_en: a negotiation to resolve differences that is conducted by some impartial party

examples.en: The dispute was finally settled through diplomatic mediation without going to court.
examples.zh: 该纠纷最终通过外交调解得以解决，并未对簿公堂。

lemmas.usage_note: 指作为第三方的调解、斡旋行为；常与go to/enter into/seek等动词搭配使用。

lemmas.def_en: a negotiator who acts as a link between parties
lemmas.def_zh: 调停者, 传递者, 基督

examples.en: A neutral mediator was appointed to help resolve the tense labor dispute.
examples.zh: 一位中立的调停者被任命来协助解决紧张的劳资纠纷。

lemmas.def_en: having no intervening persons, agents, conditions

examples.en: Babies explore the world through direct, unmediated sensory experiences every day.
examples.zh: 婴儿每天都通过直接、无中介的感官体验来探索世界。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 medius（中间），意为居于两者之间进行调停或连接。
family_guide.core_distinction: mediate 为动词调停；mediation 为名词调停行为或过程。

lemmas.def_en: an inflated feeling of pride in your superiority to others

examples.en: He has a fragile ego that cannot handle criticism.
examples.zh: 他自尊心脆弱，经不起任何批评。

lemmas.usage_note: 日常中常指自尊心或自我意识，常用搭配有 boost/bruise one's ego、a fragile/huge ego。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语单数第一人称代词 ego（我），在心理学中指自我，引申为自尊或自负。

lemmas.def_en: one who loves and defends his or her country
lemmas.def_zh: 民族主义者；国家主义者

examples.en: The prominent nationalist urged citizens to support domestic industries.
examples.zh: 这位著名的民族主义者呼吁民众支持本国工业。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指民族主义者或国家主义者；在政治语境中常指倡导民族自决或优先维护国家主权的人。

lemmas.def_en: love of country and willingness to sacrifice for it

examples.en: Economic hardship often fuels the rise of populist nationalism across the region.
examples.zh: 经济困境往往会在整个地区助长民粹民族主义的抬头。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，指民族主义思想或运动；常与rise of搭配表示民族主义思潮的抬头。

lemmas.def_en: fanatically patriotic

examples.en: The politician gained massive public support by delivering an intense and emotional nationalistic speech.
examples.zh: 这位政治家通过发表极具煽动性且带有民族主义色彩的演讲获得了大量公众支持。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自 nation（国家，民族），后缀 -ist 表“……主义者”。

lemmas.def_en: a range of mountains (usually with jagged peaks and irregular outline)
lemmas.def_zh: （尤指西班牙和美洲的）齿状山脊，连绵山脉

examples.en: Snow covered the highest peaks of the sierra.
examples.zh: 白雪覆盖了这处连绵山脉的最高峰。

lemmas.usage_note: 地理学及专有名词，源于西班牙语，指齿状连绵山脉；常作大写专名如 the Sierra Nevada。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自西班牙语，本义为“锯子”，借指锯齿般连绵起伏的山脉。

lemmas.def_en: recite with musical intonation; recite as a chant or a psalm

examples.en: Thousands of excited fans chanted the team's name throughout the final.
examples.zh: 成千上万兴奋的球迷在整场决赛中齐声高喊着球队的名字。

lemmas.usage_note: 既指抗议或比赛中众人反复呼喊口号，也指按单调节奏吟诵经文或唱赞美诗。

lemmas.def_en: reed pipe with finger holes on which the melody is played
lemmas.def_zh: 吟唱者, 调旋律管, 唱诗班成员

examples.en: He practiced the bagpipe melody repeatedly on his wooden practice chanter.
examples.zh: 他用木制练习用旋律管反复练习风笛旋律。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 cantare（唱），指有节奏地重复哼唱或喊叫。

lemmas.def_en: a short mixed drink

examples.en: He ordered a dry martini cocktail at the bar.
examples.zh: 他在酒吧点了一杯干马天尼鸡尾酒。

lemmas.usage_note: 除了指鸡尾酒外，常用于比喻多种事物危险或复杂的混合，常见搭配 a cocktail of drugs/chemicals。

family_guide.root_logic: 原指鸡尾状杂毛马，引申指混合调配的酒，再泛化为混合物。

lemmas.def_en: using language effectively to please or persuade
lemmas.def_zh: 修辞技巧；花言巧语，虚夸言辞

examples.en: Voters are growing tired of empty political rhetoric that never translates into action.
examples.zh: 选民们越来越厌倦那些从未转化为实际行动的空洞政治说辞。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，可指高超的修辞演说技巧，但现代政论文中常贬指虚妄华丽但空洞的说辞。

lemmas.def_en: a person who delivers a speech or oration

examples.en: The ancient rhetorician taught students how to craft persuasive public speeches.
examples.zh: 这位古代修辞学者教授学生如何构思有说服力的公开演讲。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to rhetoric; - W.A.White; - Lewis Mumford
lemmas.def_zh: 修辞学的, 符合修辞学的, 修辞的

examples.en: She asked a rhetorical question that required no immediate answer from anyone.
examples.zh: 她提出了一个修辞性反问，并不需要任何人的即刻回答。

lemmas.def_en: in a rhetorical manner
lemmas.def_zh: 在修辞学上, 讲究修辞地

examples.en: He smiled and paused rhetorically before delivering the final punchline.
examples.zh: 在说出最后的妙语之前，他微笑着讲究修辞地停顿了一下。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 rhetor（演说家），原指演说修辞艺术，常引申指华而不实的言辞。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or associated with heat
lemmas.def_zh: 热的, 热量的, 温泉的

examples.en: You should wear thermal underwear to protect against the bitter winter cold.
examples.zh: 你应该穿上保暖内衣，以抵御严冬的寒冷。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰 energy, insulation, spring 等，指与热量、保暖或温泉相关的物理属性。

lemmas.def_en: not involving heat

examples.en: This new preservation method relies entirely on nonthermal food processing technologies.
examples.zh: 这种新的保鲜方法完全依赖非热能的食品加工技术。

lemmas.def_en: by means of heat or with respect to thermal properties

examples.en: The modern house is thermally insulated to reduce heating costs during winter.
examples.zh: 这栋现代化房屋做了热绝缘处理，以降低冬季的取暖费用。

lemmas.def_en: rising current of warm air

examples.en: The eagle circled gracefully, catching a thermal to gain altitude without flapping its wings.
examples.zh: 老鹰优雅地盘旋着，借助一股上升热气流无需扇动翅膀便升到了高处。

lemmas.usage_note: 航空及气象领域专业名词，指上升的热气流，常与 catch, ride 等动词搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 therme（热），核心含义与“热量、温度”直接相关。

lemmas.def_en: an erroneous mental representation

examples.en: Mirrors can create the optical illusion of a much larger room.
examples.zh: 镜子可以制造出房间宽敞许多的视错觉。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与 under the illusion that 或 shatter/dispel the illusion 连用，指错误的观念或视错觉。

lemmas.def_en: a person with unusual powers of foresight

examples.en: The clever illusionist amazed the theater audience with his vanishing card tricks.
examples.zh: 这位聪明的魔术师用他消失的纸牌戏法惊艳了剧场观众。

lemmas.def_zh: 产生幻觉的, 幻影的, 错觉的
lemmas.def_en: based on or having the nature of an illusion

examples.en: The calm weather proved illusory as a fierce storm hit shortly after.
examples.zh: 平静的天气被证明只是假象，不久后暴风雨便猛烈来袭。

lemmas.def_en: marked by or producing illusion

examples.en: The artist created an illusionary sense of depth that transformed the flat, dull wall.
examples.zh: 艺术家营造出一种虚幻的纵深感，彻底改变了平淡无奇的墙面。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 illudere（嘲弄、戏弄），前缀 in- + ludere（玩耍），指感官受到戏弄而产生假象。

lemmas.def_en: the compass point midway between north and east; at 45 degrees

examples.en: A heavy blizzard swept across the Northeast overnight, disrupting transport.
examples.zh: 一场强暴风雪一夜之间席卷了东北部地区，导致交通瘫痪。

lemmas.usage_note: 指方位或地区，常与定冠词 the 连用，多作介词宾语，首字母在特指区域时大写。

lemmas.def_en: situated in or oriented toward the northeast
lemmas.def_zh: 东北的, 向东北的, 来自东北的

examples.en: We sailed slowly along the rugged northeast coast of the island.
examples.zh: 我们沿着该岛崎岖不平的东北海岸缓慢航行。

lemmas.usage_note: 作定语修饰名词，表示“东北方向的”或“来自东北的”，常修饰 coast, corner, wind 等。

lemmas.def_en: coming from the northeast

examples.en: The ship sailed safely under a gentle northeasterly breeze toward the port.
examples.zh: 船只在温和的向东北方向微风吹拂下，安全驶向港口。

family_guide.root_logic: 复合词，由 north（北）+ east（东）构成，指介于北与东之间的方位。

lemmas.def_en: throw a glance at; take a brief look at
lemmas.def_zh: 扫视, 闪光, 掠过, 提到, 略说；扫视, 反射, 使掠过

examples.en: He glanced nervously at his watch while waiting for the interview to begin.
examples.zh: 在等待面试开始时，他紧张地看了一眼手表。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与介词 at, down, over 搭配，表示迅速看一眼；及物用法较罕见。

lemmas.def_en: a quick look
lemmas.def_zh: 一瞥, 闪光, 掠过, 辉矿类

examples.en: With a quick glance over her shoulder, she made sure no one was following her.
examples.zh: 她飞快地回头瞥了一眼，以确保没有人跟着她。

lemmas.usage_note: 高频搭配为 at a glance（一眼就…）或 cast/take a glance at，指短暂的一瞥。

family_guide.root_logic: 词源或与闪烁、快速移动有关，引申为目光或光线迅速而短暂地一瞥或掠过。

lemmas.def_en: one of two divisions of an academic year
lemmas.def_zh: n. 学期（尤指半学年制）

examples.en: She plans to study abroad during the fall semester.
examples.zh: 她计划在秋季学期出国留学。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与介词in/during搭配，如during the spring semester；美式英语指一学年两学期制，三学期制常用term。

family_guide.root_logic: 来自拉丁语 semestris（六个月的），由 sex（六）和 mensis（月）结合而成，现指一学年分为两期的“学期”。

lemmas.def_en: to a complete degree or to the full or entire extent (`whole' is often used informally for `wholly')
lemmas.def_zh: adv. 完全地；总共；总而言之

examples.en: The train service was canceled altogether due to the storm.
examples.zh: 由于暴风雨，火车班次被彻底取消了。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示“完全”时常修饰形容词，如altogether different；注意与短语all together（大家一起）区分拼写与含义。

family_guide.root_logic: 复合副词，由 all（全部）+ together（一起）构成，意为“全然”、“总共”。

lemmas.def_en: coming next after the eighth and just before the tenth in position
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 第九的；九分之一的

examples.en: He celebrated his son's ninth birthday yesterday.
examples.zh: 他昨天庆祝了儿子的九岁生日。

lemmas.usage_note: 作为序数词前常加the，如the ninth edition；注意拼写去掉了nine中的e，极易误拼为nineth。

family_guide.root_logic: 基数词 nine（九）加序数词后缀 -th 演变而来（注意省略字母 e）。

lemmas.def_en: occurring or extending throughout a country or nation
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 全国性的，遍及全国的

examples.en: The police launched a nationwide hunt for the missing child.
examples.zh: 警方展开了全国范围的搜寻，以寻找那名失踪儿童。

lemmas.usage_note: 常置于名词前作定语，如a nationwide search/survey；兼作副词使用，表示“在全国范围内”，无需介词。

family_guide.root_logic: 复合形容词，由 nation（国家）+ -wide（遍及……的）构成，指全国范围的。

lemmas.def_en: very unhappy; full of misery
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 痛苦的，悲惨的；令人难受的

examples.en: The cold, rainy weather made everyone feel miserable.
examples.zh: 阴冷多雨的天气让每个人都感到极不好受。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于make somebody miserable或feel miserable；既可形容人的痛苦绝望，也可形容天气阴冷令人难受。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 miser（可怜的、悲惨的），后缀 -able 表示具有……特性的。

lemmas.def_en: any of various small flat sweet cakes (`biscuit' is the British term)
lemmas.def_zh: n. 曲奇饼，小甜饼；（计算机）Cookie

examples.en: She baked a fresh batch of chocolate chip cookies.
examples.zh: 她烤了一批新鲜的巧克力曲奇饼。

lemmas.usage_note: 美式英语指饼干（英式常用biscuit）；口语搭配that's the way the cookie crumbles意为“这就是现实”。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自荷兰语 koekje（小蛋糕），传入美式英语后泛指饼干类点心。

lemmas.def_en: a brittle silver-white metalloid element that is related to selenium and sulfur; it is used in alloys and as a semiconductor; occurs mainly as tellurides in ores of copper and nickel and silver and gold
lemmas.def_zh: n. 唱名中的第七音（同 ti）

examples.en: In sol-fa notation, te is followed by the octave doh.
examples.zh: 在唱名体系中，te 之后紧接着是高八度的 doh。

lemmas.usage_note: 音乐术语，指唱名法中的第七音（常用ti替代）；亦可作为化学元素碲（Tellurium）的符号缩写。

family_guide.root_logic: 简短外来借词，常用作“ti”的变体，指唱名中的第七音（xi/ti）。

lemmas.def_en: inconsistent with reason or logic or common sense; - Walter Lippman
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 荒谬的，荒唐的；可笑的

examples.en: It is completely absurd to spend all that money on something you will never use.
examples.zh: 把你所有的钱花在一件你永远用不上的东西上，简直荒谬透顶。

lemmas.usage_note: 常形容想法、提议或情况极其不合理，修饰 idea, proposal 或在 It is absurd that... 中作表语。

lemmas.def_en: a message whose content is at variance with reason
lemmas.def_zh: 荒谬, 悖理, 荒谬的言行

examples.en: She laughed at the utter absurdity of paying ten dollars for plain water.
examples.zh: 她对一杯白开水竟要卖十美元这种极其荒谬的事付之一笑。

lemmas.def_en: in an absurd manner or to an absurd degree
lemmas.def_zh: 荒谬地, 荒唐地, 愚蠢地

examples.en: The tiny studio apartment in the city center was priced absurdly high.
examples.zh: 市中心那间微型单身公寓的价格高得荒谬。

family_guide.root_logic: 来自拉丁语 absurdus（不合调的、愚蠢的），由 ab-（偏离）+ surdus（聋的、听不见的）组成，引申为荒谬。

lemmas.def_en: lying between two extremes in time or space or state

examples.en: This textbook is designed specifically for students at an intermediate level of English.
examples.zh: 本教材专为中级英语水平的学生设计。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰 level, stage, course 等，表示水平介于初级与高级之间，或阶段居中。

lemmas.def_en: a substance formed during a chemical process before the desired product is obtained
lemmas.def_zh: 中间物, 调停者, 中级

examples.en: The ski slope is suitable for intermediates who want to refine their technique.
examples.zh: 该滑雪道适合想要磨炼技术的中级滑雪者。

lemmas.usage_note: 指中级水平者、居间者或化学反应中的中间体，可数名词，学术或分级场景常用。

lemmas.def_en: the act of intervening for the purpose of bringing about a settlement
lemmas.def_zh: 调解, 调停, 仲裁

examples.en: The dispute was finally settled through the skilled intermediation of a neutral diplomat.
examples.zh: 这场争端最终通过一位中立外交官巧妙的调解得以解决。

lemmas.def_en: act between parties with a view to reconciling differences

examples.en: A neutral committee was appointed to intermediate between the striking workers and management.
examples.zh: 一个中立委员会被任命在罢工工人与管理层之间进行调停。

lemmas.usage_note: 较正式的书面语，多作不及物动词，常与 between 搭配，表示居中调停或起媒介作用。

lemmas.def_en: to an intermediate degree

examples.en: The raw material is stored intermediately in large bins before final processing.
examples.zh: 原材料在最终加工之前被暂时存放在大仓中。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 inter-（在……之间）+ medi-（中间）构成，指处于中间阶段、状态或调解。

lemmas.def_en: garments or white goods that can be cleaned by laundering
lemmas.def_zh: n. 待洗（或已洗）衣物；洗衣店

examples.en: I need to do the laundry tonight because I have run out of clean shirts.
examples.zh: 我今晚得洗衣服了，因为我的干净衬衫都穿完了。
