examples.en: The young hotspur rushed into the fight without considering the dangerous consequences.
examples.zh: 那个鲁莽性急的年轻人不顾危险后果便冲进了战斗。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hotspur 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to macroeconomics

examples.en: The central bank adjusted interest rates to maintain macroeconomic stability across the country.
examples.zh: 央行调整了利率以维持全国的宏观经济稳定。

lemmas.def_zh: 整体经济学, 宏观经济学
lemmas.def_en: the branch of economics that studies the overall working of a national economy

examples.en: Her research in macroeconomics focuses on inflation trends and global trade policies.
examples.zh: 她在宏观经济学方面的研究侧重于通胀趋势和全球贸易政策。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 macroeconomic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a publication containing a variety of works

examples.en: She published a concise compendium of local folklore for curious foreign visitors.
examples.zh: 她为好奇的外国游客出版了一本简明的当地民间传说纲要。

lemmas.def_en: briefly giving the gist of something

examples.en: The handbook offers a compendious overview of contemporary European legal systems.
examples.zh: 这本手册简明扼要地概述了当代欧洲的法律制度。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 compendium 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 基于信用的, 信托的, 受信托的
lemmas.def_en: relating to or of the nature of a legal trust (i.e. the holding of something in trust for another)

examples.en: Directors have a strict fiduciary duty to act in their shareholders' best interests.
examples.zh: 董事负有严格的信托责任，必须为股东的最大利益行事。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fiduciary 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the second day of the week; the first working day

examples.en: The weekly staff meeting has been rescheduled to next Mon morning at nine.
examples.zh: 每周员工例会已改至下周一上午九点举行。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mons 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the time period between dawn and noon

examples.en: The mist slowly cleared away to reveal a bright and crisp autumn morn.
examples.zh: 薄雾渐渐散去，露出了一个明朗清爽的秋日清晨。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 morn 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 暖人心房的, 感人的
lemmas.def_en: causing gladness and pleasure

examples.en: The community showed heartwarming support to the family after the devastating apartment fire.
examples.zh: 公寓失火后，社区对那家人展现出令人心暖的支持。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 heartwarming 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 反生产的；使达不到预期目标的
lemmas.def_en: tending to hinder the achievement of a goal

examples.en: Working through the night without sleep often proves completely counterproductive for final exams.
examples.zh: 通宵不睡复习期末考试往往完全适得其反。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 counterproductive 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: when light passes sharp edges or goes through narrow slits the rays are deflected and produce fringes of light and dark bands

examples.zh: 当激光束穿过这条狭缝时，就会发生光衍射现象。

lemmas.def_en: undergo diffraction

examples.en: Narrow slits can diffract light waves to create distinct interference patterns on the screen.
examples.zh: 狭缝可以使光波发生衍射，从而在屏幕上形成明显的干涉图案。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 diffraction 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 富矿带, 带来好运的事物, 幸运

examples.zh: 这家科技公司在发布最新软件后迎来了巨大的财务暴利。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bonanza 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 停止, 控制, 断念

examples.en: The court ordered the loud factory to cease and desist operations immediately.
examples.zh: 法院命令该噪声工厂立即停止运营。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 desist 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an area of ground used for some particular purpose (such as building or farming)

examples.en: They purchased a large acreage of farmland to build an organic vegetable orchard.
examples.zh: 他们买下了一大片农田来建立有机蔬菜果园。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 acreage 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 再点火, 重新激起；重新燃烧
lemmas.def_en: kindle anew, as of a fire

examples.en: Their unexpected reunion helped to rekindle the romance they had lost years ago.
examples.zh: 意外的重聚帮助他们重新燃起了多年前失去的浪漫。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rekindle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: shrub or small tree native to southwestern Asia having large red many-seeded fruit

examples.en: She carefully scattered ruby pomegranate seeds over the fresh green salad before serving.
examples.zh: 她在上桌前小心地将红宝石般的石榴籽撒在新鲜蔬菜沙拉上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pomegranate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 权宜的, 方便的, 有用的

examples.zh: 经理选择了一个政治上权宜的折中方案，而不是解决根本问题。

lemmas.def_zh: 权宜, 方便, 私利

lemmas.def_zh: 权宜, 方便, 私利
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being suited to the end in view

examples.zh: 批评人士指责该政客为了政治权宜而放弃个人道德原则。

lemmas.def_zh: 方便地, 便利地, 得当地
lemmas.def_en: in an expedient manner

lemmas.def_en: a decrease in size of an organ caused by disease or disuse

lemmas.def_en: undergo atrophy

examples.en: Prolonged bed rest during recovery can lead to serious muscular atrophy.
examples.zh: 康复期间长时间卧床休息会导致严重的肌肉萎缩。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 atrophy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 预言, 预告, 预示
lemmas.def_en: foreshadow or presage

examples.en: Ancient astrologers believed unusual celestial events could foretell the rise of kings.
examples.zh: 古代占星家认为不寻常的天象可以预示君王的崛起。

lemmas.def_en: foreshadow or presage

lemmas.def_en: the soccer or hockey player assigned to protect the goal

family_guide.root_logic: 以 goaltender 为核心的派生词族。

examples.zh: 游客们聚集在埃及沙漠明朗的阳光下，围观古老的石雕狮身人面像。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sphinx 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 闷热的, 窒息的, 乏味的, 固步自封的, 自以为是的

examples.zh: 请打开卧室窗户，因为里面的空气感觉又热又闷。

lemmas.def_en: state of obstruction or stoppage or air in the nose or throat

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stuffy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 两点, 平手, 平分

examples.zh: 两人在底线展开激烈对攻后，这场精彩的冠军争夺战打成平分。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 deuce 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: very rich flaky crescent-shaped roll

examples.zh: 他每天早餐都点一个刚出炉的黄油羊角面包和一杯黑咖啡。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 croissant 为核心的派生词族。

examples.zh: 分析师警告称，由于消费需求下降，该零售股的表现可能会低于预期。

lemmas.def_en: a student who does not perform as well as expected or as well as the IQ indicates

examples.zh: 研究人员计算了复杂的势能面以理解该化学反应路径。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wormhole 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: fool or dupe

examples.zh: 突如其来的预算削减阻挠了他们雄心勃勃的扩张计划。

lemmas.def_zh: 水管, 沟渠, 导管

examples.zh: 那座古罗马引水渠依然将新鲜的泉水引入城内。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 aqueduct 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an inferior dog or one of mixed breed

examples.en: She adopted a friendly mutt from the local animal shelter last weekend.
examples.zh: 上周末她从当地的动物收容所收养了一只友善的杂种狗。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mutt 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to cytoplasm

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cytoplasm 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 质地薄的, 没有内容的, 低级庸俗的

examples.zh: 私家侦探同意在一家低级庸俗的汽车旅馆与客户会面。

examples.zh: 最新的政治丑闻暴露了惊人的腐败与不道德肮脏行径。

examples.en: an acerbic tone piercing otherwise flowery prose
a barrage of acid comments

examples.zh: 发现恶性肿瘤尚未扩散转移，医生们终于松了一口气。

examples.zh: 评论家们不喜欢该演员过于矫饰的表演，称其僵硬且不自然。

lemmas.def_en: remote in manner

lemmas.def_en: indifference by personal withdrawal

examples.zh: 这位老年患者因哮喘呼吸时带有明显的喘息声。

examples.zh: 裁判在官方记分卡上仔细记录了每位选手的得分。

lemmas.def_zh: 教皇, 主教, 大祭司

examples.zh: 数千名虔诚的朝圣者聚集在广场上拜见教皇。

lemmas.def_zh: 烈性子的人, 喷火的东西
lemmas.def_en: a highly emotional and quick-tempered person (especially a girl or woman)

examples.zh: 别惹她发脾气，因为她可是个十足的烈性子。

lemmas.def_zh: 使精力充沛, 鼓舞, 搞活, 使健壮
lemmas.def_en: heighten or intensify

examples.en: A brisk morning walk along the coastline will quickly invigorate your tired spirit.
examples.zh: 清晨沿着海岸线轻快散步能迅速振奋你疲惫的精神。

lemmas.def_zh: 精力充沛, 身心愉快, 鼓舞
lemmas.def_en: quality of being active or spirited or alive and vigorous

family_guide.root_logic: 以 invigorate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: play boisterously

examples.en: The young lambs began to frisk playfully across the lush green meadow this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上，小羊羔们开始在郁郁葱葱的绿草地上欢快地蹦跳。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 frisk 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 生动场面, 戏剧性局面
lemmas.def_en: a group of people attractively arranged (as if in a painting)

examples.en: The sudden silence created a dramatic tableau that captured the attention of every guest.
examples.zh: 突如其来的寂静构成了一幅引人注目的生动戏剧性场面。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tableau 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a brief (and hurriedly handwritten) note

examples.en: I must quickly jot down his phone number before I forget it completely.
examples.zh: 我必须在彻底忘记之前快速记下他的电话号码。

lemmas.def_en: a small notebook for rough notes

lemmas.def_zh: 略记, 摘要记载下来
lemmas.def_en: write briefly or hurriedly; write a short note of

examples.en: I must quickly jot down his phone number before I forget it completely.
examples.zh: 我必须在彻底忘记之前快速记下他的电话号码。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 jot 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: pungent fleshy edible root

examples.en: She sliced a crisp red radish to add a peppery crunch to her salad.
examples.zh: 她切了一只爽脆的红小萝卜，为沙拉增添辛辣的口感。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 radish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a Spanish-speaking quarter in a town or city (especially in the United States)

examples.en: He grew up in a vibrant barrio known for its rich culture and street art.
examples.zh: 他在一个以丰富文化和街头艺术闻名的充满活力的街区长大。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 barrio 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: long-horned beef cattle formerly common in southwestern United States

examples.en: A solitary longhorn grazed peacefully near the wooden fence of the vast Texas ranch.
examples.zh: 一头孤独的长角牛在德州广阔牧场的木栅栏旁平静地吃草。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 longhorn 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: teach new skills

examples.en: The company offered comprehensive programs to retrain displaced workers for modern tech jobs.
examples.zh: 该公司提供全面的培训项目，帮助失业工人重新学习现代科技技能。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 retrain 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 现世主义, 宗教与教育分离论
lemmas.def_en: a doctrine that rejects religion and religious considerations

examples.en: The constitution guarantees secularism by strictly separating government affairs from religious institutions.
examples.zh: 宪法通过严格分离政府事务与宗教机构来保障世俗主义。

lemmas.def_zh: 现世主义者, 宗教与教育分离论者
lemmas.def_en: an advocate of secularism; someone who believes that religion should be excluded from government and education

examples.en: The secularist argued passionately that public schools must remain free of religious influence.
examples.zh: 这位世俗主义者慷慨陈词，认为公立学校必须免受宗教影响。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 secularism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a musical form that is often the last movement of a sonata

examples.en: The orchestra concluded their brilliant classical performance with a lively and energetic rondo.
examples.zh: 管弦乐队以一段轻快而充满活力的回旋曲结束了精彩的古典演奏。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rondo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 同谋, 串通, 复杂
lemmas.def_en: guilt as an accomplice in a crime or offense

examples.en: Investigators found clear evidence of his direct complicity in the corporate fraud scheme.
examples.zh: 调查人员找到了他直接参与该企业欺诈计划的确凿同谋证据。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 complicity 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: small pieces or streamers of colored paper that are thrown around on festive occasions (as at a wedding)

examples.en: Brightly colored confetti rained down on the cheering crowd as midnight struck.
examples.zh: 午夜钟声敲响时，五彩纸屑如雨点般落在欢呼的人群身上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 confetti 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: too numerous to be counted

examples.en: We sat together on the dark beach, gazing up at the innumerable stars.
examples.zh: 我们一起坐在黑暗的海滩上，仰望着天空中数不清的繁星。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 innumerable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: religious residence in a monastery governed by a prior or a convent governed by a prioress

examples.en: The ancient stone priory stood secluded among the quiet hills for centuries.
examples.zh: 那座古老的石头小修道院数百年来一直隐匿在寂静的群山之中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 priory 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: synthesis of compounds with the aid of radiant energy (especially in plants)

examples.en: Green plants convert ambient sunlight into essential chemical energy through the process of photosynthesis.
examples.zh: 绿色植物通过光合作用过程将环境阳光转化为必需的化学能量。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or using or formed by photosynthesis

examples.en: Algae are simple photosynthetic organisms that produce large amounts of oxygen worldwide.
examples.zh: 藻类是简单的光合生物，在全球范围内产生大量氧气。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 photosynthesis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an amateur boxer who weighs no more than 165 pounds

examples.en: The young middleweight landed a decisive punch that secured his championship title.
examples.zh: 这位年轻的中量级拳手打出决定性的一拳，锁定了冠军头衔。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 middleweight 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a small flute; pitched an octave above the standard flute

examples.en: Her piercing solo on the piccolo soared effortlessly above the entire orchestra.
examples.zh: 她用短笛吹出的嘹亮独奏毫不费力地压过了整个管弦乐队。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 piccolo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the ion NH4 derived from ammonia; behaves in many respects like an alkali metal ion

examples.en: The chemical laboratory uses ammonium compounds as an important ingredient in synthetic fertilizers.
examples.zh: 化学实验室使用铵化合物作为合成肥料的重要成分。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ammonium 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: using or knowing more than one language

examples.en: She was hired immediately because of her impressive multilingual skills and international experience.
examples.zh: 她因出色的多语言能力和国际经验而立即被录用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 multilingual 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 奴隶状态, 惩役, 地役权
lemmas.def_en: state of subjection to an owner or master or forced labor imposed as punishment

examples.en: He was finally released after enduring years of harsh penal servitude abroad.
examples.zh: 在国外忍受了多年的严酷劳役后，他终于获得了释放。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 servitude 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to olfaction

examples.en: The rich aroma of fresh coffee stimulated our olfactory senses immediately upon entering.
examples.zh: 一进门，新鲜咖啡的浓郁香气立刻刺激了我们的嗅觉感官。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 olfactory 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the sciences concerned with gathering, manipulating, storing, retrieving, and classifying recorded information

examples.en: Medical informatics is transforming healthcare by organizing complex patient data more efficiently.
examples.zh: 医学信息学通过更高效地组织复杂的患者数据正在改变医疗行业。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 informatics 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a descriptive catalog of musical recordings

examples.en: The surgeon recommended a diagnostic discography to locate the precise source of back pain.
examples.zh: 外科医生建议进行椎间盘造影术以确定背部疼痛的确切来源。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 discography 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a person who lived during the reign of Elizabeth I

examples.en: Shakespeare is celebrated as the greatest Elizabethan who ever wrote for the stage.
examples.zh: 莎士比亚被誉为有史以来最伟大的伊丽莎白时代剧作家。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 elizabethan 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 蜕变, 变质, 变形
lemmas.def_en: the marked and rapid transformation of a larva into an adult that occurs in some animals

examples.en: The caterpillar undergoes a complete metamorphosis before turning into a butterfly.
examples.zh: 毛毛虫在变成蝴蝶之前经历了彻底的蜕变。

lemmas.def_zh: 变化的, 变性的, 变态的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to metamorphosis (especially of rocks)

examples.en: Marble is a common type of metamorphic rock formed from pressurized limestone.
examples.zh: 大理石是一种由受压石灰石形成的常见变质岩。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 metamorphosis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the restoration of run-down urban areas by the middle class (resulting in the displacement of low-income residents)

examples.en: Rapid gentrification has forced many long-term residents out of the neighborhood.
examples.zh: 迅速的中产阶级化迫使许多长期居民迁出了该街区。

lemmas.def_zh: （使）中产阶级化( gentrify的过去式和过去分词 )
使中产阶级化; 使显得高雅; 修复或改善; 使优化；进行改善工作
lemmas.def_en: renovate so as to make it conform to middle-class aspirations

examples.en: Investors plan to gentrify the old industrial district with trendy cafes and boutiques.
examples.zh: 投资者计划用时髦的咖啡馆和精品店使这个旧工业区高档化。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gentrification 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: wood of a yew; especially the durable fine-grained light brown or red wood of the English yew valued for cabinetwork and archery bows

examples.en: An ancient yew tree stands in the churchyard, casting deep shadows.
examples.zh: 一棵古老的紫杉树矗立在教堂墓地中，投下浓重的阴影。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 yew 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an organized search (by police) for a person (charged with a crime)

examples.en: Police launched a massive manhunt after the dangerous convict escaped from prison.
examples.zh: 危险的罪犯越狱后，警方展开了大规模的搜捕行动。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 manhunt 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 磁性, 吸引力, 磁学, 催眠术
lemmas.def_en: attraction for iron; associated with electric currents as well as magnets; characterized by fields of force

examples.en: His natural charm and personal magnetism instantly drew everyone toward him.
examples.zh: 他天生的魅力和个人吸引力瞬间吸引了所有人。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 magnetism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a sheltered port where ships can take on or discharge cargo

examples.en: The bustling seaport handles thousands of international cargo ships every single year.
examples.zh: 这个繁忙的海港每年吞吐数千艘国际货轮。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 seaport 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: cake flavored with ginger

examples.en: The children spent the holiday afternoon decorating a sweet gingerbread house.
examples.zh: 孩子们在假期的下午忙着装饰一座甜美的姜饼屋。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gingerbread 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a check given by the British government to someone who is unemployed; it can be cashed either at a bank or at the post office

examples.en: Many retired citizens rely on a monthly state giro for living expenses.
examples.zh: 许多退休市民依靠每月转账的政府养老金生活。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 giro 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不能医治的, 不能矫正的, 无救的
lemmas.def_en: incapable of being cured

examples.en: Despite medical advances, she was diagnosed with an incurable degenerative disease.
examples.zh: 尽管医学取得了进步，她仍被诊断出患有一种无法治愈的退行性疾病。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 incurable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an escape from jail

examples.en: The audacious jailbreak shocked authorities and made headlines nationwide the next morning.
examples.zh: 这次大胆的越狱震惊了当局，并于次日清晨登上了全国头条。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 jailbreak 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 难以克服的, 不能超越的
lemmas.def_en: not capable of being surmounted or overcome

examples.en: They managed to succeed despite facing what seemed like insurmountable financial difficulties.
examples.zh: 尽管面临看似难以逾越的财务困难，他们还是成功了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 insurmountable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (medicine) obtaining pictures of the interior of the body

examples.en: The doctor ordered computed tomography to examine the internal injuries more closely.
examples.zh: 医生要求进行计算机断层扫描，以更仔细地检查内部伤势。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tomography 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the first light of day

examples.en: The hikers set out at daybreak to reach the mountain peak early.
examples.zh: 徒步旅行者在黎明时分出发，以便早点到达山顶。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 daybreak 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 皮质醇, 氢化可的松
lemmas.def_en: an adrenal-cortex hormone (trade names Hydrocortone or Cortef) that is active in carbohydrate and protein metabolism

examples.en: Chronic stress causes the body to produce elevated levels of cortisol.
examples.zh: 长期的压力会导致人体分泌更高水平的皮质醇。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cortisol 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 一口淡酒, 小争吵, 小口角, 淡酒
lemmas.def_en: a quarrel about petty points

examples.en: The couple had a minor tiff over who should cook dinner tonight.
examples.zh: 这对夫妇因为今晚该谁做晚饭而发生了一点小争吵。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tiff 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the point on the Earth's surface directly above the focus of an earthquake

examples.en: Rescue teams rushed toward the epicenter where the strongest tremors were felt.
examples.zh: 救援队迅速赶往震感最强烈的震中地区。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 epicenter 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: sting with or as with nettles and cause a stinging pain or sensation

examples.en: His constant interruptions began to nettle the speaker during the presentation.
examples.zh: 他在演讲过程中接二连三的打断开始激怒发言人。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nettle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: mar or spoil the appearance of

examples.en: Vandals used spray paint to deface the historic statue overnight.
examples.zh: 蓄意破坏者在一夜之间用喷漆涂污了这座历史雕像。

lemmas.def_en: the act of damaging the appearance or surface of something

examples.en: the defacement of an Italian mosaic during the Turkish invasion
he objected to the dam's massive disfigurement of the landscape

family_guide.root_logic: 以 deface 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 农奴, 奴隶, 服苦役的人
lemmas.def_en: (Middle Ages) a person who is bound to the land and owned by the feudal lord

examples.en: In medieval times, a serf was legally bound to the lord's land.
examples.zh: 在中世纪，农奴在法律上被束缚在领主的土地上。

lemmas.def_zh: 农权制, 农奴地位, 农奴境遇, 奴役
lemmas.def_en: the state of a serf

family_guide.root_logic: 以 serf 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: give to in marriage

examples.en: In ancient times, parents would often betroth their children at a very young age.
examples.zh: 在古代，父母常常在子女很小的时候就为他们定下婚约。

lemmas.def_en: a mutual promise to marry

family_guide.root_logic: 以 betroth 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: long nerve fiber that conducts away from the cell body of the neuron

examples.en: The electrical signal travels down the axon to stimulate the adjacent nerve cell.
examples.zh: 电信号沿着轴突传递，以刺激相邻的神经细胞。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or resembling an axon

family_guide.root_logic: 以 axon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a variety of mandarin orange

examples.en: She peeled a sweet tangerine and shared the juicy segments with her friend.
examples.zh: 她剥开一个甜柑橘，把多汁的果瓣分给朋友。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tangerine 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 可互用的, 相互作用的, 相互配合的
lemmas.def_en: able to exchange and use information

examples.en: The military requires all communication devices to be fully interoperable across different branches.
examples.zh: 军方要求所有通信设备在不同军种之间必须完全兼容互通。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 互用性, 互操作性
lemmas.def_en: (computer science) the ability to exchange and use information (usually in a large heterogeneous network made up of several local area networks)

family_guide.root_logic: 以 interoperable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (交战国间的)停火执行者(或小组)
lemmas.def_en: a member of a military force that is assigned (often with international sanction) to preserve peace in a trouble area

examples.en: The United Nations deployed a seasoned peacekeeper unit to stabilize the volatile border region.
examples.zh: 联合国部署了一支经验丰富的维和部队以稳定动荡的边境地区。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 peacekeeper 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a sore that has become inflamed and formed pus

examples.en: If you leave that dirty wound untreated, a painful fester will quickly form.
examples.zh: 如果你对那个肮脏的伤口置之不理，它很快就会形成痛苦的脓疮。

lemmas.def_en: ripen and generate pus

examples.en: If you leave that dirty wound untreated, a painful fester will quickly form.
examples.zh: 如果你对那个肮脏的伤口置之不理，它很快就会形成痛苦的脓疮。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fester 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: round one's lips as if intending to kiss

examples.en: The child began to pooch her lips, pretending to be angry with her parents.
examples.zh: 那个孩子撅起嘴巴，假装在生父母的气。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pooch 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (slang) offensive term for a lesbian who is noticeably masculine

examples.en: Volunteers piled heavy sandbags on the dike to prevent the river from overflowing.
examples.zh: 志愿者们在堤防上堆起沉重的沙袋，以防河水漫溢。

lemmas.def_en: enclose with a dike

examples.en: Volunteers piled heavy sandbags on the dike to prevent the river from overflowing.
examples.zh: 志愿者们在堤防上堆起沉重的沙袋，以防河水漫溢。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dike 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 低音, 浅色, 小声
lemmas.def_en: a quiet or hushed tone of voice

examples.en: Despite his polite smile, there was a clear undertone of anger in his voice.
examples.zh: 尽管他面带礼貌的微笑，声音里却明显带着一丝愤怒的意味。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 undertone 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a large retail store organized into departments offering a variety of merchandise; commonly part of a retail chain

examples.en: Shoppers flocked to the downtown emporium to browse its vast collection of imported goods.
examples.zh: 购物者涌入市中心的大商场，浏览其种类繁多的进口商品。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 emporium 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any substance that can cause an allergy

examples.en: Peanut dust is a common allergen that can trigger severe, life-threatening allergic reactions.
examples.zh: 花生粉尘是一种常见的过敏原，可能引发严重的致命过敏反应。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or having the effect of an allergen

family_guide.root_logic: 以 allergen 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 连指手套, 拳击手套
lemmas.def_en: glove that encases the thumb separately and the other four fingers together

examples.en: A warm woolen mitten fell from the toddler's hand into the deep snow.
examples.zh: 一只温暖的羊毛连指手套从蹒跚学步的孩子手中掉进了深雪中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mitten 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 先行数据输入, 自动调试环境, 自动设计工程
lemmas.def_en: a sweetened beverage of diluted fruit juice

examples.en: The software team installed a modern ADE to speed up the hardware development process.
examples.zh: 软件团队安装了先进的自动设计环境，以加快硬件开发进程。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ade 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 宏伟的, 壮丽的, 夸张的
lemmas.def_en: impressive because of unnecessary largeness or grandeur; used to show disapproval

examples.en: He always talked about grandiose business schemes, but he rarely took any real action.
examples.zh: 他总是空谈宏伟的商业计划，却很少采取实际行动。

lemmas.def_en: high-flown style; excessive use of verbal ornamentation

examples.en: the grandiosity of his prose
an excessive ornateness of language

lemmas.def_en: in a grandiose manner

examples.en: the building was bombastically spacious

family_guide.root_logic: 以 grandiose 为核心的派生词族。

examples.zh: 化妆师涂抹高光以凸显她那轮廓分明的高颧骨。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cheekbone 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不适当, 不足之处, 不充分
lemmas.def_en: lack of an adequate quantity or number

examples.en: His quiet voice masked a persistent feeling of inadequacy at work.
examples.zh: 他轻柔的话语掩盖了自己在工作中挥之不去的不足感。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 inadequacy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 弄上斑点, 弄成斑纹, 点缀
lemmas.def_en: produce a mottled effect

examples.en: Tiny freckles speckle her nose whenever she spends time under sunlight.
examples.zh: 每当她在阳光下待一会儿，小雀斑就会点缀在她的鼻梁上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 speckle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 打兰, 少量的酒(或饮料), 微量, 动态随机存取存储器
lemmas.def_en: a unit of apothecary weight equal to an eighth of an ounce or to 60 grains

examples.en: After a freezing walk in the snow, he craved a dram of whiskey.
examples.zh: 在雪地里冰冷地漫步之后，他渴望喝上一小口威士忌。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dram 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: one of the minor orders in the unreformed Western Church but now suppressed in the Roman Catholic Church

examples.en: Locals sought the help of an experienced exorcist to cleanse the house.
examples.zh: 当地居民寻求一位经验丰富的驱魔人的帮助来净化这栋房子。

lemmas.def_zh: 驱魔, 驱邪所用的咒语
lemmas.def_en: freeing from evil spirits

examples.en: The priest performed a solemn exorcism to drive the evil presence away.
examples.zh: 神父举行了庄严的驱魔仪式以驱逐邪灵。

lemmas.def_en: expel through adjuration or prayers

examples.en: exorcise evil spirits

lemmas.def_zh: 拔除, 除怪, 驱邪, 从...驱除妖魔, (用咒语)驱除(妖魔)
lemmas.def_en: expel through adjuration or prayers

examples.en: The priest was summoned to exorcize the dark entity dwelling inside the house.
examples.zh: 牧师被召来驱逐盘踞在这座房子里的邪恶幽灵。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 exorcist 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 急赶, 急跑, 急转
lemmas.def_en: to move about or proceed hurriedly

examples.en: Mice scurried across the kitchen floor as soon as the light was turned on.
examples.zh: 灯一打开，老鼠就匆匆穿过厨房地板逃窜。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 急促奔跑的，疾走的
lemmas.def_en: moving hurriedly with quick, short steps
lemmas.usage_note: 通常作定语修饰小动物、昆虫或匆忙的人群，常描绘生动画面，如 scurrying mice 或 scurrying commuters。

examples.en: We heard the scurrying sounds of mice behind the pantry wall.
examples.zh: 我们听到了储藏室墙后老鼠急促窜动的声音。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 scurry 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an attendant at the court of a sovereign

examples.en: The ambitious courtier flattered the king daily in hopes of gaining political influence.
examples.zh: 野心勃勃的侍臣每天奉承国王，希望能获得政治影响力。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 courtier 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: to overflow like a geyser

examples.en: Water geysered out of the broken pipe, flooding the entire street within minutes.
examples.zh: 水从破裂的管道中如间歇泉般喷涌而出，几分钟内就淹没了整条街。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 geyser 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: force into some kind of situation, condition, or course of action

examples.en: He tried to stay neutral, but he was soon embroiled in the bitter dispute.
examples.zh: 他试图保持中立，但很快就卷入了这场激烈的纷争之中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 embroil 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 费用, 经费, 支出
lemmas.def_en: the act of spending or disbursing money

examples.en: The new project requires a significant initial outlay of capital for raw materials.
examples.zh: 这个新项目需要一大笔初始资金支出来采购原材料。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 outlay 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a long fishing line with many shorter lines and hooks attached to it (usually suspended between buoys)

examples.en: The fishermen slowly hauled the heavy trawl back onto the deck after hours.
examples.zh: 数小时后，渔民们慢慢将沉重的拖网拉回到甲板上。

lemmas.def_en: fish with trawlers

examples.en: The fishermen slowly hauled the heavy trawl back onto the deck after hours.
examples.zh: 数小时后，渔民们慢慢将沉重的拖网拉回到甲板上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 trawl 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: run away secretly with one's beloved

examples.en: Knowing their parents would disapprove, the young couple decided to elope to Scotland.
examples.zh: 知道父母会反对，这对年轻情侣决定私奔去苏格兰。

lemmas.def_en: the act of running away with a lover (usually to get married)

family_guide.root_logic: 以 elope 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 字面, 字体, 印出的文字(或图样)

examples.en: The graphic designer selected a clean modern typeface for the new company logo.
examples.zh: 平面设计师为公司的新标志选择了一款干净现代的字体。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 typeface 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: lose velocity; move more slowly

examples.en: You need to decelerate gradually as you approach the sharp curve ahead.
examples.zh: 接近前方急转弯时，你需要逐渐减速。

examples.en: the deceleration of the arms race

family_guide.root_logic: 以 decelerate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: become liquid

examples.en: Extreme heat will liquefy the solid plastic blocks in just a few minutes.
examples.zh: 极高的温度会在短短几分钟内使坚硬的塑料块液化。

lemmas.def_zh: 液化, 溶解, 液化作用
lemmas.def_en: the conversion of a solid or a gas into a liquid

examples.en: The massive earthquake triggered severe soil liquefaction, causing buildings to tilt dangerously.
examples.zh: 强烈地震引发了严重的土壤液化，导致建筑物危险地倾斜。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 liquefy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an ornamental sunken panel in a ceiling or dome

examples.zh: 旅游收入的持续下降严重耗尽了该市的金库。

lemmas.def_zh: 火蜥蜴, 火怪, 耐火的人

examples.zh: 一只小小的斑点火蜥蜴在潮湿腐烂的原木下静静地缓慢爬行。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 salamander 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 音系学, 历时音系学
lemmas.def_en: the study of the sound system of a given language and the analysis and classification of its phonemes

examples.en: The introductory course explores the phonology and sound systems of various world languages.
examples.zh: 这门入门课程探讨了世界各种语言的音系学和语音系统。

lemmas.def_zh: 音位学的, 音韵学的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to phonology

examples.en: the phonological component of language

family_guide.root_logic: 以 phonology 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 公布, 布告, 张帖, 贴海报于

examples.zh: 活动人士在城墙上张贴海报，要求就气候变化立即采取行动。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 placard 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of various types of fold formed by doubling fabric back upon itself and then pressing or stitching into shape

examples.zh: 在参加典礼之前，她仔细熨烫了裙子上的每一个褶子。

lemmas.def_en: pleat or gather into a ruffle

examples.en: She ironed each pleat of her skirt carefully before attending the ceremony.
examples.zh: 在参加典礼之前，她仔细熨烫了裙子上的每一个褶子。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pleat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 微型集成电路片, 微片, 芯片

examples.en: Modern vehicles rely on dozens of microchips to control essential safety features smoothly.
examples.zh: 现代汽车依靠数十个芯片来平稳控制关键的安全功能。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 microchip 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 贴边, 鞭痕, 殴打

examples.zh: 那记重击在他右臂上留下一道疼痛的红肿鞭痕。

lemmas.def_en: beat severely with a whip or rod

examples.en: The harsh blow left a painful red welt across his right arm.
examples.zh: 那记重击在他右臂上留下一道疼痛的红肿鞭痕。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 welt 为核心的派生词族。

examples.zh: 明亮的三角旗在屋顶边缘迎风飘扬。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pennant 为核心的派生词族。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 eon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 回答, 反扑, 退还

examples.zh: 这名腐败官员因收受承包商的巨额回扣而被逮捕。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 kickback 为核心的派生词族。

examples.zh: 一个高大的黄铜蜡烛架立在木制餐桌的中央。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 candlestick 为核心的派生词族。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 firecracker 为核心的派生词族。

examples.zh: 反派策划了一个极其邪恶的阴谋来控制这座城市。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 diabolical 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a punctuation mark (-) used between parts of a compound word or between the syllables of a word when the word is divided at the end of a line of text

examples.zh: 你需要在两词之间加一个连字符以避免混淆。

divide or connect with a hyphen

examples.zh: 你需要在两词之间加一个连字符以避免混淆。

examples.en: hyphenate these words and names

examples.zh: 山间小道曲折穿行在陡峭多石的斜坡上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 zigzag 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: one who adheres to traditional views

examples.zh: 作为严格的传统主义者，他更喜欢手写信而非电子消息。

lemmas.def_en: strict adherence to traditional methods or teachings

examples.en: The rural village retains its cultural traditionalism despite rapid modern urban development.
examples.zh: 尽管现代城市快速发展，这个乡村小镇仍保留着文化传统主义。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or resembling a square

examples.zh: 数学老师要求学生们解出这道复杂的二次方程。

examples.zh: 数学老师要求学生们解出这道复杂的二次方程。

examples.zh: 该实验室使用分光计来分析恒星的化学成分。

examples.zh: 该豪车品牌以其卓越的工程水准闻名世界。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 marque 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: harsh or corrosive in tone

examples.zh: 迷路的小羊在开阔的田野上发出可怜的咩咩叫声。

lemmas.def_en: cry plaintively

examples.en: The lost lamb let out a pitiful baa across the open field.
examples.zh: 迷路的小羊在开阔的田野上发出可怜的咩咩叫声。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 baa 为核心的派生词族。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 osteoporosis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 爷爷, 老太爷, 外公

examples.zh: 我爷爷喜欢分享他年轻时在乡村的精彩故事。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 grandad 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the best of its kind

examples.en: The prime minister gave the company primo seats at the cultural festival.
examples.zh: 首相在文化节上为该公司安排了最顶级的席位。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 primo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 无比的, 不能比较的

family_guide.root_logic: 以 juggernaut 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: very slow in tempo and broad in manner

lemmas.def_en: fine ravellings of cotton or linen fibers

lemmas.def_en: fishes having large mouths with a wormlike filament attached for luring prey

examples.zh: 我们在超市买了几款乐天生产的热门巧克力零食。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lotte 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: hard dark reddish wood of a rosewood tree having a strongly marked grain; used in cabinetwork

examples.zh: 这张古董餐桌是用坚固优质的红木精心制作的。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rosewood 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: elegant and sumptuous

examples.zh: 这家精品酒店拥有大理石浴室和真丝床单，格调奢华。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 luxe 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: shrubby plant with aromatic greyish-green leaves used as a cooking herb

examples.zh: 拉蒙纳清晨在其他人醒来前悄悄收拾好了行李。

lemmas.def_en: toward the outside

lemmas.def_zh: 负担, 责任, 义务, 过失, 耻辱
lemmas.def_en: an onerous or difficult concern

examples.en: The onus is on the prosecution to prove the defendant's guilt beyond doubt.
examples.zh: 举证证明被告有罪的责任在于控方。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 onus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the branch of genetics that studies organisms in terms of their genomes (their full DNA sequences)

examples.en: Recent advances in genomics have revolutionized our understanding of inherited rare diseases.
examples.zh: 基因组学的最新进展彻底改变了我们对罕见遗传病的理解。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 genomics 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a type of cell death in which the cell uses specialized cellular machinery to kill itself; a cell suicide mechanism that enables metazoans to control cell number and eliminate cells that threaten the animal's survival

examples.en: Defects in the regulation of apoptosis can lead to uncontrolled cell proliferation.
examples.zh: 细胞凋亡调控的缺陷会导致细胞不受控制地增殖。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 apoptosis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an abnormal state in which the normal flow of a liquid (such as blood) is slowed or stopped

examples.en: The long period of political stasis finally ended after the national elections.
examples.zh: 长期的政治停滞状态在全国大选后终于结束了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stasis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 神秘的, 晦涩难解的
lemmas.def_en: requiring secret or mysterious knowledge

examples.en: He spent decades deciphering the arcane rules of medieval legal manuscripts.
examples.zh: 他花了数十年时间破译中世纪法律手稿中晦涩难懂的规则。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 arcane 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a shop where men can get their hair cut

examples.en: Old men gathered at the corner barbershop to discuss the morning news.
examples.zh: 老人们聚集在街角的理发店里讨论早间新闻。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 barbershop 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or pertaining to the adrenal glands or their secretions

examples.en: Stress triggers the adrenal glands to release adrenaline into the bloodstream rapidly.
examples.zh: 压力会促使肾上腺迅速向血液中释放肾上腺素。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 adrenal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 向后, 朝后, 突然, 船顶风地
lemmas.def_en: having the wind against the forward side of the sails

examples.en: I was taken aback by her sudden decision to quit her stable job.
examples.zh: 她突然决定辞去稳定的工作，这让我大吃一惊。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 aback 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (大学一年级男生或儿童等戴的)无檐小便帽
lemmas.def_en: a small skullcap; formerly worn by schoolboys and college freshmen

examples.en: He pulled his woolen beanie down low to protect his ears from the cold wind.
examples.zh: 他把羊毛无檐帽拉得很低，以挡住刺骨的寒风。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 beanie 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an authoritative command or request

examples.en: The special inquiry was launched at the direct behest of the prime minister.
examples.zh: 特别调查是在首相的直接命令下展开的。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 behest 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the activity of recording business transactions

examples.en: Accurate bookkeeping is essential for keeping track of a small business's daily cash flow.
examples.zh: 准确的簿记对于掌握小型企业的日常现金流至关重要。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bookkeeping 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a hill near Jerusalem where Jesus was crucified

examples.en: Pilgrims climbed the steep hill to visit the traditional site of Calvary.
examples.zh: 朝圣者爬上陡峭的山坡，参观传统的骷髅地遗址。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 calvary 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of affording easy familiarity and sociability

examples.en: A genuine sense of camaraderie quickly developed among the members of the expedition team.
examples.zh: 探险队员之间很快建立起一种真挚的同志情谊。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 camaraderie 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to the cranium which encloses the brain

examples.en: The surgeon monitored cranial pressure carefully throughout the complex neurological procedure.
examples.zh: 在复杂的神经科手术中，外科医生仔细监测着颅内压。

lemmas.def_en: the part of the skull that encloses the brain

examples.en: The helmet is designed to protect the cranium from severe blunt trauma.
examples.zh: 这款头盔旨在保护颅骨免受严重的钝器创伤。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cranial 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a computer network consisting of a worldwide network of computer networks that use the TCP/IP network protocols to facilitate data transmission and exchange

examples.en: Modern criminals increasingly exploit cyberspace to steal personal and financial information.
examples.zh: 现代罪犯越来越多地利用网络空间窃取个人和财务信息。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cyberspace 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a material such as glass or porcelain with negligible electrical or thermal conductivity

examples.en: Ceramic materials are widely used as a reliable dielectric in high-voltage capacitors.
examples.zh: 陶瓷材料在高压电容器中被广泛用作可靠的电介质。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dielectric 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: believed or reputed to be the case

examples.en: The manuscript was purportedly written by a monk in the twelfth century.
examples.zh: 据说这份手稿是12世纪的一位僧侣所写。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 purportedly 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: edge of a way or road or path

examples.en: Wild flowers grew in abundance along the dusty wayside of the country road.
examples.zh: 乡村小路尘土飞扬的路旁盛开着许多野花。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wayside 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 没有受伤的, 未受损伤的
lemmas.def_en: not injured

examples.en: Miraculously, all passengers walked away completely unscathed after the violent car crash.
examples.zh: 奇迹般的是，所有乘客在猛烈的车祸后都毫发无损地脱险了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 unscathed 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: hard volcanic rock composed of compacted volcanic ash

examples.en: Ancient inhabitants carved their homes directly into the soft volcanic tuff.
examples.zh: 古代居民直接在柔软的火山凝灰岩中开凿房屋。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tuff 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to ethnography

examples.en: The researcher spent a year conducting ethnographic fieldwork in a remote mountain village.
examples.zh: 研究人员在偏远山村进行了一年的人种志田野调查。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ethnographic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: outside the regular academic curriculum

examples.en: She balances her demanding studies with several rewarding extracurricular sports activities.
examples.zh: 她在繁重的学业与多项有益的课外体育活动之间保持平衡。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 extracurricular 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a box or chest or cabinet for holding hand tools

examples.en: He grabbed his metal toolbox from the garage to fix the leaking kitchen sink.
examples.zh: 他从车库拿来金属工具箱修理漏水的厨房水槽。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 toolbox 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: resembling milk in color not clear

examples.en: A whitish powdery mold began to spread across the surface of the old bread.
examples.zh: 一种发白的粉状霉菌开始在旧面包表面蔓延。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 whitish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 被风吹落的果子, 横财
lemmas.def_en: fruit that has fallen from the tree

examples.en: She wisely used the unexpected financial windfall to pay off her remaining student loans.
examples.zh: 她明智地利用这笔意外之财还清了剩余的学生贷款。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 windfall 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 视力测定(法), 验光配镜(法)
lemmas.def_en: the practice of an optometrist

examples.en: Advances in modern optometry have made eye examinations faster and much more precise.
examples.zh: 现代验光学的发展使眼科检查更快、更精确。

lemmas.def_en: a person skilled in testing for defects of vision in order to prescribe corrective glasses

family_guide.root_logic: 以 optometry 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: something that bulges out or is protuberant or projects from its surroundings

examples.en: Sharp rocks jut out into the ocean, creating a hazard for passing boats.
examples.zh: 锋利的岩石伸入大海，给过往船只造成了隐患。

lemmas.def_en: extend out or project in space

examples.en: Sharp rocks jut out into the ocean, creating a hazard for passing boats.
examples.zh: 锋利的岩石伸入大海，给过往船只造成了隐患。

lemmas.def_en: extending out above or beyond a surface or boundary; protruding
lemmas.usage_note: 常用于描述地形、建筑物或面部特征，如 jutting rocks, jutting chin。

examples.en: The castle was perched precariously on a jutting cliff above the sea.
examples.zh: 城堡险峻地坐落在海面上一座突出的悬崖边缘。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 jut 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: work doggedly or persistently

examples.en: They had to slog through deep mud for hours to reach the campsite.
examples.zh: 他们不得不艰难地跋涉过深泥数小时才到达营地。

lemmas.def_zh: 猛击者, 顽强地工作的人, 顽强地行进的人
lemmas.def_en: someone who walks in a laborious heavy-footed manner

family_guide.root_logic: 以 slog 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: undo the ties of

examples.en: His fingers were so cold that he could barely untie his wet shoelaces.
examples.zh: 他的手指冻得几乎解不开湿透的鞋带。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 untie 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a self-righteous or sanctimonious person

examples.en: He was exposed as a self-righteous pharisee preaching rules he never followed.
examples.zh: 他被揭露为一个自以为是的伪君子，宣扬自己从不遵守的规矩。

lemmas.def_en: excessively or hypocritically pious

examples.en: a sickening sanctimonious smile

lemmas.def_zh: 遵守表面教义的, 重虚礼的, 伪善的
lemmas.def_en: excessively or hypocritically pious

examples.en: a sickening sanctimonious smile

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pharisee 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 定界, 分开, 区别
lemmas.def_en: separate clearly, as if by boundaries

examples.en: A simple wooden fence was built to demarcate the boundary between the properties.
examples.zh: 修建了一道简单的木栅栏来划分两处地产的界线。

lemmas.def_zh: 划界, 定界, 限界
lemmas.def_en: the boundary of a specific area

family_guide.root_logic: 以 demarcate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 覆盖物, 护根, 根篱
lemmas.def_en: a protective covering of rotting vegetable matter spread to reduce evaporation and soil erosion

examples.en: Spread a thick layer of organic mulch around the plants to conserve soil moisture.
examples.zh: 在植物周围铺一层厚厚的有机覆盖物以保持土壤水分。

lemmas.def_en: cover with mulch

examples.en: Spread a thick layer of organic mulch around the plants to conserve soil moisture.
examples.zh: 在植物周围铺一层厚厚的有机覆盖物以保持土壤水分。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mulch 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the upper part of a glacier (beyond the limit of perpetual snow) where the snow turns to ice

examples.en: Climbers carefully crossed the vast expanse of neve beneath the summit glacier.
examples.zh: 登山者小心翼翼地穿过了山顶冰川下方广阔的冰原。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 neve 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an athletic competition in which a javelin is thrown as far as possible

examples.en: The Olympic athlete broke the world record with an incredible javelin throw.
examples.zh: 这位奥运选手以一次令人难以置信的标枪投掷打破了世界纪录。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 javelin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a soldier in the paratroops

examples.en: The paratrooper checked his gear carefully before jumping into the dark sky.
examples.zh: 这名伞兵在跳入黑夜前仔细检查了自己的装备。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 paratrooper 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: large long-armed ape of Borneo and Sumatra having arboreal habits

examples.en: The baby orangutan clung tightly to its mother high in the canopy.
examples.zh: 幼年猩猩紧紧抱在树冠高处的母亲身上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 orangutan 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: easily approached

examples.en: Please verify whether the remote server is still reachable after the update.
examples.zh: 请核实系统更新后远程服务器是否依然可达。

lemmas.def_zh: 不能到达的, 不能得到的
lemmas.def_en: inaccessibly located or situated

examples.en: an unapproachable chalet high in the mountains
an unreachable canyon

family_guide.root_logic: 以 reachable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a mood or display of sullen aloofness or withdrawal

examples.en: After losing the game, the boy went into a deep sulk.
examples.zh: 输掉比赛后，那个男孩陷入了极度的闷闷不乐中。

lemmas.def_en: a light two-wheeled vehicle for one person; drawn by one horse

lemmas.def_zh: 不高兴, 闷闷不乐, 不悦, 生气, 愠怒
lemmas.def_en: be in a huff and display one's displeasure

examples.en: After losing the game, the boy went into a deep sulk.
examples.zh: 输掉比赛后，那个男孩陷入了极度的闷闷不乐中。

lemmas.def_zh: 乖戾地, 悻悻然, 闷闷不乐地
lemmas.def_en: in a sulky manner

examples.en: `What else could I do?' said Graham sulkily

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sulk 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a tower for guiding pilots or marking the turning point in a race

examples.en: A massive electricity pylon collapsed in the storm, cutting power to thousands.
examples.zh: 暴风雨中一座巨大的输电铁塔倒塌，导致数千人断电。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pylon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: glyptic art in the form of a symbolic figure carved or incised in relief

examples.en: The font file does not contain a valid glyph for this character.
examples.zh: 该字体文件缺少代表这个字符的有效字形符号。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 glyph 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a person who makes deceitful pretenses

examples.en: The doctor turned out to be an imposter with fake medical degrees.
examples.zh: 那名医生原来是个持有伪造医学学位的骗子。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 imposter 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 通告者, 预告者, 先驱, 预兆
lemmas.def_en: something that precedes and indicates the approach of something or someone

examples.en: The sudden drop in temperature was a clear harbinger of coming winter.
examples.zh: 气温的骤降是寒冬即将来临的明显预兆。

lemmas.def_en: foreshadow or presage

examples.en: The sudden drop in temperature was a clear harbinger of coming winter.
examples.zh: 气温的骤降是寒冬即将来临的明显预兆。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 harbinger 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 政体, 国体, 政治组织
lemmas.def_en: the form of government of a social organization

examples.en: Citizens within a democratic polity have the right to challenge government decisions.
examples.zh: 民主政体中的公民有权质疑政府的各项决策。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 polity 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a traveler who rides a motorcycle

examples.en: Every motorcyclist must wear a certified helmet when riding on the highway.
examples.zh: 每位摩托车骑手在公路上骑行时都必须佩戴合格的头盔。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 motorcyclist 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a compound of sulphur and some other element that is more electropositive

examples.en: The hot springs emit an intense odor caused by dissolved hydrogen sulfide.
examples.zh: 温泉散发出一股由溶解的硫化氢引起的强烈气味。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sulfide 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the terminal section of the alimentary canal; from the sigmoid flexure to the anus

examples.en: The surgeon examined the lower part of the rectum for abnormal tissue.
examples.zh: 外科医生检查了直肠下部是否存在异常组织。

lemmas.def_en: of or involving the rectum

examples.en: The nurse measured the infant's body temperature using a precise rectal thermometer.
examples.zh: 护士用精准的直肠温度计测量了婴儿的体温。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rectum 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or belonging to the class Crustacea

examples.en: The crab is a marine crustacean known for its hard protective exoskeleton.
examples.zh: 螃蟹是一种以坚硬的保护性外骨骼闻名的海洋甲壳动物。

lemmas.def_en: any mainly aquatic arthropod usually having a segmented body and chitinous exoskeleton

examples.en: The crab is a marine crustacean known for its hard protective exoskeleton.
examples.zh: 螃蟹是一种以坚硬的保护性外骨骼闻名的海洋甲壳动物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 crustacean 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a woman cowboy

examples.en: The skilled cowgirl guided her horse expertly through the crowded rodeo arena.
examples.zh: 那位技术娴熟的女牛仔熟练地驾马穿过了拥挤的竞技场。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cowgirl 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a small natural hill

examples.en: They enjoyed a sunny picnic on the grassy knoll overlooking the valley.
examples.zh: 他们在俯瞰山谷的长满青草的小圆丘上享受着阳光野餐。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 knoll 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (文件)解密, 从机密表删除
lemmas.def_en: lift the restriction on and make available again

examples.en: The government decided to declassify the secret military files after fifty years.
examples.zh: 五十年后，政府决定解密这些秘密军事档案。

lemmas.def_zh: (文件)解密, 从机密表删除
lemmas.def_en: reduction or removal by the government of restrictions on a classified document or weapon

examples.en: Historians eagerly awaited the declassification of wartime intelligence files by the government.
examples.zh: 历史学家们热切期待政府对战时情报文件的解密。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 declassify 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: pot for brewing tea; usually has a spout and handle

examples.en: Steam rose steadily from the spout of the freshly boiled ceramic teapot.
examples.zh: 刚烧好的陶瓷茶壶壶嘴里平稳地冒出热气。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 teapot 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: ice cream or water ice on a small wooden stick

examples.en: The melting fruit popsicle dripped sticky juice all over the child's hands.
examples.zh: 融化的水果冰棍把黏糊糊的汁水滴满了孩子的手。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 popsicle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an armored vehicle or tank

examples.en: The museum displays a restored German panzer used during the Second World War.
examples.zh: 该博物馆展出了一辆在二战期间使用过的修复坦克。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 panzer 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a representation of a person (especially in the form of sculpture)

examples.en: Angry protesters burned a paper effigy of the corrupt politician in public.
examples.zh: 愤怒的抗议者在公共场合焚烧了那个腐败政客的纸扎肖像。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 effigy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a socially prominent person

examples.en: The wealthy socialite hosted an extravagant charity gala at her private mansion.
examples.zh: 这位富有的社交名流在自己的私人豪宅举办了一场奢华的慈善晚会。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 socialite 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 无敌的, 无双的, 无可匹敌的, 无比的, 至高无上的, 极好的
lemmas.def_en: eminent beyond or above comparison

examples.en: The museum boasts an unrivaled collection of ancient Roman artifacts and coins.
examples.zh: 该博物馆拥有无可匹敌的古罗马文物和钱币收藏。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 unrivaled 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or characteristic of a particular religious denomination

examples.en: She attended a private denominational school run by the local church community.
examples.zh: 她就读于一所由当地教会管理的私立宗派学校。

lemmas.def_zh: 不限于一宗教宗派的, 与宗教宗派无关的
lemmas.def_en: not restricted to a particular religious denomination

examples.en: a nondenominational church

lemmas.def_en: with respect to denomination

examples.en: denominationally diverse audiences

family_guide.root_logic: 以 denominational 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: extend on all sides of simultaneously; encircle

examples.en: Towering snow-capped peaks environ the remote village on almost every side.
examples.zh: 高耸的雪峰几乎从四面环绕着这个偏远村庄。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 environ 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: highly seasoned fatty sausage of pork and beef usually dried

examples.en: He made a simple lunch with sliced salami, sharp cheddar, and crackers.
examples.zh: 他用切片萨拉米香肠、浓切达奶酪和薄脆饼干做了顿简单的午餐。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 salami 为核心的派生词族。
