lemmas.def_en: an acute contagious viral disease characterized by fever and by swelling of the parotid glands

examples.en: The child stayed home from school after being diagnosed with mumps.
examples.zh: 那名儿童被确诊患有流行性腮腺炎后便留在家中休养。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mumps 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: American plants closely resembling Old World mistletoe

examples.en: They hung a sprig of mistletoe above the dining room doorway for Christmas.
examples.zh: 他们在餐厅门口上方挂了一小枝槲寄生以庆祝圣诞节。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mistletoe 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 杂技演员的, 杂技的
lemmas.def_en: vigorously active

examples.en: The dancers amazed the audience with their daring acrobatic stunts and flips.
examples.zh: 舞者们凭借大胆的杂技特技和空翻惊艳了全场观众。

lemmas.def_en: the gymnastic moves of an acrobat

examples.en: The audience gasped at the daring aerial acrobatics performed by the circus.
examples.zh: 观众对马戏团表演的惊险空中杂技发出惊叹。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 acrobatic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a muscular sac attached to the liver that stores bile (secreted by the liver) until it is needed for digestion

examples.en: The surgeon successfully removed the inflamed gallbladder during a routine procedure.
examples.zh: 外科医生在一次常规手术中成功切除了发炎的胆囊。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gallbladder 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: express admiration and pleasure by uttering `ooh' or `aah'

examples.en: The crowd began to ooh and aah at the dazzling fireworks display.
examples.zh: 人群对着耀眼的烟火表演开始发出赞叹之声。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 aah 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 昏睡的, 昏睡状态的
lemmas.def_en: relating to or associated with a coma

examples.en: The accident victim remained comatose in the intensive care unit for days.
examples.zh: 这名事故伤者在重症监护室里昏迷了数日。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 comatose 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of a series of univalent groups of the general formula CnH2n+1 derived from aliphatic hydrocarbons

examples.en: Chemists attached an alkyl group to the molecule to increase its solubility.
examples.zh: 化学家在分子上连接了一个烷基以增加其溶解度。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 alkyl 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an oriental tobacco pipe with a long flexible tube connected to a container where the smoke is cooled by passing through water

examples.en: They sat comfortably on the patio, sharing a fruit-flavored hookah late into the evening.
examples.zh: 他们惬意地坐在露台上，共享果味水烟直到深夜。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hookah 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 两层楼之间的夹层楼面
lemmas.def_en: first or lowest balcony

examples.en: We had great view of the entire concert hall from our seats in the mezzanine.
examples.zh: 我们在夹层楼面的座位上可以俯瞰整个音乐厅的全貌。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mezzanine 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the origination and development of a disease

examples.en: Researchers are studying the cellular mechanisms behind the pathogenesis of this rare autoimmune disease.
examples.zh: 研究人员正在探究这种罕见自身免疫性疾病发病背后的细胞机制。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pathogenesis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: science and technology of electronic systems and devices for aeronautics and astronautics

examples.en: The military upgraded the fighter jet with advanced avionics to improve navigational accuracy.
examples.zh: 军方为战斗机升级了先进的航空电子系统，以提高导航精度。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to avionics

examples.en: Engineers upgraded the fighter jet with advanced avionic systems for better combat precision.
examples.zh: 工程师为战斗机升级了先进的航空电子系统，以提高作战精度。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 avionics 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 墨西哥流浪乐队艺人, 墨西哥流浪乐队
lemmas.def_en: a group of street musicians in Mexico

examples.en: A lively mariachi band performed traditional Mexican songs at the outdoor wedding reception.
examples.zh: 一支欢快的墨西哥流浪乐队在户外婚宴上演奏了传统墨西哥歌曲。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mariachi 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a sovereign prince of the former ruling house of Austria

examples.en: The historical museum displayed artifacts belonging to the Austrian archduke from the nineteenth century.
examples.zh: 历史博物馆展出了属于十九世纪奥地利大公的文物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 archduke 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 代表, 委员, 杂货店
lemmas.def_en: a retail store that sells equipment and provisions (usually to military personnel)

examples.en: Soldiers can buy groceries and personal supplies at discounted prices at the base commissary.
examples.zh: 士兵们可以在基地的军人服务社以折扣价购买杂货和个人用品。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 commissary 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 尖锐, (疾病的)剧烈, 敏锐
lemmas.def_en: sharpness of vision; the visual ability to resolve fine detail (usually measured by a Snellen chart)

examples.en: The detective was widely renowned for his exceptional visual acuity and sharp investigative instincts.
examples.zh: 这位侦探以其敏锐的视觉观察力和犀利的侦查直觉而闻名。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 acuity 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 秘密会议, 教皇选举会议, 红衣主教团
lemmas.def_en: a confidential or secret meeting

examples.en: Cardinals from around the world gathered in the historic chapel for the secret papal conclave.
examples.zh: 来自世界各地的红衣主教齐聚在历史悠久的礼拜堂参加教皇秘密选举会议。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 conclave 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 千兆比特, 吉比特（10的9次方比特, 相当于十亿比特的信息单位）
lemmas.def_en: a unit of information equal to 1000 megabits or 10^9 (1,000,000,000) bits

examples.en: The tech company upgraded its office network to provide gigabit speeds for all employees.
examples.zh: 这家科技公司升级了办公网络，为所有员工提供千兆级的连接速度。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gigabit 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (=hadji)赴麦加朝圣过的伊斯兰教徒
lemmas.def_en: an Arabic term of respect for someone who has made the pilgrimage to Mecca

examples.en: After completing his pilgrimage to Mecca, he was respectfully addressed as a haji.
examples.zh: 在完成麦加朝圣后，他被大家尊称为哈吉。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 haji 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 一种矮脚长耳猎犬, 斗鸡的人
lemmas.def_en: a small breed with wavy silky hair; originally developed in England

examples.en: She brushed the silky golden coat of her energetic cocker spaniel after their walk.
examples.zh: 散步回来后，她给精力充沛的可卡犬梳理丝滑的金黄色毛发。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cocker 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 疗养院, 疗养所, 静养地
lemmas.def_en: a hospital for recuperation or for the treatment of chronic diseases

examples.en: In the early twentieth century, many tuberculosis patients rested quietly at this alpine sanatorium.
examples.zh: 二十世纪初，许多肺结核患者在这座高山疗养院静养。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sanatorium 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 火的, 似火的, 火成的
lemmas.def_en: produced under conditions involving intense heat

examples.en: Geologists collected samples of igneous rock formed by cooling lava near the active volcano.
examples.zh: 地质学家在活火山附近采集了由冷却岩浆形成的火成岩样本。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 igneous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: telephone central where circuits are completed with patchcords

examples.en: The operator quickly routed incoming calls through the busy hospital switchboard during the emergency.
examples.zh: 紧急情况下，接线员通过繁忙的医院总机迅速转接呼入电话。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 switchboard 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 难处理的, 笨大难使用的, 笨拙的
lemmas.def_en: difficult to use or handle or manage because of size or weight or shape

examples.en: Carrying the unwieldy wooden crate up the narrow flight of stairs required three people.
examples.zh: 把笨重庞大的木箱搬上狭窄的楼梯需要三个人。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 unwieldy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: linear distance between the extremities of an airfoil

examples.en: The wandering albatross has the largest wingspan of any living bird, exceeding eleven feet.
examples.zh: 漂泊信天翁拥有现存鸟类中最大的翼展，超过十一英尺。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wingspan 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 惊愕, 恐怖, 惊惶失措
lemmas.def_en: fear resulting from the awareness of danger

examples.en: The sudden cancellation of the popular music festival caused widespread consternation among ticket holders.
examples.zh: 流行音乐节的突然取消让购票者们大为惊愕和失望。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 consternation 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a radioactive isotope of carbon

examples.en: Scientists used radiocarbon dating to determine the precise age of the ancient wooden artifact.
examples.zh: 科学家利用放射性碳定年法确定了这件古代木制文物的确切年代。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 radiocarbon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the 17th letter of the Greek alphabet

examples.en: The physics professor drew the Greek letter rho on the board to represent density.
examples.zh: 物理学教授在黑板上写下希腊字母 rho 来表示密度。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rho 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: sufficiently interesting to be reported in a newspaper

examples.en: The editor decided the local charity event was not newsworthy enough for the front page.
examples.zh: 编辑认为这场当地慈善活动的新闻价值不足以登上头版。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of being sufficiently interesting to be reported in news bulletins

examples.en: the judge conceded the newsworthiness of the trial
he is no longer news in the fashion world

family_guide.root_logic: 以 newsworthy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 使休息, 寄托于；休息, 长眠, 静卧, 座落, 依靠, 信赖
lemmas.def_en: put or confide something in a person or thing

examples.en: The weary traveler lay down under the oak tree to repose for an hour.
examples.zh: 疲惫的旅行者在橡树下躺下休息了一个小时。

lemmas.def_zh: 休息, 睡眠, 静止
lemmas.def_en: freedom from activity (work or strain or responsibility)

examples.en: The weary traveler lay down under the oak tree to repose for an hour.
examples.zh: 疲惫的旅行者在橡树下躺下休息了一个小时。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 repose 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any woodland plant of the genus Anemone grown for its beautiful flowers and whorls of dissected leaves

examples.en: A tiny clownfish swam safely among the stinging tentacles of the sea anemone.
examples.zh: 一条小小的海葵鱼在海葵带刺的触手间安全地游动。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 anemone 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the dead skin at the base of a fingernail or toenail

examples.en: Apply moisturizer regularly to prevent the delicate cuticle around your nails from cracking.
examples.zh: 定期涂抹保湿霜，以防指甲周围娇嫩的表皮干裂。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to a cuticle or cuticula

examples.en: A thick cuticular wax layer protects the desert plant from losing excessive moisture.
examples.zh: 厚厚的表皮蜡质层能保护沙漠植物免于散失过多水分。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cuticle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the jaw in vertebrates that is fused to the cranium

examples.en: The surgeon carefully repaired the fracture in the patient's damaged maxilla after the accident.
examples.zh: 事故发生后，外科医生仔细修复了患者受损的上颌骨折。

lemmas.def_en: the jaw in vertebrates that is fused to the cranium

family_guide.root_logic: 以 maxilla 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: put someone through a debriefing and make him report

examples.en: The commander met with the flight crew to debrief them after the rescue mission.
examples.zh: 救援任务结束后，指挥官接见了机组人员以听取任务汇报。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 debrief 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 100 agorot equal 1 shekel in Israel

examples.en: Citizens gathered in the central agora to trade goods and debate new local laws.
examples.zh: 市民们聚集在中央集市上交换货物并辩论新的地方法律。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 agora 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: accumulated earth and stones deposited by a glacier

examples.en: Hikers navigated the rocky moraine left behind by the retreating mountain glacier.
examples.zh: 徒步旅行者穿行在消退的高山冰川所留下的岩石冰碛上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 moraine 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 一块地板, 汽车底部板
lemmas.def_en: a board in the floor

examples.en: A loose floorboard creaked loudly beneath his feet as he crept through the hallway.
examples.zh: 当他悄悄穿过走廊时，脚下一块松动的地板发出了响亮的吱呀声。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 floorboard 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 老一套的, 陈腐的, 用坏的
lemmas.def_en: repeated too often; overfamiliar through overuse

examples.en: His graduation speech relied on trite expressions that failed to inspire the restless audience.
examples.zh: 他的毕业演讲依赖陈腐的辞藻，未能鼓舞焦躁的听众。

lemmas.def_en: unoriginality as a result of being dull and hackneyed

family_guide.root_logic: 以 trite 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a facility where trees and shrubs are cultivated for exhibition

examples.en: We spent a peaceful afternoon exploring rare tree species at the city arboretum.
examples.zh: 我们在城市树木园度过了一个安静的下午，探索稀有的树种。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 arboretum 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 优秀的, 超群的, 卓越的
lemmas.def_en: greatest in importance or degree or significance or achievement

examples.en: She is recognized as the preeminent scholar in the field of modern European history.
examples.zh: 她被公认为是现代欧洲历史领域的卓越学者。

lemmas.def_zh: 卓越地, 杰出地, 超群地
lemmas.def_en: to a preeminent degree; with superiority or distinction above others; in a preeminent manner

examples.en: a wide variety of pre-eminently contemporary scenes

lemmas.def_zh: 杰出, 卓越, 超群
lemmas.def_en: high status importance owing to marked superiority

examples.en: The university maintained its preeminence in medical research through significant private and public funding.
examples.zh: 该大学通过大量的私人和公共资金，保持了其在医学研究领域的卓越地位。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 preeminent 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: frown with displeasure

examples.en: The teacher turned to scowl at the noisy students who were disrupting the class.
examples.zh: 老师转过身，对扰乱课堂秩序的吵闹学生怒目而视。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 scowl 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a ruling on a point of Islamic law that is given by a recognized authority

examples.en: The religious council issued a fatwa regarding the ethical use of new technologies.
examples.zh: 宗教委员会就新技术的伦理使用问题发布了一项教令裁决。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fatwa 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 居民, 外籍居民, 外来语
lemmas.def_en: a person who inhabits a particular place

examples.en: The raccoon has become a familiar nocturnal denizen of many modern suburban neighborhoods.
examples.zh: 浣熊已经成为许多现代郊区社区中人们熟悉的夜间居民。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 denizen 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 特大之物, 弥天大谎
lemmas.def_en: a gross untruth; a blatant lie

examples.en: He told a complete whopper about catching a giant shark during his summer vacation.
examples.zh: 他撒了个弥天大谎，声称自己在暑假期间钓到了一条巨鲨。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 whopper 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a windstorm that lifts up clouds of dust or sand

examples.en: The fierce desert sandstorm reduced visibility to zero within just a few minutes.
examples.zh: 猛烈的沙漠沙暴在短短几分钟内就将能见度降到了零。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sandstorm 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 事先钩成的看法, 成见
lemmas.def_en: an opinion formed beforehand without adequate evidence

examples.en: Traveling abroad often challenges every preconception you held about foreign cultures and lifestyles.
examples.zh: 出国旅行常常会挑战你对外国文化和生活方式持有的所有成见。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 preconception 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: someone who has been admitted to membership in a scholarly field

examples.en: The musical savant could instantly play complex classical pieces after hearing them only once.
examples.zh: 这位音乐奇才仅听一遍就能立刻演奏复杂的古典乐曲。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 savant 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: officer in the (ceremonial) bodyguard of the British monarch

examples.en: The independent yeoman worked his own land tirelessly from sunrise to late evening.
examples.zh: 这位自耕农从日出到深夜不知疲倦地耕作自己的土地。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 yeoman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 奴隶, 束缚, 奴役
lemmas.def_en: the state of being under the control of another person

examples.en: The brilliant young artist remained in thrall to his mentor's overpowering creative influence.
examples.zh: 这位才华横溢的年轻艺术家仍受制于他导师那强大的创作影响。

lemmas.def_zh: 奴隶的身分/地位, 奴役, 束缚
lemmas.def_en: the state of being under the control of another person

family_guide.root_logic: 以 thrall 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: <法>恋爱事件; 风流韵事; 私通； 闹得满城风雨的案件; 社会轶闻
lemmas.def_en: a usually secretive or illicit sexual relationship

examples.en: Their scandalous secret affaire eventually leaked to the press and ruined both careers.
examples.zh: 他们丑闻般的秘密风流韵事最终泄露给媒体，毁了两人的事业。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 affaire 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a public act of denouncing

examples.en: The politician faced severe public denunciation following the sudden exposure of the bribery scandal.
examples.zh: 受贿丑闻突然曝光后，这位政客面临着公众严厉的谴责。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 denunciation 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: having no cause or apparent cause

examples.en: Their fortuitous meeting at the airport coffee shop led to a successful business partnership.
examples.zh: 他们在机场咖啡馆的偶然相遇促成了一段成功的商业合作关系。

lemmas.def_en: by good fortune

examples.en: fortunately the weather was good

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fortuitous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: belief in a single God

examples.en: Judaism was the first major religion in the region to practice strict monotheism.
examples.zh: 犹太教是该地区第一个实行严格一神论的主要宗教。

lemmas.def_en: a believer in one god

examples.en: As a devout monotheist, he firmly believes in the existence of one God.
examples.zh: 作为一名虔诚的一神论者，他坚信独一真神的存在。

lemmas.def_en: believing that there is only one god

family_guide.root_logic: 以 monotheism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a public utility that provides telephone service

examples.en: The national telco announced cheaper data plans to attract more mobile subscribers.
examples.zh: 这家国家电信公司宣布推出更便宜的流量套餐以吸引更多移动用户。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 telco 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a watch that is worn strapped to the wrist

examples.en: He glanced at his wristwatch to check how much time remained before the flight.
examples.zh: 他看了看手表，确认起飞前还剩多少时间。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wristwatch 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 积聚者, 蓄能器, 蓄电池
lemmas.def_en: a person who is employed to collect payments (as for rent or taxes)

examples.en: The solar power system stores excess energy in a heavy-duty hydraulic accumulator.
examples.zh: 该太阳能系统将多余的能量储存在一个重型蓄能器中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 accumulator 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a person who acts as host at formal occasions (makes an introductory speech and introduces other speakers)

examples.en: A local comedian served as the emcee for the annual charity banquet.
examples.zh: 一位当地喜剧演员担任了年度慈善晚宴的司仪。

lemmas.def_en: act as a master of ceremonies

examples.en: A local comedian served as the emcee for the annual charity banquet.
examples.zh: 一位当地喜剧演员担任了年度慈善晚宴的司仪。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 emcee 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: burrowing chiefly nocturnal mammal with body covered with strong horny plates

examples.en: An armadillo crossed the dirt road and quickly curled into a defensive ball.
examples.zh: 一只犰狳穿过泥土路，迅速蜷缩成一个防御球。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 armadillo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: to gather something into small wrinkles or folds

examples.en: The intense sourness of the fresh lemon juice made her mouth pucker instantly.
examples.zh: 新鲜柠檬汁强烈的酸味让她的嘴立刻皱了起来。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pucker 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 混战, 斗狗, 空战, 狗咬狗
lemmas.def_en: a fiercely disputed contest

examples.en: Two stray hounds engaged in a noisy dogfight over an abandoned bone.
examples.zh: 两只流浪狗为了争夺一根丢弃的骨头而激烈厮打。

lemmas.def_zh: 狗打架，狗咬狗；斗狗；【军事】(战斗机的)缠战，近距离激战，空中格斗 [1915]
lemmas.def_en: a fighter pilot who engages in an aerial dogfights
arrange for an illegal dogfight

examples.en: Two stray hounds engaged in a noisy dogfight over an abandoned bone.
examples.zh: 两只流浪狗为了争夺一根丢弃的骨头而激烈厮打。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dogfight 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 奉承者, 谄媚者, 追随者
lemmas.def_en: a person who tries to please someone in order to gain a personal advantage

examples.en: The arrogant director was surrounded by sycophants who praised his every foolish idea.
examples.zh: 这位傲慢的导演身边围满了谄媚者，对他每个愚蠢的想法都大加赞赏。

lemmas.def_zh: 追随, 奉承, 谄媚
lemmas.def_en: fawning obsequiousness

lemmas.def_zh: 说奉承话的, 阿谀的
lemmas.def_en: attempting to win favor from influential people by flattery

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sycophant 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 荆棘, 悬钩子属植物, 黑莓
lemmas.def_en: any of various rough thorny shrubs or vines

examples.en: Sharp brambles tore at our jackets as we hiked through the dense woods.
examples.zh: 当我们徒步穿过茂密的树林时，锋利的荆棘刮破了我们的夹克。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bramble 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 风信子, 风信子石, 红锆石
lemmas.def_en: a red transparent variety of zircon used as a gemstone

examples.en: Fragrant purple hyacinths bloomed along the stone garden path in early spring.
examples.zh: 初春时节，芳香的紫色风信子沿着石砌花园小径竞相绽放。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hyacinth 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 沙礁, 珊瑚礁, 沙洲
lemmas.def_en: a coral reef off the southern coast of Florida

examples.en: The chartered boat dropped anchor off a tiny, uninhabited coral cay.
examples.zh: 包租的船只在一个无人居住的微小珊瑚沙洲附近抛锚。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cay 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 躺在...上面, 压在...上面, 盖得使窒息, 压得...闷死
lemmas.def_en: lie upon; lie on top of

examples.en: Thick layers of sedimentary rock overlie the ancient volcanic formations in this region.
examples.zh: 厚厚的沉积岩层覆压在该地区古老的火山岩层之上。

lemmas.def_en: lie upon; lie on top of

examples.en: the granite overlies the older rocks

family_guide.root_logic: 以 overlie 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an angel of the first order; usually portrayed as the winged head of a child

examples.en: The cathedral ceiling featured a vibrant fresco depicting a six-winged seraph.
examples.zh: 大教堂的天花板上有一幅生动的壁画，描绘了一尊六翼天使。

lemmas.def_zh: 六翼天使的, 天使一般的, 纯洁的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to an angel of the first order

examples.en: he imagined a seraphic presence in the room

family_guide.root_logic: 以 seraph 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 悸动, 心跳, 发抖
lemmas.def_en: cause to throb or beat rapidly

examples.en: His heart began to palpitate wildly as he stepped onto the speaking stage.
examples.zh: 当他走上演讲台时，他的心开始剧烈地跳动起来。

lemmas.def_zh: 悸动, 跳动, 心跳
lemmas.def_en: a rapid and irregular heart beat

family_guide.root_logic: 以 palpitate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不许可的, 不能承认的
lemmas.def_en: not deserving to be admitted

examples.en: The judge ruled that the illegally obtained recordings were inadmissible as evidence.
examples.zh: 法官裁定，非法获取的录音不能作为法庭证据。

lemmas.def_zh: 不能许可的事, 难承认的事
lemmas.def_en: unacceptability as a consequence of not being admissible

family_guide.root_logic: 以 inadmissible 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 裂口, 裂缝, 弱点, 叮当声

examples.en: A thin chink of morning light penetrated the heavy wooden window shutters.

lemmas.def_zh: 使叮当响；堵裂缝, 叮当响
lemmas.def_en: make or emit a high sound

examples.en: A thin chink of morning light penetrated the heavy wooden window shutters.
examples.zh: 一缕细微的晨光透过沉重的木制百叶窗缝隙照了进来。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chink 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 掉队, 落伍, 蔓延, 散乱
lemmas.def_en: wander from a direct or straight course

examples.en: Exhausted runners began to straggle across the finish line hours after the winner.
examples.zh: 在获胜者冲线数小时后，筋疲力尽的跑者们开始稀稀拉拉地跑过终点。

lemmas.def_zh: 游荡者, 朱经请假擅离船舰的人员, 掉队者
lemmas.def_en: someone who strays or falls behind

lemmas.def_zh: 蔓延的, 散落的, 散乱的
lemmas.def_en: spreading out in different directions

examples.en: A few straggly bushes grew along the edge of the abandoned stone quarry.
examples.zh: 废弃的采石场边缘生长着几丛杂乱蔓生的灌木。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 straggle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 眺望星辰, 耽入梦想, 做白日梦
lemmas.def_en: observe the stars

examples.en: We drove far from the city lights to stargaze under a clear night sky.
examples.zh: 我们驱车远离城市灯火，在晴朗的夜空下眺望星辰。

lemmas.def_zh: 看星星的人, 占星师, 天文学家
lemmas.def_en: someone indifferent to the busy world

examples.en: in the Odyssey Homer tells of lotus-eaters who live in dreamy indolence

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stargaze 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: expressing disapproval

examples.en: The term was originally neutral, but it gradually acquired a strong pejorative meaning.
examples.zh: 这个词最初是中性的，但后来逐渐带有强烈的贬损意味。

lemmas.def_en: in a pejorative manner

examples.en: I am not using the word pejoratively

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pejorative 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a usually malignant tumor arising from connective tissue (bone or muscle etc.); one of the four major types of cancer

examples.en: Early detection allowed the surgeon to remove the rare soft-tissue sarcoma safely.
examples.zh: 早期发现使外科医生能够安全切除这种罕见的软组织肉瘤。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sarcoma 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the froth produced by soaps or detergents

lemmas.def_en: beat severely with a whip or rod

examples.en: Rub the soap bar gently until a thick, creamy lather begins to form.
examples.zh: 轻轻揉搓肥皂，直到形成浓密细腻的泡沫。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lather 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: deep and harsh sounding as if from shouting or illness or emotion; ; ; ; - Virgil Thomson

examples.en: After cheering for hours at the concert, her voice became completely hoarse.
examples.zh: 在音乐会上欢呼了几个小时后，她的嗓音彻底沙哑了。

lemmas.def_en: in a hoarse or husky voice

examples.en: `Excuse me,' he said hoarsely

lemmas.def_en: a throaty harshness

lemmas.def_en: severe spasm of pain

examples.zh: 这家苦苦挣扎的公司发现自己陷入了破产的痛苦挣扎之中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 throe 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: turn pale, as if in fear

examples.en: Her face blanched with sudden terror when she heard the loud explosion outside.
examples.zh: 听到外面巨大的爆炸声，她的脸色顿时吓得惨白。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 blanch 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: small round bright-colored and spotted beetle that usually feeds on aphids and other insect pests

examples.zh: 一只鲜红的瓢虫轻轻落在我花园里柔软的绿叶上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ladybug 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 假装学者, 卖弄学问, 迂腐
lemmas.def_en: an ostentatious and inappropriate display of learning

examples.zh: 在随意的谈话中，他没完没了的书呆子气让房间里的每个人都感到厌烦。

lemmas.def_zh: 自夸学问的人, 空谈家, 书呆子
lemmas.def_en: a person who pays more attention to formal rules and book learning than they merit

examples.en: Nobody enjoyed talking to the pedant because he constantly corrected everyone's trivial mistakes.
examples.zh: 没人喜欢和那个书呆子聊天，因为他总是纠正别人微不足道的错误。

lemmas.def_zh: 卖弄学问的, 学究式的, 假装学者的
lemmas.def_en: marked by a narrow focus on or display of learning especially its trivial aspects

examples.zh: 作为一对富裕的丁克夫妇，他们每年都喜欢出国旅行几次。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dink 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a small tent used as a dressing room beside the sea or a swimming pool

examples.en: We rented a private beach cabana to relax comfortably away from the burning sun.
examples.zh: 我们租了一间海滩小屋，好远离烈日舒适地放松。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cabana 为核心的派生词族。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bloodhound 为核心的派生词族。

examples.zh: 他对人种学的浓厚兴趣促使他去研究整个南美洲的土著部落。

lemmas.def_zh: 民族学者, 人种学者

of or relating to ethnology

examples.en: ethnological field work

lemmas.def_zh: 步履不稳地走动, 踉跄, 摇晃, 摇摆不定, 摇摇欲坠, 玩跷跷板
lemmas.def_en: move unsteadily, with a rocking motion

examples.zh: 那叠高高易碎的盘子开始在桌边危险地晃动起来。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 teeter 为核心的派生词族。

examples.zh: 历史博物馆展出了一具战争期间步兵部队使用过的重型喷火器。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 flamethrower 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: maneuvers of a horse in response to body signals by the rider

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or completing a period of 200 years

examples.zh: 全镇的人聚集在广场上，庆祝该镇的两百周年纪念游行。

lemmas.def_zh: 干河床, 河道, 干谷, 流经干谷的溪流

examples.zh: 沙漠暴雨期间，干燥的干河床可能会突然变成汹涌的急流。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 weeknight 为核心的派生词族。

examples.zh: 他随意的微笑只是一种掩饰面试极度紧张的虚张声势。

examples.zh: 肥皂泡在空中轻轻漂浮，展现出绚丽的彩虹色。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 iridescent 为核心的派生词族。

examples.zh: 这场突如其来的悲剧让整个家庭彻底陷入了绝望。

lemmas.def_zh: 微小的, 弱小的, 微不足道的

family_guide.root_logic: 以 puny 为核心的派生词族。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hardback 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to a cuticle or cuticula

examples.en: The cosmetic cream penetrates deep into the dermal layer to restore moisture.
examples.zh: 这款美容霜能深层渗透至真皮层以恢复水分。

lemmas.def_en: the deep vascular inner layer of the skin

examples.en: Tattoo ink must penetrate deep into the dermis layer of the skin to be permanent.
examples.zh: 纹身墨水必须深入渗透到皮肤的真皮层才能保持永久。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dermal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (boxing) a blow with the fist

examples.en: He gave the vending machine a sharp biff to free his drink.
examples.zh: 他猛击了一下自动售货机，把卡住的饮料震了出来。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 biff 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: equipment and supplies of a military force

examples.en: The army base received a fresh shipment of heavy weapons and military materiel.
examples.zh: 陆军基地收到了一批新鲜运抵的重型武器和军用物资。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 materiel 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of various devices for taking hold of objects; usually have two hinged legs with handles above and pointed hooks below

examples.en: She used metal tongs to turn the sizzling sausages over the hot grill.
examples.zh: 她用金属夹子把热烤架上滋滋作响的香肠翻了个面。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tongs 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: <主美>[常用作定语]林荫道路,园林路
lemmas.def_en: a belt of parks or rural land surrounding a town or city

examples.en: The city built a scenic greenway where residents can jog and ride bicycles.
examples.zh: 该市修建了一条风景优美的绿道，居民可以在上面慢跑和骑行。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 greenway 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 肌肉抽筋, 急性硬直
lemmas.def_en: a painful muscle spasm especially in the neck or back (`rick' and `wrick' are British)

examples.en: I woke up this morning with a painful crick in my neck from sleeping awkwardly.
examples.zh: 今天早上醒来时，我因为睡姿不当导致脖子抽筋酸痛。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 crick 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the chief executive and political committee of the Communist Party

examples.en: The party politburo convened an emergency meeting to address the severe economic crisis.
examples.zh: 该党政治局召开紧急会议，以应对严峻的经济危机。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 politburo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a house so small that it is likened to a child's plaything

examples.en: The little girl spent hours arranging the miniature furniture inside her vintage dollhouse.
examples.zh: 小女孩花了数小时在这栋复古玩具小屋里摆放微型家具。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dollhouse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 头带, 轮廓线, 带状物, 带子, 束发带, 肉片, 鱼片, 襻, 嵌条, 丘带, (内)圆角
lemmas.def_en: a boneless steak cut from the tenderloin of beef

examples.en: He ordered a tender beef filet accompanied by roasted seasonal vegetables for dinner.
examples.zh: 晚餐他点了一份鲜嫩的牛柳，并配有烤时蔬。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 filet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a vehicle for carrying a coffin to a church or a cemetery; formerly drawn by horses but now usually a motor vehicle

examples.en: A black hearse moved slowly down the street, leading the quiet funeral procession.
examples.zh: 一辆黑色灵车在街道上缓缓前行，引领着肃穆的送葬队伍。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hearse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 银制的, 似银的, 银色的
lemmas.def_en: of lustrous grey; covered with or tinged with the color of silver

examples.en: The knight raised his argent shield, which gleamed brightly in the midday sun.
examples.zh: 骑士举起银白色的盾牌，在正午的阳光下闪闪发光。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 argent 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 吗哪天赐食物, 精神食粮, 甘露
lemmas.def_en: hardened sugary exudation of various trees

examples.en: The unexpected grant was manna from heaven for the struggling research laboratory.
examples.zh: 这笔意外的拨款对艰难维系的研究实验室而言犹如天赐甘露。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 manna 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 疯狂的；愚蠢的；偏激主观的；怪论连篇的
lemmas.def_en: conspicuously or grossly unconventional or unusual

examples.en: His unique gonzo journalism combined bizarre personal experiences with sharp social commentary.
examples.zh: 他独特的荒诞新闻风格将奇特个人经历与辛辣社会评论融为一体。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gonzo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 可执行的, 可以作成的, 可实行的
lemmas.def_en: capable of being done with means at hand and circumstances as they are

examples.en: Make sure not to download any unknown executable files from suspicious websites.
examples.zh: 切勿从可疑网站下载任何未知来源的可执行文件。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 executable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 令人厌恶的人, 强烈的遣责, 诅咒, 咒逐, 革出教门
lemmas.def_en: a detested person

examples.en: The idea of cheating on exams was complete anathema to the honest student.
examples.zh: 考试作弊的念头对这个诚实的学生来说是完全不可接受的。

lemmas.def_zh: 诅咒, 强烈遣责, 宣布革出教门
lemmas.def_en: curse or declare to be evil or anathema or threaten with divine punishment

family_guide.root_logic: 以 anathema 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 预示, 预兆, 预感
lemmas.def_en: make a prediction about; tell in advance

examples.en: Those thick dark clouds on the horizon seemed to forebode a violent storm.
examples.zh: 地平线上翻滚的浓黑乌云似乎预示着一场暴风雨的来临。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 forebode 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 把(证券等)从上场证券中除去, 把…从清单中划去
lemmas.def_en: remove (a security) from listing at a stock exchange

examples.en: The exchange threatened to delist the company if it failed to submit reports.
examples.zh: 交易所威胁称，若该公司未能提交报告，将对其进行退市处理。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 delist 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 代表, 委员, 人民委员(前苏联部长的旧称)
lemmas.def_en: an official of the Communist Party who was assigned to teach party principles to a military unit

examples.en: The political commissar inspected the troops to ensure strict ideological compliance.
examples.zh: 政委视察了部队，以确保官兵在思想上保持高度一致。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 commissar 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 仓库, 储藏所, 宝库
lemmas.def_en: a depository for goods

examples.en: The old brick storehouse by the docks now serves as a community art gallery.
examples.zh: 码头边那座老砖砌仓库如今被用作社区艺术画廊。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 storehouse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 少女, 姑娘, 恋人
lemmas.def_en: a girl or young woman who is unmarried

examples.en: A cheerful Scottish lassie greeted the tired travelers at the cozy village inn.
examples.zh: 一位开朗的苏格兰姑娘在舒适的乡村客栈迎接了疲惫的旅客。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lassie 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 可居住的, 可栖居的
lemmas.def_en: fit for habitation

examples.en: Renovators worked hard to make the abandoned house inhabitable before winter arrived.
examples.zh: 修缮人员加紧赶工，赶在寒冬来临前让这座废弃房屋变得适宜居住。

lemmas.def_zh: 不可居住的, 不适宜居住的
lemmas.def_en: not fit for habitation

family_guide.root_logic: 以 inhabitable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a word or phrase spelled by rearranging the letters of another word or phrase

examples.en: She rearranged the letters of her name to discover an amusing hidden anagram.
examples.zh: 她重新排列了自己名字的字母，发现了一个有趣的变位词。

lemmas.def_en: read letters out of order to discover a hidden meaning

examples.en: She rearranged the letters of her name to discover an amusing hidden anagram.
examples.zh: 她重新排列了自己名字的字母，发现了一个有趣的变位词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 anagram 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 朝三暮四的, 见异思迁的, 畸形的
lemmas.def_en: changeable

examples.en: A freakish winter heatwave caused early blooms across the northern parts of the country.
examples.zh: 一场反常的冬季热浪导致该国北部地区的花朵提前绽放。

lemmas.def_en: unpredictably

examples.en: the weather has been freakishly variable

lemmas.def_en: marked strangeness as a consequence of being abnormal

family_guide.root_logic: 以 freakish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: vi. 重新排列, 重新组合
lemmas.def_en: align anew or better

examples.en: The company decided to realign its marketing strategy to attract a younger audience.
examples.zh: 该公司决定调整其营销策略，以吸引更多年轻受众。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 realign 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 贪婪的, 饿极的, 狼吞虎咽的
lemmas.def_en: extremely hungry

examples.en: After hiking in the mountains all day, the campers returned home feeling ravenous.
examples.zh: 在山里徒步一整天后，露营者们回到家中感到饥肠辘辘。

lemmas.def_en: in the manner of someone who is very hungry

examples.en: he pounced on the food hungrily

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ravenous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 放弃；放弃信仰, 撤回声明, 公开认错
lemmas.def_en: formally reject or disavow a formerly held belief, usually under pressure

examples.en: Under intense public pressure, the senator was finally forced to recant his controversial statement.
examples.zh: 在巨大的公众压力下，参议员最终被迫撤回了他的争议言论。

lemmas.def_zh: 放弃信仰, 改变论调
lemmas.def_en: a disavowal or taking back of a previous assertion

family_guide.root_logic: 以 recant 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: butt with the head

examples.en: The angry soccer player was ejected after attempting to headbutt the referee.
examples.zh: 那名愤怒的足球运动员因企图用头撞裁判而被罚出场。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 headbutt 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 束发, 发式, 作头发
lemmas.def_en: the arrangement of the hair (especially a woman's hair)

examples.en: She spent all afternoon at the salon getting a stylish hairdo for the party.
examples.zh: 她在美发沙龙度过了整个下午，为派对做了一个时尚的发型。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hairdo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: young cow

examples.en: The young heifer grazed peacefully in the open meadow alongside the other cows.
examples.zh: 那头年轻的小母牛与其他牛群一起在开阔的草地上平静地吃草。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 heifer 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 过度的, 紊乱的, 过分的
lemmas.def_en: beyond normal limits

examples.en: He spends an inordinate amount of time scrolling through social media every single day.
examples.zh: 他每天花过多的时间刷社交媒体。

lemmas.def_zh: 紊乱地, 不规则地, 无限制地, 过分地, 无节制地, 放纵地, 过度地
lemmas.def_en: extremely

examples.en: she was inordinately smart
it will be an extraordinarily painful step to negotiate

family_guide.root_logic: 以 inordinate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: undergarment worn under a skirt

examples.en: She adjusted the lace on her antique petticoat before stepping onto the stage.
examples.zh: 登上舞台前，她整理了一下古董衬裙上的蕾丝。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 petticoat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 超越, 胜过, 战胜
lemmas.def_en: be or do something to a greater degree

examples.en: The two siblings constantly strive to outdo each other in academic achievements.
examples.zh: 这两个兄弟姐妹在学业成绩上总是争相超越对方。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 outdo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: pompous or pretentious talk or writing

examples.en: His political speech was filled with hollow bombast rather than actual policy proposals.
examples.zh: 他的政治演讲充斥着空洞的豪言壮语，而非实际的政策建议。

lemmas.def_zh: 夸大的, 夸夸其谈的
lemmas.def_en: ostentatiously lofty in style

examples.en: a man given to large talk
tumid political prose

lemmas.def_zh: 夸大地；浮华地；言过其实地；矫揉造作地
lemmas.def_en: in a turgid manner

examples.en: he lectured bombastically about his theories

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bombast 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 马背长矛打斗, 格斗
lemmas.def_en: a combat between two mounted knights tilting against each other with blunted lances

examples.en: The medieval festival concluded with an exciting joust between two armored knights.
examples.zh: 中世纪节日以两位身披铠甲的骑士之间精彩的马上枪术比赛收尾。

lemmas.def_en: joust against somebody in a tournament by fighting on horseback

examples.en: The medieval festival concluded with an exciting joust between two armored knights.
examples.zh: 中世纪节日以两位身披铠甲的骑士之间精彩的马上枪术比赛收尾。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 joust 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 痉挛的, 痉挛性的, 痉挛引起的, 患痉挛性麻痹的, 突发的
lemmas.def_en: relating to or characterized by spasm

examples.en: Physical therapy helped reduce the spastic movements in the patient's affected limb.
examples.zh: 物理治疗有助于减少患者受影响肢体的痉挛性动作。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of moving or acting in spasms

family_guide.root_logic: 以 spastic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: something unspecified whose name is either forgotten or not known

examples.en: He bought a strange electronic gizmo that promises to peel fruit automatically.
examples.zh: 他买了一个号称能自动削水果的古怪电子小玩意儿。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gizmo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 平民, 庶民, 大众, 平庸的人
lemmas.def_en: one of the common people

examples.en: He abandoned his aristocratic tastes and embraced more plebeian forms of entertainment.
examples.zh: 他放弃了贵族式的品味，转而接受更为平民化的娱乐方式。

lemmas.def_en: one of the common people

examples.en: The arrogant noble refused to mingle with anyone he considered a mere pleb.
examples.zh: 那个傲慢的贵族拒绝与任何被他视为普通平民的人交往。

lemmas.def_zh: 平民的, 一般的, 普通的, 粗俗的
lemmas.def_en: of or associated with the great masses of people

examples.en: He abandoned his aristocratic tastes and embraced more plebeian forms of entertainment.
examples.zh: 他放弃了贵族式的品味，转而接受更为平民化的娱乐方式。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pleb 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 默许, 共谋, 纵容
lemmas.def_en: encourage or assent to illegally or criminally

examples.en: Corrupt officials connived with local smugglers to bypass regular port security inspections.
examples.zh: 腐败官员与当地走私犯勾结，以绕过常规的港口安检。

lemmas.def_en: agreement on a secret plot

family_guide.root_logic: 以 connive 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: make contact or come together

examples.en: The two tech companies will conjoin their research divisions to speed up development.
examples.zh: 这两家科技公司将合并其研发部门以加快开发进度。

lemmas.def_zh: 连结的, 结合的, 联合的
lemmas.def_en: serving or tending to connect

examples.en: Words like 'and' and 'but' serve a primary conjunctive role in English grammar.
examples.zh: 诸如“and”和“but”等词在英语语法中起着主要的连接作用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 conjoin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an elderly unmarried woman

examples.en: In Victorian literature, an unmarried woman was often labeled an eccentric old spinster.
examples.zh: 在维多利亚时代的文学中，未婚女性常被贴上古怪老姑婆的标签。

lemmas.def_en: the state of being a spinster (usually an elderly unmarried woman)

family_guide.root_logic: 以 spinster 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 苯酚, 石炭酸, 羟基类化合物
lemmas.def_en: any of a class of weakly acidic organic compounds; molecule contains one or more hydroxyl groups

examples.en: The laboratory uses diluted phenol as an effective antiseptic for cleaning equipment.
examples.zh: 实验室使用稀释的苯酚作为清洁设备的有效消毒剂。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 phenol 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 一口, 少量, 小片
lemmas.def_en: a small quantity of anything

examples.en: The hungry puppy quickly devoured every single morsel of food in the bowl.
examples.zh: 饥饿的小狗很快就吃光了碗里的每一粒食物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 morsel 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 可能发生的事, 可能性
lemmas.def_en: a possible event or occurrence or result

examples.en: The disaster response team is thoroughly trained to prepare for every possible eventuality.
examples.zh: 灾难响应团队经过严格训练，随时准备应对各种可能发生的情况。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 eventuality 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 发叮当声, 发铿锵声；使铿然作响
lemmas.def_en: make a clank

examples.en: Old radiator pipes began to clank loudly as soon as the heat activated.
examples.zh: 暖气一启动，老旧的散热器水管就发出刺耳的叮当声。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 发出叮当声的，铿锵作响的
lemmas.def_en: making or characterized by a loud, harsh, non-resonant metallic sound
lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰老旧机械、铁链、盔甲等金属硬物碰撞的声音，如 clanking chains, clanking machinery。

examples.en: The clanking pipes kept the residents awake all through the night.
examples.zh: 叮当作响的管道声让住户们整夜未眠。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 clank 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 改种, 在...再植, 使移居
lemmas.def_en: plant again or anew

examples.en: Gardeners plan to replant the native trees that were destroyed during the hurricane.
examples.zh: 园丁们计划重新种植在飓风中被毁坏的本土树木。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 replant 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: change the size of; make the size more appropriate

examples.en: You can easily resize this high-resolution image to fit the website's banner.
examples.zh: 你可以轻松调整这张高分辨率图片的大小以适配网站横幅。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 resize 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the output of a computer in readable form

examples.en: The digital monitor provides a continuous readout of the patient's vital signs.
examples.zh: 数字监护仪持续提供患者生命体征的读数。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 readout 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an ecclesiastical censure by the Roman Catholic Church withdrawing certain sacraments and Christian burial from a person or all persons in a particular district

examples.en: The international court issued an interdict to halt oil drilling in protected waters.
examples.zh: 国际法庭下达禁令，暂停在受保护水域进行石油开采。

lemmas.def_zh: 禁止, 停止, 阻断
lemmas.def_en: authoritative prohibition

family_guide.root_logic: 以 interdict 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 空虚的, 愚蠢的, 空洞的
lemmas.def_en: devoid of intelligence

examples.en: I got tired of listening to their inane chatter about celebrity gossip.
examples.zh: 我听腻了他们关于明星八卦的空洞闲扯。

lemmas.def_en: total lack of meaning or ideas
vacuously or complacently and unconsciously foolish

family_guide.root_logic: 以 inane 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 理论家, 思想家,空想家
lemmas.def_en: an advocate of some ideology

examples.en: The party ideologue refused to compromise on any of their radical core doctrines.
examples.zh: 该党的理论家拒绝在其任何激进的核心信条上妥协。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ideologue 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: pain caused by venous swelling at or inside the anal sphincter

examples.en: A fiber-rich diet can help reduce the painful symptoms of a hemorrhoid.
examples.zh: 高纤维饮食有助于减轻痔疮带来的痛苦症状。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hemorrhoid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a salt or ester derived from silicic acid

examples.en: Clay is mainly composed of silicate minerals that harden after being fired.
examples.zh: 粘土主要由硅酸盐矿物组成，经烧制后会变硬。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 silicate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: vt 烹调过分的, 烹调过度的
lemmas.def_en: cook too long

examples.en: Be careful not to overcook the salmon, or it will become very dry.
examples.zh: 小心别把三文鱼煮过头，否则肉质会变得很干。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 overcook 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 工作迷, 醉心于工作的人
lemmas.def_en: person with a compulsive need to work

examples.en: As a self-confessed workaholic, she rarely leaves the office before eight in the evening.
examples.zh: 作为自认的工作狂，她很少在晚上八点前离开办公室。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 workaholic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a small shallow-draft boat carrying mounted guns; used by costal patrols

examples.en: The navy deployed a small gunboat to patrol the shallow coastal waters.
examples.zh: 海军部署了一艘小型炮艇在浅海沿岸巡逻。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gunboat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: clothing for the head

examples.en: The tribal chief wore a magnificent feather headdress during the annual ceremony.
examples.zh: 部落酋长在年度庆典上戴着华丽的羽毛头饰。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 headdress 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 缺乏的, 仅有的, 不够的, 狭小的, 吝啬的
lemmas.def_en: lacking in amplitude or quantity

examples.en: The police struggled to solve the case with such scanty and unreliable evidence.
examples.zh: 面对如此缺乏且不可靠的证据，警方难以破案。

lemmas.def_zh: 缺乏地; 不充足地; 吝啬地; 狭窄地
lemmas.def_en: in a sparse or scanty way

examples.en: a barely furnished room

lemmas.def_en: the quality of being meager; -George Eliot

examples.en: an exiguity of cloth that would only allow of miniature capes

family_guide.root_logic: 以 scanty 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 可赎回的, 可挽救的, 可偿还的
lemmas.def_en: recoverable upon payment or fulfilling a condition

examples.en: These gift vouchers are redeemable for cash or merchandise at any branch.
examples.zh: 这些礼券可在任何分店兑换现金或商品。

lemmas.def_zh: 不能收回的, 不能赎回的
lemmas.def_en: insusceptible of reform

examples.en: vicious irreclaimable boys
irredeemable sinners

family_guide.root_logic: 以 redeemable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 通气管, 气孔, 通风道, 烟道
lemmas.def_en: a scene that is filmed but is not used in the final editing of the film

examples.en: The ventilation system draws smoke away through an outtake located on the roof.
examples.zh: 通风系统通过位于屋顶的排气孔将烟雾排出。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 outtake 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 耳机, 护耳片, 眼镜脚, 头戴式耳机
lemmas.def_en: electro-acoustic transducer for converting electric signals into sounds; it is held over or inserted into the ear

examples.en: The security guard pressed his earpiece to hear the urgent message clearly.
examples.zh: 保安按紧耳机，以便听清紧急消息。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 earpiece 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: terrestrial worm that burrows into and helps aerate soil; often surfaces when the ground is cool or wet; used as bait by anglers

examples.en: A large earthworm wriggled on the wet sidewalk after the heavy morning rain.
examples.zh: 清晨大雨过后，一条大蚯蚓在潮湿的人行道上蠕动。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 earthworm 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: ground that is permanently frozen

examples.en: Rising global temperatures are causing the Arctic permafrost to thaw at alarming rates.
examples.zh: 全球气温上升正导致北极冻土带以惊人的速度融化。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 permafrost 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 火柴制造者, 媒人, 安排比赛的人
lemmas.def_en: someone who arranges (or tries to arrange) marriages for others

examples.en: Her grandmother acted as a matchmaker and introduced her to a charming doctor.
examples.zh: 她的祖母充当媒人，把她介绍给了一位迷人的医生。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 matchmaker 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 精明的, 明智的, 策略的
lemmas.def_en: marked by artful prudence, expedience, and shrewdness

examples.en: Under the tense circumstances, he thought it politic to remain completely silent.
examples.zh: 在紧张的局势下，他认为保持完全沉默是明智之举。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 politic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: contemptibly small in amount

examples.en: The sick child was covered in a measly rash and ran a high fever.
examples.zh: 生病的孩子身上长满了出麻疹般的皮疹，并伴有高烧。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 measly 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 说法, 说话的方式方法, 用语
lemmas.def_en: a manner of speaking that is natural to native speakers of a language

examples.en: In financial parlance, the term liquidity refers to how quickly assets turn into cash.
examples.zh: 在金融用语中，流动性一词指资产转化为现金的速度。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 parlance 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不可忍受的, 忍耐不住的
lemmas.def_en: used of persons or their behavior

examples.en: His arrogant attitude and constant bragging made him insufferable to work with.
examples.zh: 他傲慢的态度和不断的吹嘘让人无法忍受与他共事。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 insufferable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a political orientation originating in the 1960s; blends liberal political views with an emphasis on economic growth

examples.en: Critics argue that neoliberalism widens the economic gap between the rich and poor.
examples.zh: 批评人士认为新自由主义拉大了贫富之间的经济差距。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 neoliberalism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: important European leguminous forage plant with trifoliate leaves and blue-violet flowers grown widely as a pasture and hay crop

examples.en: The farmer harvested a fresh field of lucerne to feed his dairy cows.
examples.zh: 农夫收割了一片新鲜的苜蓿来喂养他的奶牛。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lucerne 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a network of intersecting blood vessels or intersecting nerves or intersecting lymph vessels

examples.en: The solar plexus is a complex network of nerves located in the abdomen.
examples.zh: 腹腔神经丛是位于腹部的一个复杂神经网络。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 plexus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: having or involving or marked by several dimensions or aspects

examples.en: Poverty is a multidimensional problem requiring both economic and social policy solutions.
examples.zh: 贫困是一个多维度的问题，需要经济与社会政策共同解决。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 multidimensional 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 移转, 踌躇不前, 停止不动
lemmas.def_en: refuse to comply

examples.en: The stubborn horse suddenly jibbed and refused to cross the wooden bridge.
examples.zh: 那匹倔强的马突然踌躇不前，拒绝走过木桥。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 jib 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a recreational facility including a swimming pool for water sports

examples.en: Families flocked to the outdoor lido to cool off during the heatwave.
examples.zh: 热浪期间，许多家庭涌向露天游泳池消暑纳凉。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lido 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: characteristic of a revival of an earlier classical style

examples.en: The grand museum was designed in a neoclassical style with towering stone columns.
examples.zh: 这座宏伟的博物馆采用新古典主义风格设计，带有高耸的石柱。

lemmas.def_en: revival of a classical style (in art or literature or architecture or music) but from a new perspective or with a new motivation

examples.en: The grand courthouse facade reflects the balanced symmetry characteristic of neoclassicism.
examples.zh: 宏伟的法院外立面体现了新古典主义标志性的均衡对称。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 neoclassical 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 朱特人, 朱特族, 黄麻
lemmas.def_en: a plant fiber used in making rope or sacks

examples.en: The workers stored the dried jute fibers in large woven sacks.
examples.zh: 工人们把晒干的黄麻纤维存放在大编织袋里。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 jute 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 外来的, 非必要的, 无关的
lemmas.def_en: not pertinent to the matter under consideration

examples.en: Please delete any extraneous details to keep the report concise and clear.
examples.zh: 请删去无关的细节，以保持报告简明扼要。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 extraneous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 无所不在的, 普通存在的
lemmas.def_en: being present everywhere at once

examples.en: Smartphones have become an omnipresent feature of modern daily life worldwide.
examples.zh: 智能手机已成为全球现代日常生活中无处不在的事物。

lemmas.def_en: the state of being everywhere at once (or seeming to be everywhere at once)

examples.en: Smartphones have led to the omnipresence of digital media in our daily lives.
examples.zh: 智能手机导致数字媒体在我们的日常生活中无处不在。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 omnipresent 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of several North American trees of the genus Populus having a tuft of cottony hairs on the seed

examples.en: A tall cottonwood tree shaded the front yard during the hot summer.
examples.zh: 在炎热的夏天，一棵高大的三角叶杨遮蔽着前院。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cottonwood 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: relating to geometry as developed by Euclid

examples.en: Traditional architects often rely on Euclidean geometry to draft their building blueprints.
examples.zh: 传统建筑师经常依靠欧几里得几何学来绘制建筑蓝图。

lemmas.def_zh: (古希腊数学家)欧几里得的, 欧几里得几何学的
lemmas.def_en: relating to geometry as developed by Euclid

examples.en: High school geometry typically begins with the principles of standard euclidian space.
examples.zh: 高中几何通常从标准的欧几里得空间原理开始讲起。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 euclidean 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 举动, 行为；所做之事（doing的复数）
lemmas.def_en: manner of acting or controlling yourself

examples.en: The suspicious neighbor watched all the strange doings across the street closely.
examples.zh: 多疑的邻居密切注视着街对面发生的所有古怪举动。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 doings 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 似男孩的顽皮姑娘, 假小子
lemmas.def_en: a girl who behaves in a boyish manner

examples.en: As a young tomboy, she preferred climbing trees to playing with dolls.
examples.zh: 小时候她是个假小子，比起玩洋娃娃更喜欢爬树。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tomboy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: in need of repairs

examples.en: The abandoned mansion had fallen into complete disrepair over the last decade.
examples.zh: 在过去的十年里，这座废弃的豪宅已经彻底年久失修。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 disrepair 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: in a dim indistinct manner

examples.en: A single candle dimly illuminated the dusty corners of the dark attic.
examples.zh: 一根蜡烛微弱地照亮了黑暗阁楼里布满灰尘的角落。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dimly 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a highly toxic chemical nerve agent that inhibits the activity of cholinesterase

examples.en: The international treaty strictly bans the production and stockpile of deadly sarin.
examples.zh: 该国际条约严格禁止生产和储存致命的沙林毒剂。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sarin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 闩, 横木, 球门的横木
lemmas.def_en: a horizontal bar that goes across something

examples.en: His powerful shot hit the crossbar and bounced away from the goal.
examples.zh: 他的强力射门击中横梁，弹出了球门范围。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 crossbar 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a rotating shaft driven by (or driving) a crank

examples.en: The mechanic replaced the damaged crankshaft to get the engine running smoothly.
examples.zh: 修理工更换了损坏的曲轴，以使发动机平稳运转。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 crankshaft 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: game bird of the sandpiper family that resembles a snipe

examples.en: A solitary woodcock probed the moist soil in search of fresh earthworms.
examples.zh: 一只单独行动的丘鹬探入湿润的土壤中寻找新鲜的蚯蚓。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 woodcock 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 佃农, 茅屋小农, 雇农, 开尾销, 销, 制销
lemmas.def_en: a peasant farmer in the Scottish Highlands

examples.en: Make sure to secure the wheel with a sturdy steel cotter pin.
examples.zh: 务必使用坚固的钢制开尾销将轮子固定好。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cotter 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a steep-walled semicircular basin in a mountain; may contain a lake

examples.en: A quiet glacial lake rested at the base of the steep corrie.
examples.zh: 一个宁静的冰川湖坐落在陡峭的冰斗底部。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 corrie 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of various edible tropical marine gastropods of the genus Strombus having a brightly-colored spiral shell with large outer lip

examples.en: She picked up a pink conch shell from the warm sandy beach.
examples.zh: 她从温暖的沙滩上捡起了一枚粉红色的海螺壳。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 conch 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 森林的, 农村的, 乡村的
lemmas.def_en: relating to or characteristic of wooded regions

examples.en: They enjoyed a peaceful picnic in the sylvan surroundings of the park.
examples.zh: 他们在公园充满林木芳馨的优美环境中享受了一场宁静的野餐。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sylvan 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 长老住宅, 长老, 区会, 教区, 司祭席
lemmas.def_en: building reserved for the officiating clergy

examples.en: The visiting priest stayed at the presbytery next to the old church.
examples.zh: 来访的神父住在老教堂旁边的神父住宅里。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 presbytery 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: having a common axis

examples.en: The technician connected the television to the wall outlet using coaxial cable.
examples.zh: 技术人员用同轴电缆将电视机连接到墙上的插座。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 coaxial 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a cat with a grey or tawny coat mottled with black

examples.en: An orange tabby cat curled up on the rug for an afternoon nap.
examples.zh: 一只橘色斑猫蜷缩在地毯上睡午觉。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tabby 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the readily stainable substance of a cell nucleus consisting of DNA and RNA and various proteins; during mitotic division it condenses into chromosomes

examples.en: The cell condenses its chromatin into distinct chromosomes before dividing successfully.
examples.zh: 细胞在成功分裂前会将染色质浓缩成清晰的染色体。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chromatin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: anesthetize with chloroform

examples.en: The old villain tried to chloroform the guard to enter the vault.
examples.zh: 那个老恶棍企图用氯仿迷晕警卫以潜入金库。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chloroform 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 雪纺绸, 薄绸, 女子服装装饰品
lemmas.def_en: a sheer fabric of silk or rayon

examples.en: Her elegant wedding dress was made of layers of delicate white chiffon.
examples.zh: 她优雅的婚纱由数层精致的白雪纺制成。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chiffon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 荞麦, 荞麦片, 荞麦粉
lemmas.def_en: a member of the genus Fagopyrum; annual Asian plant with clusters of small pinkish white flowers and small edible triangular seeds which are used whole or ground into flour

examples.en: She cooked a warm bowl of buckwheat porridge for a healthy breakfast.
examples.zh: 她煮了一碗热腾腾的荞麦粥作为健康早餐。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 buckwheat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 娇养, 溺爱, 用文火煮(蛋)
lemmas.def_en: treat with excessive indulgence

examples.en: Parents should not coddle their children if they want them to become independent.
examples.zh: 如果父母希望孩子独立，就不应该过分溺爱他们。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 coddle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 礼貌, 规矩, 适当
lemmas.def_en: correct or appropriate behavior

examples.en: She always behaved with great propriety in front of her strict grandparents.
examples.zh: 她在严厉的祖父母面前总是表现得极有分寸。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 propriety 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a dwarfed ornamental tree or shrub grown in a tray or shallow pot

examples.en: He carefully trimmed the delicate bonsai tree on the sunny windowsill yesterday.
examples.zh: 他昨天仔细修剪了向阳窗台上的那株精致盆栽。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bonsai 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: densely branched Eurasian plant; foliage turns purple-red in autumn

examples.en: Tourists climbed up to the belvedere to enjoy the breathtaking panoramic view.
examples.zh: 游客们爬上望景楼，欣赏令人叹为观止的全景。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 belvedere 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a soft silvery-white tetravalent radioactive metallic element; isotope 232 is used as a power source in nuclear reactors; occurs in thorite and in monazite sands

examples.en: Scientists consider thorium a potentially safer alternative fuel for nuclear power plants.
examples.zh: 科学家认为钍是核电站潜在的更安全替代燃料。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 thorium 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: someone who guards an entrance

examples.en: The friendly doorman greeted every resident with a warm smile each morning.
examples.zh: 友善的门童每天早晨都带着热情的微笑迎接每位住户。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 doorman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a removable board fitted on the side of a wagon to increase its capacity

examples.en: She placed the antique silver tea set on the wooden dining sideboard.
examples.zh: 她把古董银质茶具摆放在了木质餐具柜上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sideboard 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [商](股票)报升(成交价格比上一个交易高的成交或价格)
lemmas.def_en: a transaction in the stock market at a price above the price of the preceding transaction

examples.en: The retail company reported a sudden uptick in online sales this quarter.
examples.zh: 这家零售公司报告称本季度线上销售额突然上升。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 uptick 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: pan with a convex bottom; used for frying in Chinese cooking

examples.en: Heat the cooking oil in a large wok before adding the vegetables.
examples.zh: 在将蔬菜下锅之前，先在大炒锅里把食用油烧热。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wok 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: French classical painter (1780-1867)

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ingress 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: lack of intellectual power

examples.en: His sudden physical incapacity prevented him from completing the difficult mountain climb.
examples.zh: 他身体机能的突然丧失使他无法完成艰难的登山。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 incapacity 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: impossible to hear; imperceptible by the ear

examples.en: Her timid reply was completely inaudible over the roar of the crowd.
examples.zh: 在人群的喧嚣声中，她怯懦的回答完全听不见。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 inaudible 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 渗透作用, 渗透性, 潜移默化, 耳濡目染
lemmas.def_en: (biology, chemistry) diffusion of molecules through a semipermeable membrane from a place of higher concentration to a place of lower concentration until the concentration on both sides is equal

examples.en: Living abroad helped her absorb the foreign language almost entirely through osmosis.
examples.zh: 在国外生活让她几乎完全通过耳濡目染掌握了这门外语。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to osmosis

examples.en: The cells collapsed rapidly after being exposed to a high osmotic pressure environment.
examples.zh: 细胞在暴露于高渗透压环境后迅速萎缩。

lemmas.def_en: by means of osmosis

family_guide.root_logic: 以 osmosis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the direction from which the wind is coming

examples.en: The experienced sailors directed the boat toward the safer, sheltered windward coast.
examples.zh: 经验丰富的水手们将船驶向更安全、有遮蔽的上风面海岸。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 windward 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (slang) offensive names for a White man

examples.en: The movie accurately reflected the racial tensions where that slur was used.
examples.zh: 这部电影真实反映了使用该种族侮辱性词汇的紧张关系。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 honky 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the cause or intention underlying an action or situation, especially in the phrase `the whys and wherefores'

examples.en: He explained the subtle why and wherefore behind his surprising career decision.
examples.zh: 他解释了自己做出这个惊人职业决定背后的微妙缘由。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wherefore 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of numerous plants widely cultivated for their showy single or double red or pink or white flowers

examples.en: A vibrant pink peony bloomed beautifully in the center of her garden.
examples.zh: 一朵娇艳的粉色牡丹在她花园的中心美丽绽放。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 peony 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: to this place (especially toward the speaker)

examples.en: He waved his hand urgently to summon the young servant hither immediately.
examples.zh: 他急切地挥手，示意那个年轻仆人立刻到这边来。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hither 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不透水的, 不漏水的, 无懈可击的
lemmas.def_en: not allowing water to pass in or out

examples.en: The clever defense lawyer presented a watertight alibi for the innocent suspect.
examples.zh: 这位聪明的辩护律师为无辜的嫌疑人提供了无懈可击的不在场证明。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 watertight 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 巴拉汀伯爵的, 在领地内行使王权的, 腭的, 宏伟的, 壮丽的
lemmas.def_en: relating to or lying near the palate

examples.en: The ancient palatine chapel impressed visitors with its exceptionally grand architectural design.
examples.zh: 古老的王权礼拜堂以其格外宏伟的建筑设计让游客印象深刻。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 palatine 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 草本的, 叶状的, 绿色的
lemmas.def_en: characteristic of a nonwoody herb or plant part

examples.en: These herbaceous perennials will naturally die back during the cold winter months.
examples.zh: 这些草本多年生植物在寒冷的冬季会自然枯萎。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 herbaceous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 交通全面大堵塞; 僵局
lemmas.def_en: a traffic jam so bad that no movement is possible

examples.en: An overturned truck caused hours of complete gridlock on the main highway.
examples.zh: 一辆翻倒的卡车导致主干公路上出现了数小时的彻底瘫痪。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gridlock 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 铁的, 含铁的, 亚铁的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or containing iron

examples.en: A powerful magnet can easily separate ferrous scrap from non-magnetic household waste.
examples.zh: 强力磁铁可以轻松地从非磁性生活垃圾中分离出含铁废料。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ferrous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a geological process in which one edge of a crustal plate is forced sideways and downward into the mantle below another plate

examples.en: Severe earthquakes frequently occur along the oceanic plate subduction zone off coast.
examples.zh: 沿海的大洋板块俯冲带附近经常发生强烈地震。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 subduction 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 异教徒, 异教信仰, 偶像崇拜
lemmas.def_en: any of various religions other than Christianity or Judaism or Islamism

examples.en: The historian studied the transition from ancient paganism to Christianity in the region.
examples.zh: 历史学家研究了该地区从古代异教信仰向基督教的转变。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 paganism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a holding device attached to a workbench; has two jaws to hold workpiece firmly in place

examples.en: He clamped the wooden board firmly in the vise before sawing it.
examples.zh: 他在锯木板之前，先把它牢牢地夹在虎钳里。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 vise 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 泛滥, 洪水, 大雨, 大量, 一阵
lemmas.def_en: (often followed by `of') a large number or amount or extent

examples.en: The police are investigating a recent spate of burglaries in the quiet neighborhood.
examples.zh: 警方正在调查这个安静社区最近发生的一连串盗窃案。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 spate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 安琪莉可（女子名）；百劫红颜（电影名称）
lemmas.def_en: any of various tall and stout herbs of the genus Angelica having pinnately compound leaves and small white or greenish flowers in compound umbels

examples.en: Angelique decided to pursue her master's degree in fine arts in Paris.
examples.zh: 安琪莉可决定去巴黎攻读纯艺术硕士学位。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 angelique 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 表情符号, 表情图示
lemmas.def_en: a representation of a facial expression (as a smile or frown) created by typing a sequence of characters in sending email

examples.en: She added a smiling emoticon to her text message to show her happiness.
examples.zh: 她在短信里加了一个笑脸表情符号来表达喜悦。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 emoticon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a young male attendant on a Scottish Highlander chief

examples.en: The experienced gillie guided the visitors to the best fishing spots along the river.
examples.zh: 经验丰富的向导带领游客前往沿河最佳的钓鱼点。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gillie 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 可以解的, 可以解决的
lemmas.def_en: capable of being solved

examples.en: With proper collaboration, most technical challenges turn out to be completely solvable.
examples.zh: 只要通力合作，大多数技术难题最终都可以得到解决。

lemmas.def_en: not easily solved; ; - C.L.Jones

examples.en: an apparantly insolvable problem
public finance...had long presented problems unsolvable or at least unsolved

lemmas.def_en: the property (of a problem or difficulty) that makes it possible to solve

family_guide.root_logic: 以 solvable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 使麻木不仁, 使不敏感
lemmas.def_en: cause not to be sensitive

examples.en: Constant exposure to violent media can gradually desensitize people to real suffering.
examples.zh: 持续接触暴力媒体会逐渐让人对现实中的苦难麻木不仁。

lemmas.def_zh: 脱敏(现象), 减感(作用)
lemmas.def_en: the process of reducing sensitivity

examples.en: the patient was desensitized to the allergen

family_guide.root_logic: 以 desensitize 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 开胃的, 促进食欲的, 鲜美可口的
lemmas.def_en: appealing to or stimulating the appetite especially in appearance or aroma

examples.en: The chef prepared an appetizing platter of grilled seafood and fresh herbs.
examples.zh: 厨师准备了一盘诱人可口的海鲜烧烤拼盘配新鲜香草。

lemmas.def_en: not appetizing in appearance, aroma, or taste

family_guide.root_logic: 以 appetizing 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 水门, 水闸, 防潮水闸
lemmas.def_en: something that restrains a flood or outpouring

examples.en: Engineers opened the main floodgate to prevent the rising river from bursting its banks.
examples.zh: 工程师打开主水闸，以防上涨的河水决堤。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 floodgate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a path (often marked) where something (as a street or railroad) can be crossed to get from one side to the other

examples.en: Drivers are required by law to stop for pedestrians waiting at the crosswalk.
examples.zh: 法律规定，司机必须停车礼让在人行横道等待的行人。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 crosswalk 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: rotating mechanism in the form of a universally mounted spinning wheel that offers resistance to turns in any direction

examples.en: The smartphone relies on an internal gyroscope to determine its precise orientation.
examples.zh: 智能手机依靠内置陀螺仪来确定其精准朝向。

lemmas.def_en: having the characteristics of a gyroscope

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gyroscope 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a non-finite form of the verb; in English it is used adjectivally and to form compound tenses

examples.en: The teacher explained how a present participle can function as an adjective.
examples.zh: 老师解释了现在分词是如何充当形容词使用的。

lemmas.def_en: a non-finite form of the verb; in English it is used adjectivally and to form compound tenses

family_guide.root_logic: 以 participle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: metal that is cast in the shape of a block for convenient handling

examples.en: The worker carefully lifted the heavy gold ingot using a pair of tongs.
examples.zh: 工人用一把钳子小心翼翼地夹起沉重的金锭。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ingot 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the branch of medical science that studies viruses and viral diseases

examples.en: Recent breakthroughs in virology have helped scientists develop more effective vaccines.
examples.zh: 病毒学最近的突破帮助科学家研发出了更有效的疫苗。

lemmas.def_en: a specialist in virology
of or relating to the science of virology

examples.en: virological research

family_guide.root_logic: 以 virology 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: befitting a person of noble origin

examples.en: He was born into a patrician family with deep roots in local politics.
examples.zh: 他出生于一个在当地政界根基深厚的贵族家庭。

lemmas.def_en: a person of refined upbringing and manners

examples.en: He was born into a patrician family with deep roots in local politics.
examples.zh: 他出生于一个在当地政界根基深厚的贵族家庭。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 patrician 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 永世, 万古, 极长的时期
lemmas.def_en: (Gnosticism) a divine power or nature emanating from the Supreme Being and playing various roles in the operation of the universe

examples.en: Geologists estimate that these unique rock formations took an aeon to develop completely.
examples.zh: 地质学家估计，这些独特岩层的完全形成经历了漫长岁月。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 aeon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an enthusiastic kiss

examples.en: The happy couple shared a quick smooch before boarding their separate trains.
examples.zh: 这对幸福的恋人在登上各自的火车前匆匆吻别。

lemmas.def_zh: 搂抱着接吻；与...搂抱接吻, 弄脏
lemmas.def_en: snuggle and lie in a position where one person faces the back of the others

examples.en: The happy couple shared a quick smooch before boarding their separate trains.
examples.zh: 这对幸福的恋人在登上各自的火车前匆匆吻别。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 smooch 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: be or become luminescent; exhibit luminescence

examples.en: Certain deep-sea jellyfish luminesce brightly when disturbed by predators in the dark.
examples.zh: 某些深海玻璃水母在黑暗中受到捕食者惊扰时会发出亮光。

lemmas.def_zh: 无热光, 冷光, 发冷光
lemmas.def_en: light not due to incandescence; occurs at low temperatures
emitting light not caused by heat

family_guide.root_logic: 以 luminesce 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 过大而不适于, 长得比...高(或大、快), 成长得不再具有...
lemmas.def_en: grow too large or too mature for

examples.en: Children often outgrow their shoes quickly during their annual summer growth spurts.
examples.zh: 孩子们在夏季猛长期通常很快就穿不下原来的鞋子了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 outgrow 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a knob used to release the catch when opening a door (often called `doorhandle' in Great Britain)

examples.en: She polished the antique brass doorknob until it shone brightly in the sunlight.
examples.zh: 她把那只复古黄铜门把手擦得在阳光下熠熠生辉。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 doorknob 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the working together of two things (muscles or drugs for example) to produce an effect greater than the sum of their individual effects

examples.en: The successful merger demonstrated the powerful synergism between the two tech companies.
examples.zh: 这次成功的合并展现了两家科技公司之间强大的协同效应。

lemmas.def_en: used especially of drugs or muscles that work together so the total effect is greater than the sum of the two (or more)

lemmas.def_zh: [医]协同地, 协同作用地, 以协同方式
lemmas.def_en: (of group) in a synergistic or cooperative manner

family_guide.root_logic: 以 synergism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the line formed by the edge of a garment around the neck

examples.en: Her elegant evening dress featured a flattering sweetheart neckline.
examples.zh: 她优雅的晚礼服有着迷人的心形领口。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 neckline 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a ritual recitation of words or sounds believed to have a magical effect

examples.en: The wizard muttered an ancient incantation to open the locked door.
examples.zh: 巫师低声念诵古老的咒语以打开锁住的门。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 incantation 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the belief in magical spells that harness occult forces or evil spirits to produce unnatural effects in the world

examples.en: The dark cult was accused of practicing necromancy in the cemetery.
examples.zh: 该黑暗教派被指控在墓地里施行通灵巫术。

lemmas.def_en: one who practices magic or sorcery
relating to or associated with necromancy

examples.en: mysterious necromantic rites

family_guide.root_logic: 以 necromancy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an affront to one's dignity or self-esteem

examples.en: He suffered the indignity of being publicly reprimanded by his boss.
examples.zh: 他遭受了被老板当众斥责的侮辱。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 indignity 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 被虐待狂, 受虐待者
lemmas.def_en: someone who obtains pleasure from receiving punishment

examples.en: You must be a masochist to go running outside in this freezing blizzard.
examples.zh: 在这场冰冻暴风雪中到室外跑步，你一定是个受虐狂。

lemmas.def_en: sexual pleasure obtained from receiving punishment (physical or psychological)

examples.en: Choosing to run a marathon in the freezing rain seemed like pure masochism.
examples.zh: 选择在冰雨中跑马拉松简直就像纯粹的受虐。

lemmas.def_zh: 性受虐狂者的, 受虐狂者的
lemmas.def_en: deriving pleasure or sexual gratification from being abused or dominated
in a masochistic manner

examples.en: masochistically he insisted on an even greater workload

family_guide.root_logic: 以 masochism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a print made from a woodcut

examples.en: The gallery exhibited a rare collection of sixteenth-century woodcut prints.
examples.zh: 画廊展出了一批罕见的16世纪木刻版画藏品。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 woodcut 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: characterized by energy and vigor

examples.en: The actor was admired for his virile charm and commanding stage presence.
examples.zh: 这位演员因其充满阳刚之气的魅力和极具威慑力的舞台气场而备受赞誉。

lemmas.def_zh: 成年, 男性生殖力, 男子气概, 精力充沛, 雄浑, 刚强有力
lemmas.def_en: the masculine property of being capable of copulation and procreation

family_guide.root_logic: 以 virile 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: corrupt morally or by intemperance or sensuality

examples.en: Politicians should not debase the debate with crude personal insults.
examples.zh: 政客们不应以粗俗的人身攻击来贬低辩论的格调。

lemmas.def_en: being mixed with extraneous material; the product of adulterating
a person who lowers the quality or character or value (as by adding cheaper metal to coins)

family_guide.root_logic: 以 debase 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a decorative framework to conceal curtain fixtures at the top of a window casing

examples.en: The workers carefully restored the ornate plaster cornice along the living room ceiling.
examples.zh: 工人们仔细修复了客厅天花板边缘华丽的石膏檐口。

lemmas.def_en: furnish with a cornice

examples.en: The workers carefully restored the ornate plaster cornice along the living room ceiling.
examples.zh: 工人们仔细修复了客厅天花板边缘华丽的石膏檐口。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cornice 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: try to stir up public opinion

examples.en: The rebel group tried to foment discord among the local population.
examples.zh: 叛乱团伙企图在当地民众中煽动不和。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 foment 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [医] 去纤颤器, 除纤颤器
lemmas.def_en: an electronic device that administers an electric shock of preset voltage to the heart through the chest wall in an attempt to restore the normal rhythm of the heart during ventricular fibrillation

examples.en: Paramedics quickly applied the defibrillator to restore the patient's normal heartbeat.
examples.zh: 急救人员迅速使用除颤器来恢复病人的正常心跳。

lemmas.def_zh: [医] 去纤颤, 除纤颤(使纤维性颤动停止), 组织纤维分离[法]
lemmas.def_en: treatment by stopping fibrillation of heart muscles (usually by electric shock delivered by a defibrillator)

lemmas.def_zh: & vi .[医](使)(心脏)去纤颤,(使)( 心脏)除纤颤
lemmas.def_en: stop the fibrillation and restore normal contractions, usually by means of electric shocks

examples.en: The emergency response team rushed in to defibrillate the patient and restore a normal heartbeat.
examples.zh: 急救小组迅速赶到，对患者进行除颤以恢复正常心跳。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 defibrillator 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: stout-bodied insect with large membranous wings; male has drum-like organs for producing a high-pitched drone

examples.en: The loud buzzing of a cicada echoed through the warm summer afternoon.
examples.zh: 蝉响亮的鸣叫声回荡在温暖的夏日午后。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cicada 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a short pithy instructive saying

examples.en: My grandmother often quoted the aphorism that actions speak louder than words.
examples.zh: 我祖母常引用“行胜于言”这句格言。

lemmas.def_zh: 关于格言/警句的, 格言/警句性的
lemmas.def_en: containing aphorisms or maxims

examples.en: axiomatic wisdom

family_guide.root_logic: 以 aphorism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 未确诊的,尚未找出原因的
lemmas.def_en: eluding diagnosis

examples.en: She suffered from severe chronic fatigue that remained undiagnosed for years.
examples.zh: 她患有严重的慢性疲劳，多年来一直未确诊病因。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 undiagnosed 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 瓦尔纳[保加利亚东北部港市]
lemmas.def_en: a port city in northeastern Bulgaria on the Black Sea

examples.en: Many European tourists spend their summer holidays relaxing on the beaches of Varna.
examples.zh: 许多欧洲游客在瓦尔纳的海滩上度过夏日假期。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 varna 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 可用时间, 正常运行时间
lemmas.def_en: a period of time when something (as a machine or factory) is functioning and available for use

examples.en: The cloud hosting provider guarantees ninety-nine point nine percent server uptime.
examples.zh: 这家云托管服务商保证百分之九十九点九的服务器正常运行时间。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 uptime 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 无报答的, 没有受到报复的
lemmas.def_en: not returned in kind

examples.en: He poured his grief over unrequited love into heartfelt poetry.
examples.zh: 他将单相思的悲伤倾注在由衷的诗篇中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 unrequited 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the exterior body of a motor vehicle

examples.en: The mechanic repaired the dented bodywork after the minor car accident.
examples.zh: 轻微车祸后，技工修好了凹陷的车身。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bodywork 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a Latin American dance similar in rhythm to the rumba

examples.en: The lively rhythm of the mambo got everyone dancing immediately.
examples.zh: 曼波舞欢快的节奏立刻让每个人都跳起舞来。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mambo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a small drum with one head of soft calfskin

examples.zh: 那位中世纪街头乐手吹着简朴的木笛，敲着小鼓。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tabor 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 妻与前夫所生的女儿, 夫与前妻所生的女儿
lemmas.def_en: a daughter of your spouse by a former marriage

examples.en: He treated his stepdaughter with the same love as his own children.
examples.zh: 他对待继女就像对待亲生孩子一样关爱。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stepdaughter 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a leaven of dough in which fermentation is active; used by pioneers for making bread

examples.en: Every Sunday morning, he bakes a fresh loaf of crusty sourdough bread.
examples.zh: 每个星期天早晨，他都会烤一条新鲜酥脆的酵母酸面包。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sourdough 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: male sheep especially a castrated one

examples.en: The experienced farmer selected a healthy wether to lead the grazing flock.
examples.zh: 经验丰富的农夫挑选了一只健康的阉羊来领引放牧的羊群。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wether 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a boisterous comedy with chases and collisions and practical jokes
